items.english_text: *Troparion:* Taught by the words of Paul, O Thecla, bride of God *...and confirmed in the faith by Peter, called of God, thou wast revealed as a protomartyr and first among women to suffer; thou didst ascend the pyre as unto a place of fair blossoming; wild beasts and bulls were struck with terror before thee, as thou wast armed with the Cross: therefore pray, O all-lauded one, that our souls may be saved!*[^223]

items.english_text: *Kontakion:* Thou didst shine forth with the beauty of virginity, O maiden, and wast adorned with the crown of martyrdom; thou wast steadfastly entrusted with the apostolate, O glorious one, and didst turn the fiery flame into dew, and muzzle the mouths of beasts, striving to save thyself as thou didst seek Paul, O first-suffering Thecla!

items.slavonic_text: к҃е · Пр҃пеныꙗ м҃рте нашеꙗ є҆фросиньи · а́леѯа ндрьскыꙗ · в҃е пѣніе по обыю тр҃о гл҃а и҃ · Ѡ тебѣ м҃ти є́фросинье · и҆ꙁвѣстно сп҃сесе · є́же по ѡ҆браꙁꙋ · пріимши бо кр҃ть послѣдова хр҃тоу · дѣюще на оу҆чеваше преꙁирати плът преходитъ бо · прилежати же дш҃и · вещии бессм҃ртнѣитѣм же съ а́г҃глы · радꙋетсѧ дꙋ хъ твои :~ по ѕ҃ пѣ ко̑ гл҃а в҃ по̑ вышнн Вышніи живота желающе · спобити сѧ · нижнюю пищю тощно ѡ҃ставила є́си м҃ати · и҆ себе примѣсила є́си посрѣдѣ мꙋжи · и҆ ѡ҆бь роучника вреденнаго не радивши :~ к҃ѕ · Преставленіе ст҃го ап҃ла · н єѵлнста іѡ҃а бо гослова · праꙁнꙋємь ве днь · пѣніекъсено щное · поємь ст҃ры на и҃ · гл҃а а҃ · по̑ н ебе сныихъ чиномь · сл҃а гл҃а в҃ · сп҃а громова і ны б҃ · пренде с тѣнь · выхо̑ пр҃о д҃невныі н чтен г҃ · ѡ̈ съборнаго посланіа іѡаннова · Въꙁлюбленіи а́ще ср҃дце ваше · Въꙁлюбле

items.english_text: *Troparion:* In thee, O mother Euphrosyne, was preserved with certainty that which is according to the image: for taking up the cross, thou didst follow Christ, and by thy deeds didst teach us to overlook the flesh, for it passes away, and to care for the soul, a thing immortal; therefore, O venerable one, thy spirit rejoices with the angels!

items.section: ...and if anyone [say]: thus indeed 13 readings. Then the ectenia: "Let us all say", and "Vouchsafe, O Lord"; then the completion of evening prayers. Then we go out into the narthex, singing the samoglasny stichera of Tone 1: "Rivers of theology", "Manifesting purity", "Disciple of the Savior", "He who ineffably"; and 2 of Tone 2: "He who...", "Apostle and Theologian"; Tone 4: "Leaning back..."; Both now, Theotokion. And we enter into the church, singing the stichera that are at the Aposticha, with the verses: "Their sound is gone out into all the earth" [LXX Ps. 18:5]; Verse: "The heavens declare the glory of God" [LXX Ps. 18:2]. Glory, Tone 6: "O apostle of Christ, evangelist..."; Both now, Theotokion. Troparion, Tone 2:*[^225]

items.day_or_date: On the 26th day: The Falling-Asleep of the Holy Apostle and Evangelist John the Theologian. We celebrate the great day. All-Night Vigil. We sing stichera on 8, Tone 1, Podoben: "Joy of the Heavenly Ranks" (Небесных чинов): Glory, Tone 2: "Son of Thunder"; Both now, Theotokion: "The shadow of the Law has passed away"; Entrance, prokeimenon of the day, and 3 readings from the Catholic Epistle of John: "Beloved, if our heart condemn us not..." [1 Jn. 3:21–4:6]; "Beloved, [if God so loved us, we ought also to love one another]..." [1 Jn. 4:11–16]; "Beloved, [if a man say, I love God, and hates his brother, he is a liar]..." [1 Jn. 4:20–5:5].

items.slavonic_text: Подобаеть вѣдати · ꙗ́ко сице праꙁноуємы въвсѧ праꙁникы въ ꙗ́же быеть пѣньа въсенощнаа · на лѵ̄ ѡ̈ ка пѣ г҃ и҆ ѕ҃ · пр҃о · гл҃а и҃ · Въ въсю ꙁемлю · с҃ · нб҃са повѣдают а́пль ѡ̈ съборного посланіа іѡ́а · Бр҃іа б҃а никтоже · а́ллуа и́сповѣдать нб҃са · с҃ · б҃ъ прославлꙗетсѧ · єѵе іі н҃а въꙁдвиже нье · к҃ ꙁачалѣ · ѡ̈ іѡ́а · въ ѡ́ вре стоꙗ хꙋ при кр҃тѣ · к҃ѣ въ · въ въсꙗ ꙁемлꙗ и́ꙁыдош · к҃ꙁ · Ст҃го мч҃нка · калистрата · и́ и́же съ ннмь · на гн҃ въꙁва · ст҃а ст҃го гл҃а д҃ · самогласны прѣчт҃наго кр҃та ти · і ны · б҃ · тр҃о мч҃нкы твои гн҃ · на оу̑ по ѕ҃ пѣ ко̑ гл҃а д҃ ꙗ́ви сѧ · Многоѡ́браꙁныꙗ раны претерпѣвше · и́ вѣ нца ѡ҃ б҃а приє́мши ѡ́ надлите сѧ бл҃женін · памѧть всепраꙁденьственоую ва съвръша ющи · великыи калистрате хв҃и сострадлци дла моли сѧ · оу҆мирити пастьвоу и́ люди · ты бо є́си вѣрныимь оу҆твръжденіе :~

provenance.verbatim_source:

Having endured manifold wounds and received crowns from God, intercede, O blessed ones, for those who celebrate your all-festal memory: O great Callistratus and fellow-sufferers of Christ, pray that He pacify the flock and people; for ye are the confirmation of the faithful!

items.english_text: *Troparion:* A dweller of the wilderness and an angel in the flesh, and a wonderworker wast thou shown forth, O our God-bearing father Cyriacus: having received heavenly gifts through fasting, vigilance, and prayers, thou healest the sick and the souls of those who in faith flee unto thee! Glory to Him Who gave thee strength! Glory to Him Who crowned thee! Glory to Him Who works healing for all through thee!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*  
A dweller of the wilderness and an angel in the flesh, and a wonderworker wast thou shown forth, O our God-bearing father Cyriacus: having received heavenly gifts through fasting, vigilance, and prayers, thou healest the sick and the souls of those who in faith flee unto thee! Glory to Him Who gave thee strength! Glory to Him Who crowned thee! Glory to Him Who works healing for all through thee!

Zealously suffering for Christ, thou didst endure all manner of afflictions, O hieromartyr Gregory; blood added unto blood was preserved undefiled like precious gold, as thou sangest the hymn marvelously: "God is with me, and no one else is against me!"

items.day_or_date: On the 1st day: The Protection of the Most Holy Theotokos, and the Holy Apostle Ananias, and our Venerable Father Romanus the Melodist. We celebrate all day. All-Night Vigil, if the igumen wills. At Vespers: "Blessed is the man". At "Lord, I have cried", we sing 10 stichera: of the Theotokos, 3 prosomoia on 4; and of the Apostle, 3; and of Romanus, 3; Glory, of the Apostle; Both now, of the Protection. Entrance; prokeimenon of the day; and 3 readings of the Theotokos. Ectenia. At the Litiya, stichera of the Protection which are [appointed].
items.slavonic_text: и на стиховнѣ · покровоу · гл҃а · в҃ · г҃ · и́ а́постолоу · самогласень · гл҃а · и҃ · съ стихомь · в въсꙗ ꙁемлꙗ · съсоудан ꙁбраннаго · с ла́ · р оманоу · и́ нн҃ѣ · по кровоу · т ропарь · а́ постоле ст҃ыи · с ла́ · Ѡ тебѣ ѡ҃че романе · и҆ꙁвѣстьно спасенноую бысть ѡ҃браꙁъ , приємъ бо кр҃стъ въслѣ довалъ еси хр҃тоу · твора и́ оу҆чаше · еже пре ꙁирати плътъ · мимоходитъ бо · приле жати же доуши ве щии бессм҃ртнѣи · тѣ мь съ а́г҃глы радоуетсѧ д҃хъ твои :~ і ны покровоу · Д н҃ь благовѣрнии людье · свѣтло праꙁноуемь ѡ҃сѣнꙗеми твоимь бг҃о мати пришествіемь · и́ къ тво́емоу въ ꙁирающе прѣчистомоу ѡ҆́браꙁоу · оу҆мили но глемь , покрыи насъ чьстныимь си покро вомь · и́ и́ꙁбави насъ ѡ҃ въсѣкого ꙁла · мо лѧщи сина си х҃а б҃а нашего · спасти доуша наша :~ и на оу҆трьни · т ропа̄ · п окровоу ·

items.english_text: *Troparion:* In thee, O father Romanus, was preserved with certainty that which is according to the image; for taking up the cross, thou didst follow Christ, and by thy deeds didst teach us to overlook the flesh, for it passes away, and to care for the soul, a thing immortal; therefore, thy spirit rejoices with the angels!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*  
In thee, O father Romanus, was preserved with certainty that which is according to the image; for taking up the cross, thou didst follow Christ, and by thy deeds didst teach us to overlook the flesh, for it passes away, and to care for the soul, a thing immortal; therefore, thy spirit rejoices with the angels!

items.english_text: *Exapostilarion of the Theotokos, and of the Apostle. At the Praises: of the Protection, 3 prosomoia on 4, Tone 8; Glory, Both now: samoglasen of the Protection; Great Doxology. After the Trisagion, Troparion of the Protection; ectenia, dismissal. At the Liturgy: from the canons, Ode 3 of the Protection on 4, and of the Apostle Ode 6 on 4; Prokeimenon, canticle of the Theotokos: "My soul doth magnify the Lord" [Lk. 1:46]; Verse: "For He hath regarded the lowliness of His handmaiden" [Lk. 1:48]. Of the Apostle: "Into all the earth is their sound gone out" [LXX Ps. 18:5]. The Epistle of the Protection: "Brethren, the first tabernacle had..." [Heb. 9:1–7, pericope 320]; if it be the primary church [of the Apostle], the Epistle: on Friday of the 3rd week after Pascha, from the half [Acts 8:26–39, pericope 21]. Alleluia: "Unto Thy countenance shall make supplication the rich among the people" [LXX Ps. 44:13]; Verse: "The heavens shall confess Thy wonders, O Lord" [LXX Ps. 88:6]. Gospel from Luke, pericope 54: "Jesus entered into a certain village..." [Lk. 10:38–42; 11:27–28]; of the Apostle, from [Luke, pericope 51]: "He that hears you..." [Lk. 10:16–21]. Communion verse: "I will take the cup of salvation" [LXX Ps. 115:4], and the other: "Into all the earth is their sound gone out" [LXX Ps. 18:5].*

items.english_text: *Kontakion:* Having passed through the heavenly gates in the spirit, and having been instructed by him that ascended unto the third heaven, O Dionysius, thou didst enrich all understanding with ineffable mysteries, and didst illumine them that sat in the darkness of ignorance; therefore we cry unto thee: Rejoice, O father of the whole world!

items.english_text: *Kontakion:* As an unshakable pillar, O Hierotheus, thou wast not terrified by the threats of the enemy, but didst destroy the fortress of delusion, appearing as a precious stone, O father; therefore the Master, seeing thee as His servant, crowns thee with His life-originating right hand: entreat Him for all of us!

items.slavonic_text: наполненъ хв҃ъ а́пле · и́ слоужитель и́сти ннѣ покаꙗніель въꙁпитыи еси въ бъдонїгѣ · на хва̄ самогл҃н · на д҃ є́дн гл҃а · послѣ довалъ еси · и́ в҃ · д҃ го · р аꙁоумоу бж҃твы номоу · оу҆́дицею глꙋбинноу · с ла гл҃ ѕ · в ъброна добро · н а лѵ̄р ѡ̈ ка̄ · п ѣ г҃ · и́ ѕ · п ро г л҃а и҃ · в ъвсю ꙁемлꙗ · с҃ · н б҃са повѣда · а́ пль н҃е · г҃ · а́ ллуа · И́ сповѣдають нб҃са · е ѵ́е ѡ̈ іѡ́а · ѡ̈ оу҆трнее · к҃ѣ в въсꙗ ꙁемлю С тыхь мч҃никь сергѣꙗ · и́ вакха · в҃е с҃тры н а ѕ · г л҃а ѕ · с ергіи · И́ вакхъ · н а стї ѡ̈ · с ла̄ с҃т · і н҃ы · б҃ · т ро̄ г л҃а · є҃ · О у́добреніе хв҃ы стратотр҃пець · ѡ҃чи хв҃ѣ цр҃кви · ѡ҃чи просвѣтита дшь наши · сергіе многостр҃ть не · и́ вакхе преславне · ꙗ́ко да оу҆бѣжимь тъмы грѣховныꙗ · и́ свѣта ꙗ́виве м ѡ҆́бе щинници невечернꙗго · мл҃твами ваю ст҃аꙗ :~ н а оу҆рни · к а́нѡ ѡ̈ · с ты · н а ѕ · п о ѕ п ѣѣ · к ҃о г ла̄ в҃ · в ышии · О у́дльна врагы моу
items.english_text: *Kontakion:* Having armed the mind against enemies manfully *...ye destroyed all their deceit and received victory from on high, O all-lauded martyrs, crying with one mind: "It is good and beautiful to be with God!"*[^239]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Kontakion:*  
Having armed the mind against enemies manfully...
*...ye destroyed all their deceit and received victory from on high, O all-lauded martyrs, crying with one mind: "It is good and beautiful to be with God!"*[^239]

items.slavonic_text: жескь въѡ҃роуживше · и́ всю и́хь лесть ра ꙁдроушиста и́ побѣдоу съвыше приємши · мч҃нци въсехвалніи · единомыслено въпи юще добро и́ красиво є́же быти съ бг҃мь :~ н а х ва̄ с амогл҃ны д҃ г л҃а и́ г л҃ г҃ · с л҃ г л҃ в҃ · и́ н҃ы б҃ · н а стїхѡ · с ла̄ с ты і н҃ы б҃ · н а лѵ̄ п ро̄ с тымь и́же сж · с҃ · прѣꙁрѣхъ га̄ · а́ пл н҃е к҃ · к҃ в҃ · ст҃ы · а́ ллуа · с е коль добро · е ѵ́е · ѡ̈ лоукы · в ъ вто к҃і н҃е · к҃ѣ в ъпамѧть П рѣподобныꙗ м҃три нашеꙗ пелагіи · и́же въ а́нтиѡхіи · а́ллуна · в ечерь · с тры г҃ · в ъс҃ · с тыꙗ г҃ · с л҃ г л҃ д҃ · И́ де же оу҆мно жисѧ · и́ нн҃ѣ б҃ · н а стїхѡ · и́ т ро · Ѡ тебѣ м ати с е̄ · к҃е · н а оу҆рни · к анѡ · ѡ̈ · с тыа н а д҃ · п о ѕ · п ѣ к ҃о г л҃а в҃ · Т ѣло свое по щеніель и́стонивши · неѡ҃усыпанныими мо литвами · ѕижителꙗ мл҃ꙗше грѣха ради своего да пріе́мьше съвръшено е прощеніе · и́ пріѡ҃ставленіе · и҆ покааніа покаꙁавши :~
items.english_text: *Kontakion:* Having wasted thy body with fasting, with sleepless prayers thou didst entreat the Creator for the sake of thy sin, that having received complete forgiveness, thou mightest obtain remission, having shown forth repentance!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Kontakion:*  
Having wasted thy body with fasting, with sleepless prayers thou didst entreat the Creator for the sake of thy sin, that having received complete forgiveness, thou mightest obtain remission, having shown forth repentance!

items.slavonic_text: ѳ҃ · Ст҃го ап҃ла · іакова алфеева · и прпⷣбнаго ѡц҃а андроника · празнꙿ ве̇ днь · в҃ ст҃ры ст҃го · на ѕ҃ · сла́ · гл҃ · д҃ · Иже бж҃ітвънаго дх҃а · и нн҃ы · бц҃ю · на ст҃нѡвѣ · сла́ · гла · є҃ · Вѣрно тръжествоуемь · и нн҃ы · бц҃а · тро́ · Ап҃ле ст҃ыи · сла́ · Поустынныи житель · і єко́ · на оутрⷩ · кано́ ѿ · и ст҃ы на и҃ · по ѕ҃ · пѣ́ · ко́ · гла́ · д҃ · *Кондакъ:* Оу́дицею ловѧжьѧ · рыбы оу́ловилъ єси словесныя · и си принеслъ єси начаткы бг҃оу нашему · и въ х҃вы раны въжделѣ ѡблектисѧ · подобникъ стрⷭ҇тнемь єго показасѧ · тѣмь съшєдшесѧ почитаємь · ап҃ле іакове · въсепразденьственоуютвою памѧть · и съгласно въпїемь · моли х҃а бг҃а ѡ вьсѣхъ насъ :~ на лт҃у · ѿ ка пѣ́ · г҃ · и ѕ҃ · про́ · въ въсѧ землѧ · ст҃и · Нб҃са повѣдають · а҃пль · не́ · і҃ · аллугїа́ · Исповѣдають нб҃са · еѵ҃лїе · ѿ лоу́ · н҃а · Слоушаꙗ · кѣ́ · въ въсѧ землѧ изыдѡ ·

items.english_text: *Kontakion:* O angler who catchest fish, thou didst catch spiritual fish, and broughtest these first-fruits unto our God; and desiring to be clothed in the wounds of Christ, thou wast shown forth as an imitator of His Sufferings; therefore, having come together, we honor, O Apostle James, thy most festive memory, and cry out with one accord: "Entreat Christ God for all of us!"

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Kontakion:*  
O angler who catchest fish, thou didst catch spiritual fish, and broughtest these first-fruits unto our God; and desiring to be clothed in the wounds of Christ, thou wast shown forth as an imitator of His Sufferings; therefore, having come together, we honor, O Apostle James, thy most festive memory, and cry out with one accord: "Entreat Christ God for all of us!"

items.slavonic_text: [С]тыхъ мч҃нкъ · євлампиꙗ · и євлампїи · і҃ · аллугїа · тр҃о Мч҃нци твои гн҃и · по ѕ҃ · пѣ́ ко́ гла́ г҃ · *Кондакъ:* Доблѧѧ мч҃нкы · и брⷶа по плъти мѫдраго євлампиꙗ и євлампїю почитаєсна, бо беззаконныхъ кознодѣиство посрамиша силою крⷭ҇тною · сего ради ꙗвишасѧ мч҃нкомъ слава · коупно же и похвала :~ Ст҃го ап҃ла, филипа єдиного · ѿ · ꙁ҃ · диꙗконъ · а҃і · и прпⷣбнаго ѡц҃а нашего · фео́фана исповѣдника · и творца канономъ · єпⷭ҇па никеискаго · вечерь · ст҃ры · ст҃ы · на ѕ҃ · на стихо́ ѿ · тро́ · Ап҃ле ст҃ыи · слава гла́ и҃ · *Тропарь:* Правовѣрїю наставниче · и бл҃гочтїю оу́чителю · и чистотѣ · въселенѣи свѣтилниче, инокоующымъ бг҃одх҃овьное оу́добрение · феѡ́фане мѫдре · оу́ченьи своими вьсѣхъ просвѣтилъ єси · цѣвнице дх҃овнаꙗ моли х҃а бг҃а сп҃стисѧ дш҃амь нашимъ :~ на оу҃рн· канонъ · къ ѿ · на ѕ҃ · и ст҃ыхь · на и҃ ·

items.slavonic_text: [С]тыхъ мч҃нкъ · євлампиꙗ · и євлампїи · і҃ · аллугїа · тр҃о Мч҃нци твои гн҃и · по ѕ҃ · пѣ́ ко́ гла́ г҃ · *Кондакъ:* Доблѧѧ мч҃нкы · и брⷶа по плъти мѫдраго євлампиꙗ и євлампїю почитаєсна, бо беззаконныхъ кознодѣиство посрамиша силою крⷭ҇тною · сего ради ꙗвишасѧ мч҃нкомъ слава · коупно же и похвала :~ Ст҃го ап҃ла, филипа єдиного · ѿ · ꙁ҃ · диꙗконъ · а҃і · и прпⷣбнаго ѡц҃а нашего · фео́фана исповѣдника · и творца канономъ · єпⷭ҇па никеискаго · вечерь · ст҃ры · ст҃ы · на ѕ҃ · на стихо́ ѿ · тро́ · Ап҃ле ст҃ыи · слава гла́ и҃ · *Тропарь:* Правовѣрїю наставниче · и бл҃гочтїю оу́чителю · и чистотѣ · въселенѣи свѣтилниче, инокоующымъ бг҃одх҃овьное оу́добрение · феѡ́фане мѫдре · оу́ченьи своими вьсѣхъ просвѣтилъ єси · цѣвнице дх҃овнаꙗ моли х҃а бг҃а сп҃стисѧ дш҃амь нашимъ :~ на оу҃рн· канонъ · къ ѿ · на ѕ҃ · и ст҃ыхь · на и҃ ·
items.english_text: *Kontakion:* Let us honor the noble martyrs and brother and sister according to the flesh, the wise Eulampius and Eulampia; for they put to shame the crafty scheming of the lawless by the power of the Cross; therefore they were revealed as the glory and together the praise of martyrs!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Kontakion:*  
Let us honor the noble martyrs and brother and sister according to the flesh, the wise Eulampius and Eulampia; for they put to shame the crafty scheming of the lawless by the power of the Cross; therefore they were revealed as the glory and together the praise of martyrs!

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.english_text: *Kontakion:* *After Ode 3, Kontakion [of St. Theophanes], Tone 2:*[^242] Having thundered forth Christ's Divine Incarnation, thou didst utterly expose the bodiless enemies, O marvelous Theophanes; therefore we faithfully and piously sing unto thee, as thou entreatest unceasingly for all of us!

items.english_text: *It is fitting to know that on the coming Sunday following the memory of the holy apostle, we celebrate the memory of the holy Fathers of the Seventh Ecumenical Council, who assembled in Nicaea for the second time, against the accursed and godless-confessing, Christ-hating and Christian-reproaching iconoclasts, our venerable fathers, and the bishops who suffered together with them. We follow the sequence of the Seventh...* *...Council together with the Resurrection [hymns of the Octoechos].*[^243]

items.slavonic_text: *...бора съ въскрьсьными :~* Стыхъ моученникъ провъ · тархъ · и андроника · в҃і · вечерь · ст҃ры · г҃ ѿ · и ст҃ыхь · г҃ · сла́ · гла́ · д҃ · Воиньствовавше х҃о · на стиховнѣ ѿ · сла́ ст҃ыхь гла́ а҃ · і нн҃ѣ бц҃ · тро́ · гла́ · є҃ · *Тропарь:* Стыхъ моученникь исправленїю небесныꙗ силы преоу́дивишасѧ · како въ тѣлѣ мрътвенѣмь · бесплътныꙗ врагы силою крътъною подвигьшесѧ добрѣ · побѣдиша невидомо · и молѧтсѧ гв҃и помиловати дша наша :~ слава гла́ и҃ · Правовѣрїю · ѻ҃ · а҃і · на оу́трени · канонъ къ ѿ · и ст҃ыхь · на д҃ · по ѕ҃ · пѣ́ · кѡ́ · гла́ · в҃ · *Кондакъ:* Троица намь славоу проꙗвльше · доблествениі хв҃и къ ѡ́роужници · и моучеци · стархоѡмь · провь же и андроникь · ѡбличивьше прельсть въсемоучителей безбожие · вѣрою крѣпько страдавьше :~ На литоургїи · про́ · гла́ д҃ ·
items.english_text: *Troparion:* At the achievements of the holy martyrs the heavenly hosts marveled greatly: how in a mortal body, having striven valiantly by the power of the Cross, they invisibly conquered the bodiless enemies, and they entreat the Lord to have mercy upon our souls!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*  
At the achievements of the holy martyrs the heavenly hosts marveled greatly: how in a mortal body, having striven valiantly by the power of the Cross, they invisibly conquered the bodiless enemies, and they entreat the Lord to have mercy upon our souls!

items.english_text: *Kontakion:* As a most precious treasure from the Master and an unfading lily, your relics pour forth streams of healings unto them that are upon the earth, cleansing infirmities and various passions, and granting grace abundantly unto souls; therefore with love we celebrate with one accord your solemnity, O divine martyrs!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Kontakion:*  
As a most precious treasure from the Master and an unfading lily, your relics pour forth streams of healings unto them that are upon the earth, cleansing infirmities and various passions, and granting grace abundantly unto souls; therefore with love we celebrate with one accord your solemnity, O divine martyrs!

items.english_text: *Kontakion:* Having acquired her as an intercessor in afflictions, let us piously hymn the holy Paraskeva; for having forsaken this life, she received that which is incorruptible unto the ages; therefore she found glory in miracles and grace by the divine commandment!

items.english_text: *Kontakion:* *Kontakion [of St. Euthymius], Tone 2:*[^246] Passing blamelessly through the multitude of tempests, by the streams of thy tears thou didst drown the bodiless enemies, O God-wise Euthymius, venerable one, and having received the gift of miracles, entreat unceasingly for all of us!

items.slavonic_text: ...нима мечемь вѣры · и ѡбоюдꙋ вѣнчися ѡ[т] бг҃а прпⷣбнемч҃нче андрѣю ѡ́тче нашъ :~ по ѕ҃ · пѣ́ ко́ гла́ и҃ · *Кондакъ:* Мѫжьствоу тезоименитомоу бл҃годаренію · ꙗко бл҃гочтїꙗ таиноглавьникоу · похваленіи възовемь къ бг҃у · ѡ таинныхь лютыхь спасеніа · да поємь ти радоуисѧ ѡ́ч҃е прⷭ҇нопамѧтне :~ С҃того ап҃ла · и еѵ҃листа лоукы · празнꙿ ве́ днь · и҃і · вечерь · ст҃ры · на ѕ҃ · сла́ гла́ и҃ · Ап҃ле хв҃ь · и нынѣ · бц҃ю · на стиховнѣ · ѡ́ · сла́ гла́ ѕ҃ · въсемѫдре · і ны б҃ тро́ гл҃ є҃ · *Тропарь:* Ап҃льскыхь дѣꙗніи сказателꙗ · и еѵ҃лїю хв҃оу свѣтла списателꙗ · лоукѫ прелѣпаго · инеиписана соущихъ въ цр҃кви · пѣсни сщ҃еныими · ст҃го ап҃ла похвалимь · ꙗко врача соуща чловѣчьскыꙗ немощи · є́ства и недоугы · иꙗзвы дш҃и исцѣлѧюща · и молѧщасѧ непрестанно за дш҃а нш҃а :~ на оу҃ ка̃ с то на ѕ҃ · по ѕ҃ · пѣ́ ко́ гл҃ в҃ · Тврьды...
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The narrator of the Acts of the Apostles, and the radiant writer of Christ's Gospel, Luke most fair, who depicted those things unwritten that belong to the Church: with sacred songs let us praise the holy apostle, as being a physician of human weaknesses, healing the ailments of nature and the wounds of the soul, and praying unceasingly for our souls!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*  
The narrator of the Acts of the Apostles, and the radiant writer of Christ's Gospel, Luke most fair, who depicted those things unwritten that belong to the Church: with sacred songs let us praise the holy apostle, as being a physician of human weaknesses, healing the ailments of nature and the wounds of the soul, and praying unceasingly for our souls!

items.slavonic_text: *Кондакъ:* ...истиннаго бл҃гочⷭ҇тїю проповѣдника · и таинаго неизреченныи вѣтїю · звѣздоу цр҃ковноую лоукѫ бж҃твьна въсхвалимь · слово бо єго избра съ павлѡмь мѫдры ꙗзыкѡ оу́чителꙗ · единь свѣдыи сердьце нашѧ :~ на хва́ · а҃ пл҃з · на д҃ · гл҃а д҃ · с ъстихѡ́ Въ всю землю · сла́ гл҃ и҃ · Приди всѧ тва · і ны б҃ · на ст҃нѡ́ · сла́ д Вдьскыє съше́ше с̃ · і ны б҃ · на лу҃ргїн ѿ ка пѣ́ г҃ и ѕ҃ · пр̃о · гла́ д҃ · въ всю землю · ст҃ · нб҃са повѣдаю · а҃пль · ѻ̃ · н҃і · аллоуиа · и сповѣдаꙗт нб҃са · еѵ҃лїе ѿ лоу́ слоушаꙗ ва · к̃ѣ в въсю зе · С҃тго прр҃ка · иѡила · и ст҃го мч҃ника · оу́ара · ѳ҃і · и ст҃го сщ҃енномч҃нка · садофа · и с нимь · р҃ · к҃ · и · и҃ · мѫчени́к при сапори цр҃и · в персѣ · Егда же моучиль ст҃лъ хв҃ы тыи садофь · тогда рече, к броуюкоу мо́емоу · ꙗко хр҃тїане, имѧть зъвзѧти лющн моꙗ · н иже аще призоветь бг҃а · имене мо́его ради · сп҃сенїе ѡ́...
items.english_text: *Kontakion:* ...preacher of true piety, and an orator of ineffable mysteries, the star of the Church, let us praise the divine Luke; for the Word, Who alone knows our hearts, chose him together with Paul, the teacher of the wise nations![^248]

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.slavonic_text: ...брѧщеть · Въ то́ днь · великаго ѡ́ц҃а нашего іѡ́а рыльскаго · садофу · тр҃о гл҃ д҃ · И нравом причастник · іѡ́а тр҃о гл҃ а҃ · *Тропарь:* Покаꙗнїа основанїе · прописанїе оу́миленїа ѡ́бразь оу́тѣшенїа · дх҃внаго совершенїа · точно аг҃гломь житїе твое бы прпⷣбне · въ млт҃вахъ оу́бо и пощенїи · и въ слъза̃ прѣбываꙗ · ѡ́ч҃е іѡ́анне мл҃и х҃а бг҃а ѡ дшахь нашихъ :~ садофоу · кѡ́ гл҃а д҃ · *Кондакъ:* В лїню реченїю, оу́сердно къ подобыствѣ послѣдова · ꙗко оу́бо пастырь добрыи · дш҃ѫ свою положилъ єси за хв҃ы ѡ́вца · сщ҃енномч҃нче садофе · молититꙗ мнѡгострадалне · моли пастырельначалника х҃а · и на причести деснаго ѡ́вець стоꙗнїа · давъпїемъ ти · радоуисѧ сщ҃енныи ѡ́ч҃е садофе · иже за х҃а кровь свою излиавыи :~ іѡ́анно ко́ гл҃а и҃ · *Кондакъ:* Аг҃гльскомꙋ житїю поревновавь прпⷣбне · и вьсѧ земнаꙗ ѡ́ставивь · и къ х҃оу прите...
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Foundation of repentance, model of compunction, image of consolation, of spiritual perfection: thy life was truly like unto that of the angels, O venerable one; abiding in prayers, in fasting, and in tears, O father John: entreat Christ God for our souls!

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.english_text: *Kontakion:* *Kontakion of Sadoth, Tone 4:* Zealously following in imitation of the Master's teaching, as a good shepherd thou laidest down thy life for the sheep of Christ, O hieromartyr Sadoth; we pray thee, O much-suffering one: entreat Christ the Chief Shepherd, and number us also among the sheep standing on His right hand, that we may cry unto thee: Rejoice, O holy father Sadoth, who didst pour out thy blood for Christ!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Kontakion of Sadoth, Tone 4:*  
*Kontakion:*  
Zealously following in imitation of the Master's teaching, as a good shepherd thou laidest down thy life for the sheep of Christ, O hieromartyr Sadoth; we pray thee, O much-suffering one: entreat Christ the Chief Shepherd, and number us also among the sheep standing on His right hand, that we may cry unto thee: Rejoice, O holy father Sadoth, who didst pour out thy blood for Christ!

items.slavonic_text: кль еси · и того заповѣдьми огражаема · и явися стлъпъ непоколѣблемын · вражии нападеніи · тѣмь зовем ти радуися ѡ́че іѡанне · свѣтило пресвѣтлое :~ С҃тго вели комч҃нка · артемиꙗ · вечерь · стры · на ѕ҃ сла гл҃а в҃ · разумнаго свѣта · і ны б҃о · на стн · ѡ · сла і ны б҃о · тро мч҃нкъ твои на оутрьни · каны · ѡ · и с҃тго на ѕ҃ · по ѕ҃ пѣ ко҃ гла в҃ · бл҃гочтнаго, и вѣнценось наго · иженаврагы въсприимша побѣды · съшедшеся д҃ховно · похвалимь, артемиꙗ оуч҃ника блг҃ти · и чудесемь подателꙗ ѡби лнаго · молит бо ся г҃ви ѡ всѣхъ нас :~ на лургіи · ѡ ка · пѣ г҃ и ѕ҃ · про гла д҃ · въ звеселится · апль · сѫбота · а҃ · по · аллуа праведникъ ꙗко · еѵе ѡ іѡа · сѫбота г҃ · по па · к҃в · Въ к҃а · память · прпбⷣнаго ѡц҃а нше го · ілариѡна великаго · празднуе весь днь · вечерь · стры · с҃тго на ѕ҃ · сла гла в҃ · ѡ оу́
items.english_text: *Kontakion:* Gathering together spiritually, let us praise Artemius, the pious and crown-bearing one, who took up victories over the enemies, the disciple of grace and bountiful giver of miracles; for he prays unto the Lord for all of us!

provenance.verbatim_source:

Gathering together spiritually, let us praise Artemius, the pious and crown-bearing one, who took up victories over the enemies, the disciple of grace and bountiful giver of miracles; for he prays unto the Lord for all of us!

items.english_text: *Kontakion:* *After Ode 6, Kontakion [of the Hierarch], Tone 8:* As a great sun and companion of the Apostles, the Church of all the faithful glorifies thee, O Abercius; which do thou preserve, O blessed one, by thy prayers, invincible and untroubled by any heresies, and undefiled, O much-suffering one!

Having striven valiantly from infancy, O Marcian with wise Martyrius, ye cast down the apostate Arius, preserving the Orthodox faith undefiled...
...following Paul the good teacher; therefore with him ye have found life, as chosen champions of the Trinity![^255]

items.english_text: *Troparion:* A great helper in dangers hath the universe found thee, O passion-bearer, who vanquishest the heathen; for as thou didst cast down the pride of Lyaeus, and didst strengthen Nestor at the tribunal, so, O holy Demetrius, entreat Christ God to grant unto us great mercy!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*  
A great helper in dangers hath the universe found thee, O passion-bearer, who vanquishest the heathen; for as thou didst cast down the pride of Lyaeus, and didst strengthen Nestor at the tribunal, so, O holy Demetrius, entreat Christ God to grant unto us great mercy!

*Kontakion:*  
In the flesh as one bodiless thou wast revealed upon the earth, planted like a tree by the waters of abstinence, flourishing by the flow of thy tears, washing away defilement; therefore thou wast shown forth, O Abramius, as a dwelling of the Divine Spirit!

items.english_text: *Kontakion:* The beacons of truth and heralds of piety the pair let us worthily praise with songs: Zenobius together with the like-minded Zenobia, who lived together, and therefore received the incorruptible crown of martyrdom![^258]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Kontakion:*  
The beacons of truth and heralds of piety...
...the pair let us worthily praise with songs: Zenobius together with the like-minded Zenobia, who lived together, and therefore received the incorruptible crown of martyrdom![^258]

items.english_text: *Kontakion:* As all-sacred vessels of the All-Holy Spirit and rays of the Sun of glory, let us dutifully hymn the wise apostles: Apelles, Urban, Aristobulus, Amplias, Stachys, and Narcissus, and the others, whom the grace of our God assembled!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Kontakion:*  
As all-sacred vessels of the All-Holy Spirit and rays of the Sun of glory, let us dutifully hymn the wise apostles: Apelles, Urban, Aristobulus, Amplias, Stachys, and Narcissus, and the others, whom the grace of our God assembled!

items.slavonic_text: сла ѡ́ всегда имаще х҃а · і ны · б҃ · тро гл҃ и҃ · С҃тіи кезсребрьници · и чюдотворци · козма и даміань по:ѣтите немощи наша · тоуне приꙗсте · тоуне и дадита :~ на оу҃ ка ѡ҃ · и с҃т на ѕ҃ · по ѕ҃ · пѣ ко҃ гл҃ в҃ по Твръдыꙗ · Иже блг҃ть приємьше исцѣленіи простирае те здавье колѣщімь врачеве · и чютворци сла вніи · но вашим посещеніе · незпостата · ѡпо лченіа, низложисте · мир а исцѣлѣющи чю десы · на хва стры с на д сл г д источи · і н б на стн · т сл г н і н б на лу ѡ ка пѣ г и ѕ про стыим же сѫ стн прѣзрѣ апль · въ коун · брати вы есте тѣло хво · аллуиа · гла в · се коли добро · еѵе по оно времꙗ призва іс · к҃в · вопаліа · С҃тыхь мч҃нкь · акындина · и пигасьꙗ · афѳоніа · елпиди фора · и анподмета · верь стры сты на ѕ сла гла ѕ · днь патериць · і н б на стн ѡ сл гл в · пртек възрауелся · і н б тро г и

items.slavonic_text: С҃трастотръпци гн҃и · бл҃жена ꙗже землꙗ напи вшая кръви ваша · с҃ти и хранилища прїємь ше тѣлеса ваша · на сѫдищи бо врага ѡбли чисте · и х҃а съ дръзновеніемь проповѣда сте · того ꙗко бл҃га молите сп҃сти молимъвы д҃ша наша :~ на оу҃трни к҃аны · ѡ҃ · на ѕ҃ · по ѕ҃ · пѣ ко҃ гл҃а в҃ · Бл҃гочъстивыꙗ и б҃о носныꙗ мч҃нкы на землѣ оставльше всꙗ ческаꙗ · и прїꙗтыхъ въ наслаженіе бл҃гы твоихъ покоꙗ · акендина · и пигасьꙗ · анє мподиста · съ нимиже и афѳоніа · и елпи дифора · єдинь бо єси бл҃гооувѣтливы :~ на лутоургіи · про с҃тыимь иже сѫть · с҃тн прѣзрѣ · а҃пль к҃ꙁ · н҃е · а҃луа · възъзваша праведнїи · єѵлїе · ѡ лоу в ъкто к҃і · н҃е · к҃в радоуите сꙗ · С҃тыхь мч҃нкъ, акеѱи мы · еппа · и ѡсифа презвитера · и аифала дьꙗкона · и с҃тго мч҃нка · геѡрга · сщ҃енье цр҃кви · иже в лидѣ · идеже положено с҃тое
items.english_text: *Troparion:* O passion-bearers of the Lord, blessed is the earth that drank your blood, and holy are the dwellings that received your bodies; for at the tribunal ye exposed the enemy, and proclaimed Christ with boldness; Him, as He is good, pray to save our souls, we beseech you![^260]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*  
O passion-bearers of the Lord, blessed is the earth that drank your blood, and holy are the dwellings that received your bodies; for at the tribunal ye exposed the enemy, and proclaimed Christ with boldness; Him, as He is good, pray to save our souls, we beseech you![^260]

provenance.verbatim_source:

A bright luminary hast thou appeared, shining in the world and illuminating in the darkness of passions, and a mighty physician wast thou shown to be, granting healing unto them that ask grace of healings, that we may cry unto thee: Rejoice, O father Joannicius!

items.slavonic_text: і н҃б · тро гл҃а г҃ · Бж҃їꙗ вѣрѣ исповѣданіе · иного тꙗ павла · цр҃кви ревнительꙗ · въ сщ҃е нныихъ ꙗвиль єси · въпїеть с тобою и авель къ г҃оу · и захарьина кровь правднаго · ѡ́ч҃е прпⷣбне х҃а б҃а моли · даровати намь веліꙗ мл҃ть :~ на оу҃ к҃ ѡ҃ · с҃ты на ѕ҃ · по ѕ҃ · пѣ ко҃ гл҃а в҃ · В ъзсиꙗвы на землї ꙗко звѣзда б҃освѣтлаꙗ · съборную просвѣщаеши цр҃ко вь · за нюже пострада · и д҃шю свою павле по ложивы · ꙗко захарьина · и авелева ꙗсно вопіе кровь твоꙗ къ г҃оу :~ на стн ѡ҃ гл҃а с҃ · чтна пре г҃дль · и поетсꙗ сл҃а гл҃о г҃ ѕ҃ · прпⷣбне ѡ́ · сл҃ г҃ ꙁ · і н҃ б · на лу҃ ѡ ка пѣ г҃ и ѕ҃ про въ схвалꙗтсꙗ · с҃ти въспоите г҃ви · а҃пль н҃е г҃ по а҃ луа г҃ к҃і · єрен твои · єѵе ѡ лу в нл҃а ѕ҃ н҃е · до полоу дн҃е въ па ц҃а с҃тыи мч҃нкь · л҃ · и г҃ · иже въ мелетїн · и прпⷣбнаго ѡц҃а нашего · лазарꙗ чюдотворца · иже в галасинстѣ ѡ́стровѣ · иже єс ни · в҃е стры с҃то лазара поетсꙗ ꙗко
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The confession of the divine faith showed thee forth unto the Church as another Paul, a zealot among the consecrated; Abel cries out with thee unto the Lord, and the blood of Zacharias the righteous; O venerable father, entreat Christ God to grant unto us great mercy!

items.english_text: *Troparion:* With vigilant prayers and streams of tears thou didst bedew thy pillar, and by the sighs from the depth of thy heart thou didst make thy labors fruitful a hundredfold, and becamest a shepherd, granting forgiveness unto all, O our venerable father Lazarus: entreat Christ God that our souls may be saved!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*  
With vigilant prayers and streams of tears thou didst bedew thy pillar, and by the sighs from the depth of thy heart thou didst make thy labors fruitful a hundredfold, and becamest a shepherd, granting forgiveness unto all, O our venerable father Lazarus: entreat Christ God that our souls may be saved!

items.english_text: *Kontakion:* Beyond nature were thy pains and ascetic struggles, O divinely wise one; the angels, beholding thy salvation, marveled; and now having received a crown from God, and as one having boldness before the Lord, deliver us from all dangers, that we may cry unto thee: Rejoice, O father Lazarus!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Kontakion:*  
Beyond nature were thy pains and ascetic struggles, O divinely wise one; the angels, beholding thy salvation, marveled; and now having received a crown from God, and as one having boldness before the Lord, deliver us from all dangers, that we may cry unto thee: Rejoice, O father Lazarus!

items.day_or_date: On the 8th day: Synaxis of the Archangel Michael and the Other Bodiless Powers. We celebrate all day. At Vespers: "Blessed is the...* man" [Ps. 1]. Stichera on 6; Glory, Tone 1: "Of the bodiless hosts..."; Entrance; Prokeimenon of the day; and three readings: 1st, from Joshua the son of Nun: "The children of Israel went out..." [Josh. 5:13–15]; 2nd, from the Prophet Isaiah: "Thus says the Lord: All the earth cries out..." [Isa. 14:7–20]; 3rd, from the Prophet Isaiah [or Zechariah]: "Thus says the Lord: Let all flesh keep silence before the face [of the Lord]..." [Zech. 2:13 / Hab. 2:20]. At the Aposticha: of the Octoechos; Glory, Tone 2: "Rejoice with us..."; Both now, Theotokion. Troparion is said 6 times. At Matins: Canons of the Octoechos, and of the angels on 6. After Ode 6, Kontakion, Tone 4, is said 6 times. At the Praises: and of the Archangel on 4; then Verse: "Who makes His angels spirits" [LXX Ps. 103:4]; is sung the Idiomelon, Tone 6: "Thy angels, O Christ..."; Glory, Tone 5: "Wherever [Thy grace] overshadows..."; Both now, Theotokion. Great Doxology. Troparion of the Archangel. Dismissal. At the Liturgy: The sequence is said 6 times.[^265]

items.slavonic_text: мѫжь · стры на ѕ҃ · сла гл҃а а҃ · разѫ мныхь силъ · выхоⷣ про днекны · и чтеа г҃ · а є · ѿ іесоуса навгина · изыдоша снове іилеви · в҃ є · ѿ пррⷣка исаиа · тако гл҃еть г҃ь въсꙗ землꙗ въпїеть · г҃ є · ѿ пррⷣка иса тако гл҃ть г҃ь · да говѣеть ксѣка плъть ѿ лица на стн ѡ҃ · сла гл҃а в҃ · пр҃те съ гл҃ ль · і ны б҃ тро с҃е ѕ҃ на оу҃р каны ѡ҃ · и аг҃гло на ѕ҃ · по ѕ҃ · пѣ кѡ҃ гл҃а д҃ · с҃е ѕ҃ · на хвалите · и архаг҃гло на д҃ · та с҃ти твора аг҃глы поетсꙗ самогласен · гл҃а ѕ҃ · аг҃гли твои х҃е сла гл҃а є҃ · идеже ѡ́синаеть · і ны · б҃о · славослое великое · тро архаг҃гло · ѿтъеа ѡ҃ поу · на лу҃тоургіи · с лоу · с҃е ѕ҃ · С҃тыхь мч҃нкь · ѡ́нсифора · и порфирьꙗ · и прпⷣбны матри нашеꙗ матроуны · и ѳеѡ́ктисти а · лесвискыꙗ · а҃ллуа · тро мч҃нци твои · сла ѡ тебѣ мати · ко҃ гл҃а в҃ · За любовь гн҃ю прпⷣбнаꙗ · покоища желаніе возненавидѣ
items.english_text: *Kontakion:* For the love of the Lord, O venerable one, Thou didst hate the desire for rest having enlightened thy spirit by fasting, and by thy prayers cast down the enemy's raging; for valiantly in the faith hast thou overcome![^266]

provenance.verbatim_source:

For the love of the Lord, O venerable one, Thou didst hate the desire for rest...
...having enlightened thy spirit by fasting, and by thy prayers cast down the enemy's raging; for valiantly in the faith hast thou overcome![^266]

items.slavonic_text: пощенїемь дх҃ъ просвѣтивши · и жтвои ми мл҃твами противныꙗ шатаніꙗ разори · крѣпько бо въ вѣрѣ побѣдила єси :~ по ѕ҃ · пѣ ко҃ гл҃а в҃ · Мч҃нкъ двоица пострадавше крѣпко · вражїю гордыню на земли низло жиша · ѡ́зарившесꙗ бл҃годать несъзда нныꙗ тр҃ца, славныи ѡ́ньсифоръ · и порь фирїи · молꙗщесꙗ прилежно, ѡ всѣ на :~ С҃тыи ап҃лъ, ераста · ѡ́лѹмпь · родиѡна · и прочихъ · тро а҃плне ст҃їи · и на оу҃трьни · к҃а ѡ҃ и с҃ты на д҃ · по ѕ҃ · пѣ кѡ҃ гл҃а в҃ · Бж҃твеныимь свѣтѡ́ оу́мь ѡ́заряємыи · и вѣтіискаꙗ плетеnіа мѫдро разористе · ꙗзы кы всемоу́ ловилъше а҃пли славніи · влцѣ приведесте · тр҃цю бж҃твъноуіу наоучаю ще :~ С҃тыи мч҃никь, мины · и виктора · и ве кентіꙗ · и с҃тыꙗ мч҃нцѣ стефаниды · и с҃то го ѡц҃а нашего ѳеѡ́дра стоудїискаго · в҃ер е стры с҃ты г҃ · и с҃тм б҃о ѳеѡ́рѫ г҃ · сл҃ гл҃ ѕ҃ ·
items.english_text: *Kontakion:* *After Ode 6, Kontakion, Tone 2:* The pair of martyrs, having suffered valiantly, cast down the enemy's pride upon earth, being enlightened by the grace of the uncreated Trinity, glorious Onesiphorus and Porphyrius, praying fervently for all of us!

provenance.verbatim_source:

*Kontakion:*  
The pair of martyrs, having suffered valiantly, cast down the enemy's pride upon earth, being enlightened by the grace of the uncreated Trinity, glorious Onesiphorus and Porphyrius, praying fervently for all of us!

items.slavonic_text: и прпⷣбнаго ѡц҃а нила · в҃ерь · стры · с҃ты · на ѕ҃ · сла гл҃а в҃ · мл҃тыни источьникь · і ны б҃ ѡ҃ · на стн ѡ҃ · сла и҃нокы дн҃сь · і ны б҃ · тро гл҃а и҃ · Въ тръпѣнии своемь стꙗ жаль єси мьздоу свою ѡ́ч҃е прпⷣбне · въ мл҃и тва непрестанно тръпѣвы · нищїꙗ възлю билъ єси · и сихъ напиталъ єси · нѫ молисꙗ х҃оу б҃оу ѡ́ч҃е іѡанне бл҃жне · да сп҃сеть д҃ша наша :~ сл҃а слъзъ твоихъ · с҃е г҃ · на оу҃р ка ѡ҃ на ѕ҃ · и с҃ты два · по г҃ · пѣ ко҃ ни лоу · гл҃а в҃ · Чистотою дшевьною бж҃твьно въѡ́роуживъсꙗ · и непрестанную мл҃твѫ ꙗко копіе въ роучь имвы · крѣпко съсеклъ єси бѣсовьскаꙗ ниле ополченїꙗ · чюдотво рче ѡ́ч҃е нашь · непрестано молꙗ ѡ всѣхь нас :~ по ѕ҃ · пѣ кѡ҃ ѡ́ іѡаннѣ · гл҃а в҃ · вышнихъ · Бл҃гатьство свое расточилъ єси нищиимь · и нбⷣное бататьство нынѣ приꙗль · ѡ́ч҃е премѫдре іѡ́анне · сего ради въси тꙗ

items.section: On the 13th day: In memory of our Father among the Saints John Chrysostom, Patriarch of Constantinople. We celebrate all day, with an All-Night Vigil sung if the Abbot wills. At Vespers: "Blessed is the man" [Ps. 1]; Stichera on 8; Glory, Tone 6: "Venerable father, thrice-blessed..."; Both now, Theotokion of the Octoechos, Tone 1: "Who will not bless thee...". Entrance; Prokeimenon of the day; and three readings. At the Aposticha: Idiomela, 3; and verses, Tone 4: "My mouth shall speak [wisdom]" [LXX Ps. 48:4], "The mouth of the righteous [shall meditate wisdom]" [LXX Ps. 36:30]; Glory, Tone 6: "O golden-voiced trumpet..."; Both now, Theotokion: "O Theotokos, Thou art the true vine...". Troparion, Tone 8

Grace having shone forth from thy mouth like gold, it enlightened the universe, [gathering] treasures not of covetousness...

items.section: At Matins: The customary psalmody, and canon of the Octoechos, then of the saint; Songs of Ascents [Anabathmoi] of Tone 4. Prokeimenon: "My mouth shall speak [wisdom]" [LXX Ps. 48:4]; Verse: "Hear this, all ye nations" [LXX Ps. 48:2]. Let every breath. Gospel from John, Thursday of the 5th week [Jn. 10:9–16], ending: "about the middle". Psalm 50. Sticheron of the saint. Canon of the Theotokos: "Held fast by many [temptations]...", with the heirmos on 6; and of the saint on 8. After Ode 6, Kontakion, Tone 6, Podoben: "Fulfilling the dispensation for our sake" (Еже о нас)
items.season_or_tone: PART III: MENOLOGION
items.day_or_date: On the 13th day: In memory of our Father among the Saints John Chrysostom, Patriarch of Constantinople. We celebrate all day, with an All-Night Vigil sung if the Abbot wills. At Vespers: "Blessed is the man" [Ps. 1]; Stichera on 8; Glory, Tone 6: "Venerable father, thrice-blessed..."; Both now, Theotokion of the Octoechos, Tone 1: "Who will not bless thee...". Entrance; Prokeimenon of the day; and three readings. At the Aposticha: Idiomela, 3; and verses, Tone 4: "My mouth shall speak [wisdom]" [LXX Ps. 48:4], "The mouth of the righteous [shall meditate wisdom]" [LXX Ps. 36:30]; Glory, Tone 6: "O golden-voiced trumpet..."; Both now, Theotokion: "O Theotokos, Thou art the true vine...". items.slavonic_text: мирови сокровище снискавъ · высотоу намь съмиреномоудрїа показалъ еси · но твоими словесы наказуꙗ · ѡ́тче іѡ́анне златооу́ сте · моли же словоу х҃оу б҃оу · сп҃тисꙗ д҃шамь нашимъ :~ на оу҃рни · ѡ́ бычнѡе стїхословіє · и канонъ ѡ́ктоиха · тѣ с҃тго с те д҃ го гла · про оу́ста моꙗ възгл҃ать · ст҃и · оу́слы те вси ꙗзыци · всꙗко дыханіе · єѵе ѡ іѡ́ в че҃ є҃ · к҃е ѡ́ полоу · ѱл҃м н҃ · стра ст҃го · ка б҃ци · многыми ѡ́дръж · съ ірмосомь на ѕ҃ · и с҃тго на и҃ · по ѕ҃ · пѣ ко҃ гла ѕ҃ · еже ѡ́ на · Ѿ нб҃съ прїинє бж҃твънѫ ю бл҃ть · и своими оустнами вьсѧ оу́чиши · покла натисꙗ въ троуице единомѫ б҃оу · іѡанне зла тооусте вьсебл҃жене прпⷣбне достоино хва лимь тꙗ · еси бо наставникь · ꙗко бж҃твнаꙗ ꙗвлѣꙗ :~ на хва стры на д҃ · сла гла и҃ · златыими крилы · і ны б҃ · славословие ве ликое · тро с҃таго ѡ́ктениа · ѿпоусть ·
items.english_text: *Kontakion:* *From heaven hast thou received divine grace, and by thine own lips dost teach all to worship the one God in Trinity, O John Chrysostom, all-blessed, venerable one, worthily do we praise thee; for thou art an instructor, revealing divine things!*

items.slavonic_text: И детсꙗ с҃тое масло · ѿ кандила с҃таго · поє мыимь самогласникомь · на лѵ҃тоургии ѡ́ ка҃ пѣ г҃ · и ѕ҃ · пр҃о гла а҃ · оу́ста моꙗ възгл҃ать · с҃ти · оу́ слышите вси · а҃пль к҃ ев тако намь подобаеть · а҃ллуа · г҃ в҃ · оу́ста праведнаго · єѵлїе · ѡ іѡанна · ре г҃ь азъ есмь дверь · к҃в въ память · С҃того ап҃ла филиппа · празнуеве днь · в҃е · стры на ѕ҃ · г҃ і ѕ҃ всеоу́пованіе · сл҃ г҃ ѕ҃ · небнаго · і н҃ б҃ на стн ѡ҃ · сл҃ г҃ в҃ ѡ́ставивь · і н҃ б҃ тро а҃пл есты нау҃ ка ѡ҃ і с҃т на ѕ по ѕ҃ пѣ кѡ҃ гла и҃ · ꙗко начаткы · Оу́чн҃къ , и дроугъ твои · и подобникъ стр҃тн твоєи · въселенѣи б҃а тꙗ проповѣда · б҃огласныи филиппе · того мл҃твами ѡ҃ иꙗзыкъ безаконныхъ цр҃ковь твою · и весь градъ твои · б҃ца ради съблюди многомл҃тиве :~ на хва · само гласны г҃ · гл҃а в҃ · сл҃а г҃ д рыбноую ловь · і н҃ б҃ славословье великое · тро с҃т ѡ́ктеа ·
items.english_text: *Kontakion:* *Thy disciple and friend, and imitator of Thy Passion, the divinely inspired Philip, preached Thee as God unto the universe; by his prayers, preserve Thy Church and all Thy city from lawless nations, for the sake of the Theotokos, O Thou Who art plenteous in mercy!*

items.slavonic_text: дважды днемь · в ъсрѣже · и пя · ꙗды дважды · токмо рыбы не ꙗды · Вѣдати же аще бѫдеть · начало сего · с҃тго поста · въ сѫботоу · и ли в н҃елю · въ тꙗ дни · поє тся · тро · кѡ҃ · с҃тыи исповѣдникь · а́ ѡ про чеихъ б҃ · и н҃е · то аллуина · постнаго ради въхоженіа · и начала · С҃тыи исповѣдник гоурїꙗ · самона · и авива · в҃ерь · стры · с҃ты на ѕ҃ · сл҃а гл҃а в҃ · єдеса веселить · і ны б҃ на стн · ѡ҃ · сл҃а гл҃а в҃ · придѣте мч҃нико любци · і ны б҃ ѡ҃ · тро гл҃а є҃ · Чюдеса с҃ты мч҃никь гра нераздроушимь намь подавь х҃е б҃е · мл҃твами ихъ съвѣты ꙗзыкѡмь разо ри · и цр҃твіꙗ скиперь оутвръди · ꙗко єди нь бл҃гъ · и чл҃колюбець :~ на оу́трьни · ка҃ ѡ҃ · с҃ты · на ѕ҃ · по г҃ · пѣ ко҃ гла в҃ · Съ высоты мѫдріи бл҃гть въꙁемше · сѫщи въ напастех престоите прехвалнїи тѣмь · и ѡтроковицю с҃тнїи ѿ съмръти горькыꙗ
items.english_text: *Troparion:* *Having granted us the miracles of Thy holy martyrs as an indestructible rampart, O Christ God: by their prayers cast down the counsels of the heathen, and establish the sceptre of the kingdom; for Thou alone art good and the Lover of mankind!*

provenance.verbatim_source:

*Having granted us the miracles of Thy holy martyrs as an indestructible rampart, O Christ God: by their prayers cast down the counsels of the heathen, and establish the sceptre of the kingdom; for Thou alone art good and the Lover of mankind!*

items.english_text: *Troparion:* *Today is the prelude of the good will of God, and the herald of the salvation of mankind: in the temple of God the Virgin clearly is shown forth, and proclaims Christ unto all; unto her let us also cry aloud with a great voice: Rejoice, thou fulfillment of the Creator's dispensation!*

items.section: The Troparion of the feast is said thrice, Tone 4: "Today is the prelude of the good will..."; and the homily of the feast is read. At Matins: the customary psalmody [Kathisma], and the other prayers; Sessional hymns of the feast; Songs of Ascents [Anabathmoi] of Tone 4. Prokeimenon, Tone 4: "Hear, O daughter" [LXX Ps. 44:11]; Verse: "My heart hath poured forth a good word" [LXX Ps. 44:2]. Let every breath. Gospel from Luke [Lk. 1:39–49, 56]; after the Gospel, Psalm 50; Sticheron of the feast. Two canons, Tone 4 of George, and Tone 1; the heirmoi twice, and the troparia on 12; Katavasia: "Christ is born", both choirs together. After Ode 3, Hypakoe of the feast. After Ode 6, Kontakion of the feast, Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou Who Wast Lifted Up upon the Cross" (Вознесыйся)

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Kontakion of Saint Peter, Tone 3:*  
*Kontakion:*  
*By Orthodox precepts having enlightened the Church, for which thou didst suffer, O divinely-blessed father, driving away the apostate Arius; therefore celebrating thy most pure memory, we cry aloud in orthodox manner: Rejoice, O Peter, rock of the faith!*

At the Praises: Stichera of the saints on 4; Glory... Both now, of the feast, Tone 2: "Today into the church she is led..."; Great Doxology; Troparion of the feast; litany; dismissal; and the First Hour. At the Liturgy: of the feast, from both sides Ode 9 with the heirmos on 8; Troparion of the feast; Glory... Both now, Kontakion of the feast. Prokeimenon, the Song of the Theotokos: "My soul doth magnify the Lord" [Lk. 1:46]; Verse: "For He hath regarded the lowliness of His handmaiden" [Lk. 1:48]...[^286]* *...Apostle of the day, and of the feast; Alleluia: "Hear, O daughter" [LXX Ps. 44:11]; Verse: "The virgins shall be brought unto the King" [LXX Ps. 44:15]; Gospel of the day, and of the feast; Communion verse: "I will take the cup of salvation" [LXX Ps. 115:4].*

items.slavonic_text: апостолъ дневныи · и празднику · алли луиа · Слыши дъщи · ст҃и · Приведоут сѧ цр҃ю дв҃ы · єѵ[агге]лїе дневное · и праздникоу · г҃ · н · причастень · Чашю сп҃сенна прии[му] · Прп҃бнаго ѡц҃а нашего Алимпиа · алли луиа · тр҃о · с҃е · а҃ · Тръпенїю стлъпь бы[сть] · кѡ[ндакъ] · гл҃а · и҃ · Ꙗко начаткы єстьства :~ Ꙗко добродѣтелемь виноу · и постьнико мь оудобренїе · цр҃кы славит тѧ дн҃ь · и въ спѣваетъ Алимпїе · молитвами ти пода и же чьтоущимь любовїю доблести тво ꙗ · и корениꙗ лютыхъ прѣгрѣшеннии изба вленїа тезоимените :~ Ст҃ого моученика Иꙗкова Перскаго · в вечерь · ст҃ры · с҃то · сл҃а · гл҃а в҃ · і нꙑ · б҃ · и на стїх · ѡ[ктоиха] · тр҃о · Моученикъ твои гн҃и въ страданіи твоемь · по ѕ҃ · пѣ[сни] кѡ[ндакъ] · гл҃а · в҃ · Дброкавь добро не соупроужници терпеливо дш҃ьне · и стра шнаго соудища оубоꙗ сѧ перское повеленіе
items.english_text: *Kontakion:* *As the cause of virtues and an adornment of fasters, the Church glorifies thee today, and sings thy praise, O Alypius; by thy prayers grant unto them that honor with love thy valiant deeds deliverance from the roots of grievous transgressions, O namesake of freedom from sorrow!*

items.slavonic_text: Иже въ трⷪ҇ци бл҃гочьстно пѣваемаго · послѣ доующїи бг҃оу стратотръпнице · елинскыꙗ ѡставила еси жрътвы · посрѣдѣ же поби га стражѫщи варваро · мѫчителен не оубо ꙗ сѧ прѣщеньꙗ мѫжеоумнаа · велегласно въпиющи присно · тр҃цю чьтоу едино бж҃е ство :~ та тѣ ст҃ыѧ · по ѕ҃ · пѣ[сни] кѡ[ндакъ] їѡан[ну] · гла[съ] д҃ · Пѣснописца и чьстнаго бг҃огл҃ни ка · цр҃кви казателѧ , и оучитела · и врагѡ[мъ] съпротивноборца · їѡанна въспоимь · ѡрѫ жїе бо възѧ длꙑ крⷭ҇тъ гн҃ь · въсѧ ѡтрази ере скыꙗ льсть · и ꙗко теплъ престатель къ бг҃оу · вьсѣмь подаваеть съгрѣшенїемь про щенїе :~ на хва[лехъ] с҃мгл[асни] ст҃ыѧ гл҃ а҃ · ины в҃ · гл҃ · а҃ · сл҃а гл҃а ѕ҃ · стрⷭ҇тотръпчьскы · і н҃ы б҃ · и на стїховнѣ · въ ѡхтаикоу · сл҃а · Инокоь множьство · і нынѣ · б҃ · на лѵ тоургіи · ѡ[т] канона · с҃тыѧ · пѣ[снь] г҃ · на д҃ и ст҃омоу · ѕ҃ · на д҃ · про[кименъ] · Дивень бг҃ъ въ ·
items.english_text: *Kontakion:* *Having followed God Who is devoutly praised in the Trinity, O passion-bearer, thou didst abandon the pagan sacrifices; and enduring suffering in the midst of the contest, O Barbara, thou wast not dismayed by the threats of the torturers, O courageous of soul, crying out with a great voice unceasingly: I revere the Trinity, one Godhead!*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Kontakion:*  
*Having followed God Who is devoutly praised in the Trinity, O passion-bearer, thou didst abandon the pagan sacrifices; and enduring suffering in the midst of the contest, O Barbara, thou wast not dismayed by the threats of the torturers, O courageous of soul, crying out with a great voice unceasingly: I revere the Trinity, one Godhead!*

items.english_text: *Kontakion:* *The hymnographer and honored divinely-eloquent one, the instructor and teacher of the Church, and against the enemies an antagonist, let us hymn John; for having taken up as an armor the Cross of the Lord, he drove back all heretical deceit, and as a fervent intercessor before God, he grants unto all the remission of transgressions!*

items.english_text: *Kontakion:* *As a pure sacrifice offered unto God from infancy, through virtue, O blessed one, wast thou a founder of piety; therefore didst thou become an ornament of the venerable, a citizen of the desert worthy of all praise! Therefore we cry unto thee: Rejoice, O all-wealthy Sabbas!*

items.english_text: *Kontakion:* *In Myra, O holy one, wast thou shown forth as a hierurg; for the Gospel of Christ, O venerable one, having fulfilled, thou didst lay down thy life for thy people, and didst save the innocent from death; therefore wast thou hallowed...[^294]* *...as a great initiate of the grace of God![^295]*

provenance.verbatim_source:

*In Myra, O holy one, wast thou shown forth as a hierurg; for the Gospel of Christ, O venerable one, having fulfilled, thou didst lay down thy life for thy people, and didst save the innocent from death; therefore wast thou hallowed...[^294]*
*...as a great initiate of the grace of God![^295]*

items.english_text: *Troparion:* *Today the bonds of barrenness are loosed, for having heard Joachim and Anne, beyond hope she clearly conceives: for the Maiden goes forth, from Whom He Who is uncircumscribed was Himself born, becoming a mortal, and commanded the Angel to cry unto her: Rejoice, O thou full of grace, the Lord is with thee!*

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.slavonic_text: вень бг҃ъ · ст҃и · въ цр҃ква · а҃пль · къ Ъевреѡ[мъ] братїа имѣаше пръвыи храмь · а҃ллилуиа · Сп҃сенїе праведныимь · єѵ[агге]лїе · ѡ[т] лоукы · сѫбота · ѕ҃ · к҃н · Радоуите сѧ · і҃ · С҃тымоу ченикь манны · и ермогена · и евграфа · ст҃ры ст҃ы[мъ] · на ѕ҃ · на стї[ховнѣ] · ѡ[ктоиха] · сл҃а ст҃ы[мъ] і н҃ы · б҃ · тр҃о · гла[съ] и҃ · Въздержаньемь стр҃ти · ѡгне палныꙗ оумрътивше стремленьꙗ и дви женїа · хв҃и мч҃нци прїꙗша бл҃гть · недоу гы ѡ[т]ганати немощныимь · живи и жь по покончинїѣ · чюдодѣйствовати · въ исти ноу чюдо прѣславно · ꙗко кости нагыꙗ исто чають исцѣленїа · слава единомоу оуснижи телю бг҃оу :~ на оутрини · каноны · ѡ[ктоиха] ст҃ы[мъ] на ѕ҃ · по ѕ҃ · пѣ[сни] кѡ[ндакъ] гла[съ] д҃ · Добропѣньии гла[съ] , твоихъ словесь ерьмогене · из глѫби ны погыбели н възведъ ши по ставника дае ни жизни · ѡноудоу же и евграфъ цр҃ꙗ лювь личникы · радꙋꙗ сѧ посѣкаеть ꙗ въ славнѫ
items.english_text: *Troparion:* *By the restraint of passions, having put to death the fiery surges and stirrings, the martyrs of Christ received grace to drive away afflictions from the infirm, and alive and even after death to work wonders; in truth a most glorious wonder, that bare bones pour forth healings! Glory to the only humbled God!*

provenance.verbatim_source:

*By the restraint of passions, having put to death the fiery surges and stirrings, the martyrs of Christ received grace to drive away afflictions from the infirm, and alive and even after death to work wonders; in truth a most glorious wonder, that bare bones pour forth healings! Glory to the only humbled God!*

items.english_text: *Kontakion:* *The sweet-singing voice of thy words, O Hermogenes, having drawn up Menas from the depth of perdition, appointed him as a director unto life; from whence also Eugraphus, rejoicing, cuts down the emperor's flatterers, for a glorious crown, and with diligence pray marvelously that all who sing of thee with love may be saved!*

items.slavonic_text: ꙗ главоу · и и прилежно моли дивно · сп҃сти сѧ всѣмь любовїю поющимъ тѧ :~ на лѵ тоургіи · про[кименъ] Ст҃ымь иже сѫ[ть] · ст҃и Прѣ[д]зрѣ[хъ] а҃пль · не[дѣлѧ] к҃з · а҃ллилуиа · Възваша праве[днїи] єѵг҃гелїе · ѡ[т] лоу[кы] · к҃і · не[дѣлѧ] · к҃ѣ · Радоуите сѧ · а҃і · Прп҃бнаго ѡ҃ца нашего , данила стлъпни ка · тр҃о · Терпѣнїю стлъпь бы[сть] · се҃ а҃ · б҃ц · гла[съ] и҃ · ꙗко начаткы · Ꙗко звѣзда много просвѣтлаа · възьше бл҃жене на стлъпь · ми ръ просвѣтилъ еси · прп҃бныими дѣлы свои ми · и тьмоу прѣльсти ѡ[т]гналъ еси ѡ҃че · тѣ мьже молимь тѧ и нн҃ѣ ѡблиетани въ ср҃дца ра бъ твоихъ · незаходѧщїи свѣ[тъ] разоума :~ в҃і · Прп҃бнаго ѡ҃ца нашего , спиридона чю творца епп҃а триѳинска · В вечерь · ст҃ры · ст҃го · на ѕ҃ · сл҃а в҃ · ст҃ле бж҃їь · і н҃ б҃ · на стїх[овнѣ] · ѡ[ктоиха] · сл҃а гла[съ] а҃ · Прп҃бне ѡ҃че · і н҃ б҃ · тр҃о се҃ в҃ · Правило вѣрѣ · на оутрыни · ка ноны · ѡ[ктоиха] · ст҃го на ѕ҃ · по ѕ҃ · пѣ[сни] кѡ[ндакъ] гла[съ] в҃ ·
items.english_text: *Kontakion:* *As a star of great radiance, having mounted upon the pillar, O blessed one, thou didst enlighten the world by thy venerable deeds, and the darkness of deceit hast thou driven away, O father; therefore we pray thee even now: Shine into the hearts of thy servants the unwaning light of understanding!*

provenance.verbatim_source:

*As a star of great radiance, having mounted upon the pillar, O blessed one, thou didst enlighten the world by thy venerable deeds, and the darkness of deceit hast thou driven away, O father; therefore we pray thee even now: Shine into the hearts of thy servants the unwaning light of understanding!*

items.english_text: *Hypakoe:* *The fire was changed into dew for the Children, and weeping was changed into joy; for the Angel ministered unto both wonders: unto the one indeed he transformed the furnace into rest, but unto the other he proclaimed the three-day resurrection; and O Author of our life: Lord, glory to Thee!*

items.slavonic_text: С҃тго сщ҃мчка · елиферьꙗ · и прп҃бнаго ѡ҃ца на шего павла чюдотворца · иже в латрѣ · В е черь · ст҃ры · ст҃ы[мъ] · На сти[ховнѣ] · ѡ[ктоиха] · тр҃о · И нраво[мъ] причастникъ · се҃ г҃ · сл҃а гл҃а д҃ · Ꙗко бе сплътныимь единокрѫвникъ · и въсѣ[мъ] прп҃бныимь ѡбещникь · преславныи павь ле · поемь , и молимь ти сѧ · моли въсегда ѡ на[съ] · ꙗко да ѡбрѧщемь мл҃ть :~ На оутрь[ни] · каноны · ѡ[ктоиха] · и ст҃ы[мъ] · По г҃ · пѣ[сни] кѡ[ндакъ] гла[съ] в҃ · твръдыꙗ · Оудобренїе сщ҃еныхь прп҃бь не · и прѣложенне стрⷭ҇тотръпець · въси въ хвалѧюще молимь сѧ · сщ҃енномоуч҃нче еле ферье · любовію памать твою празнующїи ѡ[т] бѣдъ многоразличныхь свободи · мо лѧ сѧ бепрестанни ѡ въсѣхь на[съ] :~ По ѕ҃ · пѣ[сни] кѡ[ндакъ] ст҃го · гла[съ] и҃ · Ѿ юности бг҃омоудре ꙗже паче оума възжелѣвь · мѫжьскыи ми рьскыꙗ тѧжь ѡставилъ еси · и быль еси бж҃твьныимь житїемь · троици жилище ·
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* *As a kinsman of the bodiless and a companion of all the venerable, O most glorious Paul, we hymn thee and pray unto thee: Pray ever for us, that we may find mercy!*

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.english_text: *Troparion:* *Great are the achievements of faith: in the fountain of flame, as upon the water of rest, the three holy Children rejoiced, and the Prophet Daniel showed himself a shepherd unto lions as unto sheep; by their intercessions, O Christ God, have mercy on us!*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*  
*Great are the achievements of faith: in the fountain of flame, as upon the water of rest, the three holy Children rejoiced, and the Prophet Daniel showed himself a shepherd unto lions as unto sheep; by their intercessions, O Christ God, have mercy on us!*

items.day_or_date: On the 20th day: The Holy Hieromartyr Ignatius the God-Bearer. We begin the Forefeast of the Nativity of Christ. On that day reposed the Most Consecrated Metropolitan Peter of All Rus', at the 3rd hour of the night, in the year 6834 [1326 AD]; he pastured the Church of God for 18 years and 6 months, and was laid to rest in the city of Moscow, in the Church of the Dormition of the Holy Theotokos.[^309]

items.english_text: *Troparion:* *Make ready, O Bethlehem: Eden is opened unto all! Adorn thyself, O Ephratha, for the Tree of Life hath blossomed forth from the Virgin in the cave! For Her womb was revealed as a spiritual paradise, wherein is the divine Garden, from which eating, we shall live, and not die as Adam: Christ is born, to raise up the previously fallen image!*

items.english_text: *Kontakion:* *The light-bearing day of thy radiant contests proclaims unto all Him who was born in the cave; thirsting with love to feast upon Him, thou didst hasten to be devoured by beasts; therefore, O Ignatius, thou wast called the God-bearer!*

items.slavonic_text: Подобаеть же вѣдати · сице бываеть, въ слѣдованїе и до канѡна · рожества хв҃а · ѡхтаикъ не поет сѧ · донелѣже и кр҃щнье проводит сѧ · се же е[сть] · ѿ к҃, го дни декабрѧ, мц҃а · и до , д҃і · генварѧ · въ нже ѿдава етсѧ празникъ · бг҃оꙗвленьꙗ · На лѵтоу[ргіи] · прѣпразденствоу · пѣ[снь] г҃ · на д҃ · и ст҃ого · ѕ҃ · на д҃ · Про[кименъ] · Възвеселитсѧ · ст҃и · Оу слыши б҃е · а҃пль · Брае любѧщиимь бг҃а · а҃ллуиа · Праведникь · єѵ[агге]лїе · ѿ ма[тѳеа] · в лоу цѣ · Приде іс҃ въ капернаоумь · ки[ноникъ] въ пама[ть] · С҃тыꙗ мч҃енницю оульꙗны · В[еч]ерь · ст҃ры прѣпразденствоу · и стыꙗ · сл҃а і нн҃ѣ прѣ празденствоу · На сти[ховнѣ] · прѣпраз[днеству] · тр҃о Гото висѧ · На оу[трени] · г҃ · ка[ѳїзма] · сѣ[дальны] прѣпраз[днеству] · ка[нонъ] · прѣ праз[днеству] · на и҃ · стыꙗ · на д҃ · По г҃ · пѣ[сни] кѡ[ндакъ] · гл҃а г҃ · Дѣвьствоу доброта присно · и лоу ченникомь вѣнець · ꙇоульꙗніи нн҃ѣ вѣнча сѧ · дароующиимь въ недꙋзѣхь болѣзнемь

items.slavonic_text: Марїꙗ · дьвъчревоносащи безсѣменно роже ство · наста же времѧ ржⷭ҇тва и мѣсто не бѣ ѡбители · но ꙗко красна палата вертепъ цр҃ци показа · Хс҃ ражаетсѧ прежде падшии въскрⷭ҇си ти ѡбразъ :~ На оу́[трини] ка[нонъ] прѣпраз[днеству] · г҃ · в҃ · на и҃ · Спи сасѧ · сты[ꙗ] на д҃ · По г҃ пѣ[сни] кѡ[ндакъ] гл҃ в҃ · Бл҃городїа правитѧ красолѣпно · ꙋкрашенꙋ ѡбници въ гѫрабьинъ зракъ ѡ[т] дв҃ы · соединили кодвы сщ҃еносѣ · показа сїꙗющꙋ дв҃амь вѣченоснꙋю · ꙗ во истинно бл҃городїа бж҃твную славꙋ возлю бивши :~ По ѕ҃ прѣпра[зднеству] На хва[лехъ] по г҃ г[л҃] ѕ҃ аг҃ге льскы · Сл҃[а] і н҃ гл҃ в҃ · Севре[ма] · На стїх[овнѣ] стры г҃ д҃ · Сл҃[а] і н҃ гл҃ и҃ Воспрїими ви[ѳлеѡме] По тр҃то тро Описасѧ ѡкте[ниꙗ] ѡпꙋз[а] · И не совокоуплае[мь] · Вѣдомо же [боуди] ѿ сего дни ендо · д҃і · дни · ге[нваря] · мц҃а вон же ѿдае[тъ] сѧ празн[икъ] · бг҃оꙗвле[нїꙗ] · стїслови на оу́[трини] по в҃ ка[ѳїзмѣ] а на вечерни · г҃ · а · р҃ · аввага · ѿправꙗет же нде сѧстае[ть] · к҃г · до · ст҃ьнеци · поемь на вечерни · павечерни ца же · малаꙗ · ѡпоущилницѧ бѣ · безъ ꙗзы[ка] :~
items.english_text: *Kontakion:* *Fleeing fair-seemingly the nobility of rank, adorned in a bridegroom-like manner, thou wast united in dove-like likeness from the Virgin, showing thyself crown-bearing unto virgins, O sacredly-robed one, who in truth didst love the nobility of divine glory!*

O Lord, glory to Thee!*

items.slavonic_text: Преже дн҃ьница ѿ ѡ҃ца безъ мт҃ре родися · на земли безъ ѡ҃ца · въплътисѧ дн҃ь и҆сте бе · тѣмь звѣзда бл҃говѣстоуєть волхво мъ · а҆гг҃ли же съ пастыри поють · безъ сѣме нное рожество твое бл҃годатнаꙗ :~ На ѳ҃ · пѣ · чⷭ҇тнѣишю не стихословимь · свѣт праꙁ · На хва · празни · гла҃ д҃ · на д҃ · Веселите сѧ праведнїи · и҆ны г҃ · сла҃ гла҃ ѕ҃ · Дн҃ь не видимыи · і҆ нн҃ѣ гла҃ в҃ · дн҃ь х҃с · славосло вье великое · тро҃ празнї · ѡ҆ктєа · ѿпоу · На лѵ҃тоургїи · ѡ҆ка праꙁ пѣ г҃ · и҆ ѕ҃ · кн҃ Преже дн҃ьница · про · пѣ бц҃и Величитъ ду ше моꙗ · стиꙗ ꙗ҆ко призри · а҆пл҃ · Брає ст҃и сїꙗ є҆дин · а҆ллилуа · гла҃ и҃ · Въскрьни ги въ покои твои · є҆ѵггелїе · ѿ ма҃ · ѿшедшимъ влъхвомъ · кин҃ И҆збавленье посла гь лю · Сѫбота · по рж҃твѣ хв҃ѣ · На лѵ҃п про҃ гл҃ д҃ · Помѧноу и҆мѧ твое · сти · Слыши дщи · а҆пл · лв · н҃е · а҆ллилуиа · гла҃ и҃ · Помѧни гн҃ дв҃да ·
items.english_text: *Kontakion:* *He who was born of the Father without mother before the morning star, became incarnate upon earth without father today from thee; therefore a star announces good tidings to the Magi, and angels with shepherds sing of Thy seedless childbearing, O Full of Grace!*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Kontakion:*  
*He who was born of the Father without mother before the morning star, became incarnate upon earth without father today from thee; therefore a star announces good tidings to the Magi, and angels with shepherds sing of Thy seedless childbearing, O Full of Grace!*

items.section: On Saturday, at Little Vespers: from the Octoechos, Resurrection and Theotokion according to custom; but the service of the saints which is in the [Menaion] is sung when the superior of the church desires it. At Great Vespers: "Blessed is the man" [Kathisma 1]. On "Lord, I have cried", we sing 3 Resurrection stichera; and of the feast, 4, Tone 2: "Come, let us rejoice..."; and of the saints, 3, Tone 1, Podoben: "Thou who bearest flesh..."; Glory, Tone 6: "Rejoicing, we celebrate [the memory]..."; Both now, Theotokion of the current tone. Entrance according to custom. At the Aposticha: Resurrection sticheron, and the Alphabetical stichera; Glory, Tone 6: "Jerusalem, rejoice..."; Both now, of the feast. Blessing of the loaves; Troparion, Tone 2: "Rejoice, O Virgin Theotokos..." twice, and of the saints once

items.english_text: *Troparion:* *Proclaim the marvelous wonders unto David the ancestor of God, O Joseph: thou hast seen a Virgin giving birth; with the shepherds thou hast given glory; with the Magi...[^333]* *...thou hast worshipped; having received word from an angel: pray unto Christ God that He may save our souls!*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*  
*Proclaim the marvelous wonders unto David the ancestor of God, O Joseph: thou hast seen a Virgin giving birth; with the shepherds thou hast given glory; with the Magi...[^333]*

items.section: And reading in the Epistles. At Matins: Resurrection [troparion] twice; Glory, of the saints; Both now, of the feast. After the Kathismata: Sessional hymns of the Resurrection with their Theotokia; "Blessed are the blameless" [LXX Ps. 118] with their troparia; Hypakoe of the Tone; and the Polyeleos; Sessional hymn of the feast; Gradual hymns of the Tone. Prokeimenon of the Tone; "Let every breath praise the Lord"; Resurrection Gospel; "Having seen the Resurrection of Christ"; Psalm 50; Resurrection Sticheron. Canons: of the Resurrection to 4, and of the Theotokos to 2, and of the Righteous to 4. After Ode 3, Kontakion, Tone 1

items.english_text: *Kontakion:* *The prophetic choir celebrates divinely the marvel wrought unto thee, O Virgin; for thou hast given birth upon earth unto God incarnate; therefore angels with shepherds sing, and magi with faith, together with Joseph, cry aloud the wonders of David!*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Kontakion:*  
*The prophetic choir celebrates divinely the marvel wrought unto thee, O Virgin; for thou hast given birth upon earth unto God incarnate; therefore angels with shepherds sing, and magi with faith, together with Joseph, cry aloud the wonders of David!*

items.english_text: *Kontakion:* *Yesterday the Master was revealed unto us in the flesh, and today the servant departs from the flesh; yesterday He that reigns was born in the flesh, today the servant is stoned with stones; for His sake dies the divine first-martyr, Stephen!*

items.section: At Vespers: Stichera: 3 of the Forefeast, Tone 4; 3 of the saint, Tone 8; Glory, Both now, Tone 6: "He goes unto the Jordan...". At the Aposticha: Idiomela, 3 of the Forefeast: "Coming unto the witness..."; another, Tone 2: "Again Jesus..."; another, Tone 3. And they say verses: "Therefore will I remember Thee from the land of Jordan..." [LXX Ps. 41:7]; "The waters saw Thee, O God, the waters saw Thee" [LXX Ps. 76:17]. And they say these verses at Vespers, and at Matins, even unto the Eve of the Enlightenment [Theophany]. Glory, Both now, Tone 3: "Come, all ye faithful...". Troparion, Tone 4

items.english_text: *Sessional hymn of the prophet; Glory, of the saint; Both now, of the Forefeast. After Ode 6, Kontakion of the Forefeast. At the Praises and at the Aposticha: all of the Forefeast, according to yesterday's direction. At the Divine Liturgy:...[^344]* *...Liturgy: From the canons: of the Forefeast, Ode 3 on 4; to the martyr, Ode 6 on 4. Prokeimenon: "The righteous shall rejoice in the Lord" [LXX Ps. 63:11]; Verse: "Hear my voice, O God" [LXX Ps. 63:2]. Epistle to Timothy: "Child Timothy, by the putting on of hands..." [2 Tim. 1:3–9]. Alleluia: "The righteous man shall flourish like a palm tree" [LXX Ps. 91:13]. Gospel from Matthew: "At that time, the Lord said: Behold, I send you forth as sheep in the midst of wolves..." [Mt. 10:16–22]. Communion verse: "In everlasting memory shall the righteous be" [LXX Ps. 111:6].*

items.slavonic_text: чьтоуть . парміи . д а бꙋде готовы сътво рити . великою . мл҃о . и по ѡктенѣ абые . начи наеть великою . мл҃о . велен еси г̃и . и по скон чаньи . мл҃о гл̃ть іереи . миръ всѣмь . дьіако главы ваша . по҃ . мл҃о . в тан . приклони г̃и оухо твое . та̃ кꙋзекр̃ть . и възгла̃ть . ꙗко ты еси с҃тыни наша . бл̃гвнвь водꙋ чт̃ны крⷪ҇тѡ̃ . прамо погрꙋзить . крⷪ҇ть въ водѣ . гла̃ тр҃о . гла̃ а҃ . въ іѡрданѣ крⷪ҇щающꙋ ти ся г̃и . троичьское явися поклананіе . ро дителевъ бо гласъ свидѣтельствоваше ти . възлюбленаго тя сн҃а имяноуꙗ . и дх҃ъ въ видѣніи голꙋбинѣ . извѣстоваше словесы оутвръженіе . ꙗвлен ся х҃е бж҃е нашъ . и мирꙑ просвѣщь слава тебѣ :~ и всѣмь сьщаемы ѿ воды кропленіа . поють . въ іѡрданѣ крⷪ҇щающоути ся г̃и . г҃ жьі . в шѐ въ цр҃ко вь поють . слава . гла̃ ѕ҃ . въ схо̃ половрѣ ніи . и гл̃ють . ѱ̃ломь , л҃г . бл҃гва г̃ана .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* *When Thou wast baptized in the Jordan, O Lord, the worship of the Trinity was made manifest: for the voice of the Father bore witness unto Thee, naming Thee His beloved Son, and the Spirit in the form of a dove confirmed the certainty of the word: O Christ God, Who hast appeared and enlightened the world, glory to Thee!*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*  
*When Thou wast baptized in the Jordan, O Lord, the worship of the Trinity was made manifest: for the voice of the Father bore witness unto Thee, naming Thee His beloved Son, and the Spirit in the form of a dove confirmed the certainty of the word: O Christ God, Who hast appeared and enlightened the world, glory to Thee!*

items.slavonic_text: года̃ ти выи . тѣ празниковꙋ . сте̃ д҃ ѻ . гла̃ про̃ гла̃ д҃ . море видѣвь . с҃ . что ти е̃ мо ре да по . вьсѣко ды . еѵ̃ліе . ѿ ма̃ . ѱ̃лѡ н҃ . стра празнно . канѡ̃ два гла̃ в҃ . г̃на коꙁмы . и г̃на іѡа̃ . ірм̃ь . подв҃і . тр҃о по д҃ . и пакы ірм̃ь по единож . ѡ ба лика вку̃ по г҃ . пѣ ѵпакои . гла̃ и҃ . егда ꙗвленіе мь твоимь просвѣтилъ еси всячьскаꙗ , то гда сланое се невѣрьствіе море бѣжа . іѡрда нь долꙋ текавъ възврати ся . на нбо къзнося на . на высотꙋ бж҃твныи ꙁаповѣдіи твоихь съблюди х҃е бж҃е . мл҃твами бц҃а помилꙋина :~ и чтенье ѿ бг҃ослова . пакы ідониіс . по ѕ҃ . кѡ̃ гла̃ д҃ . ꙗвиль ся еси дньсь вселенѣи . и свѣтъ твои г̃и ꙁнамена ся на на̃ . въ раꙁꙋмѣ поющихъ тя . прииде и ꙗви ся свѣть непри косновенныи :~ на ѳ҃ . чт̃нѣишю не стихо словимь . свѣ̃ . ꙗви ся сп҃съ нашъ . г҃ жьі на хва̃ . поемь самогласны г҃ гла̃ а҃ . на д҃ .
items.english_text: *Hypakoe:* *After Ode 3, Hypakoe, Tone 8:* *When by Thy manifestation Thou enlightenedst all things, then this salty sea of unbelief fled, and Jordan flowing downward turned back, exalting us unto heaven: keep us upon the height of Thy divine commandments, O Christ God, through the prayers of the Mother of God, and have mercy upon us!*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*After Ode 3, Hypakoe, Tone 8:*  
*Hypakoe:*  
*When by Thy manifestation Thou enlightenedst all things, then this salty sea of unbelief fled, and Jordan flowing downward turned back, exalting us unto heaven: keep us upon the height of Thy divine commandments, O Christ God, through the prayers of the Mother of God, and have mercy upon us!*

items.english_text: *Troparion: "When Thou wast baptized in the Jordan, O Lord...".* *Entrance: "Blessed is He that comes in the name of the Lord; God is the Lord, and hath appeared unto us" [LXX Ps. 117:26–27]. Troparion: "When Thou wast baptized in the Jordan...". Glory, Both now, Kontakion of the feast. Instead of the Trisagion: "As many of you as have been baptized into Christ have put on Christ. Alleluia" [Gal. 3:27]. Prokeimenon, Tone 4: "Blessed is He that comes in the name of the Lord" [LXX Ps. 117:26]; Verse: "O give thanks unto the Lord, for He is good" [LXX Ps. 117:1]. Epistle to Titus: [Titus 2:11–14; 3:4–7]. Alleluia, Tone 4: "Bring unto the Lord, O ye sons of God" [LXX Ps. 28:1]; Verse: "The voice of the Lord is upon the waters" [LXX Ps. 28:3]. Gospel from Matthew: "At that time, comes Jesus [from Galilee to Jordan unto John]..." [Mt. 3:13–17]. Kinonikon: "The grace of God that brings salvation hath appeared unto all men" [Titus 2:11]. And there is consolation for the brethren, eating fish and oil.*

items.section: At Vespers: we do not chant the Kathisma. Stichera: 3 of the feast, 3 of the Forerunner; Glory, Tone 6: "The bodily luminary..."; Both now, Tone 6: "God the Word appeared...". Entrance. Great Prokeimenon, Tone 7: "Our God is in heaven and on earth: He hath done whatsoever He pleased" [LXX Ps. 113:11]; Verses: 1. "In the exodus of Israel out of Egypt..." [LXX Ps. 113:1]; 2. "The sea saw and fled..." [LXX Ps. 113:3]; 3. "What ailed thee, O thou sea, that thou fleddest?..." [LXX Ps. 113:5]. But if it be Saturday [evening]: "The Lord reigns..." [LXX Ps. 92:1]. Верьне ст҃не ловї. ст҃ры. г҃. праꙁн̃. г҃. пр̃тчи. сла̃ гла ѕ҃. плотное свѣтило. і нн҃ы гл҃ ѕ҃. бг҃ъ слово ꙗви. выхо̃ про̃ гла ꙁ҃. бг҃ъ же нашь на нб҃си и̑ на земл̑и. г҃. въсходѣ їи҃лвѣ. г҃. море видѣ. г҃ что ти е̃ море. а̑ще бѫде̃ в сѫбо̃. гь̃ въ цр҃и сѧ. на сти. по̃ г҃. гл̃а д҃. ꙗко видѣша тѧ грѧдоу ща. сти же. г̑ лили. море видѣ. чт̃ѡ ти е̃ море. сла̃ гл̃а д҃. ꙗко ду̃ха рачи. і нн҃ы праꙁ то. гла. тро̃ пр̃тчи. гла в҃. памѧть пра ведникоу с похвалами, и̑ псилнь въꙁ дисвь ны. сла̃ і нн҃ы праꙁнико̃. на оу̑трьни. тро̃ праꙁни̃. в҃. сла̃ пр̃тчи. і нн҃ы праꙁн̃. по ка ꙁивѣ. сѣ̃ праꙁнико̃. кано̃. праꙁнико̃. на ѕ҃. и̑ пр̃тчи. на ѕ҃. по г҃. їпѣ. ко̃ праꙁнико̃ по ѕ҃. ко̃ гла ѕ҃. Плотьскаго ти х҃е прише ствїꙗ оу̑боꙗвся їѡрданъ. съ страхо̃ вьꙁ вращааше. пррⷱтьское же слоуженїе съвръ шиѧ їѡ̃а. трепето̃ ѡ̑прѧташе. а̑ггльстїи

items.slavonic_text: и̑ ст҃го ѡц҃а маркелїна. в коу. праꙁ. и̑ сты. тро̃. мч̃нкъ тво. на оу̃. по г҃. пѣ ко̃. сѣто гла д҃. Вл̃ка преклонь оу̑бѡ въ їѡрданѣ главоу. скроуши ѕмїевы главы. страда льца же главѣ оу̑сѣкши несльстивыи паде̃: — і҃. И̑ же въ сты ѡц҃а нашего григорьꙗ. єп̃па ни сьскаго. и̑ ст҃го доменьтиа. єп̃па мелентїн скаго. и̑ прп̃бнаго ѡц҃а нашего, маркиꙗна. поетсѧ. въ слѣдованїе єго папаверницн. тро̃. гла̃ д҃. бг҃ъ ѡць наши. сла і нн҃ѣ пра ꙁн̃. на оу̃ кано̃ праꙁникоу. и̑ сты. по г҃. пѣ̃ тро̃. гла а҃. ликь а̑ггль. Ѡ̑колды дшевнымы вьдѧ ст҃лю. бодръ пастырь ꙗвисѧ мирови. жеꙁломь премꙋдрости тво еѧ. и̑ теплымь прѣстательстводь си. всѧ ѡ̑гналь еси ꙁлославныѧ ꙗко волкы. невре димо съблюди стадо. григорье премꙋдре: — по ѕ҃. праꙁн̃. на сти. все праꙁн̃. на лур ѡни праꙁн. пѣ г҃. и̑ ст҃о ѕ҃. про̃. въсхва

items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 1, Podoben: "The angelic choir" (Ликъ ангельскій):* *Beholding with the eyes of the soul, O hierarch, thou wast revealed unto the world as a vigilant shepherd: by the rod of thy wisdom and by this thy fervent intercession, thou hast driven away all the ill-believing like wolves; keep the flock unharmed, O most wise Gregory!*

provenance.verbatim_source:

Прп̃бнаго ѡц҃а на̃шего ѳедось ꙗ. началника общежитью. Ве́рь. бл̃жнь мѫжь. ст҃ры. и̑ ст҃го на ѕ҃. гл̃а е҃. прп̃бь не ѡ̃че. і нн̃ праꙁ̃. выхо̃. про дню. чт̃еа г҃ прп̃бны ѡ̑бцїи. на сти п праꙁни̃. сла̃ и̑ по кыи множество. і н̃ праꙁни̃. тро̃ с леꙁьтео се̃ г҃. сла̃ і нн̃ы праꙁни̃. на оу̑трн тр̃о п ра ꙁни̃ в҃. сла̃ ст̃о. і нн̃ы праꙁни̃. по каꙁма сѣ̃ праꙁни̃. и̑ много мл̃тивьин. сѣ̃кн ст̃ог̃. те дго, гла̃са. про̃ чтна прѣ гд̃ь. сти. что въз ꙁдамь. єѵ̃лїе. ѿ лоу̃. в па̃ к҃. не̃. в въ ѡ̑но вре, ста їс̃ на мѣстѣ ѱл̃ѡ н҃. с тро̃а. и̑ ст҃го. ка̃п праꙁникоу на ѕ҃. и̑ ст҃го на ѕ. катавасьꙗ. глоубинѣ. по г҃. пѣ̃ к̃он ст҃ гла̃ и҃. Насажень въ дворы гн҃ꙗ. своꙗ при подобныꙗ добродѣтелни и̑ꙁрастиль еси.

items.slavonic_text: и̑ оу̑множилъ еси чада своꙗ въ поустыни. и̑ слѣꙁами твоихъ исто̑чникы напаꙗеши стадо началникь бж҃твьныхъ дворовь. тѣм же ꙁовемь ти радꙋи сѧ ѡче нашь федо сїе: — та̃ сѣ̃ и̑ ст҃го. сла̃ і нн҃ѣ праꙁникоу. по ѕ҃. к̃о праꙁникꙋ. по ѳ҃. свѣ̃ праꙁн̃. и̑ ст҃го. на хва. пѡ̃. и̑ ст҃го. на д҃. сла̃. гла в҃. добродѣтелна лѣствица. і нн҃ пра ꙁнико̃. дн҃ь х҃съ въ їѡрданѣ. славословь е великое. ѡ́ктеньꙗ. ѡ̑пꙋ. на лїтоургїи ѡ̑ канѡ̃ праꙁникꙋ. на ѕ҃. ст҃ого. ѕ҃. про̃. чт̃на прѣ гд̃ь. стн. что въздамь. а҃пл. не̃ е҃і. а̑ллилуна. бл̃жень мѫжь ко ꙗи. г҃. силно на ꙁемли. єѵ̃е ѿ м̃а в че̃ г҃ н҃е. ре̃ гь̃ всѧ кн̃ в па̃. Стыꙗ мц̃нци, татьꙗны. в кꙋ праꙁ̃ ст҃ыꙗ на ли праꙁ̃. ст҃ыꙗ ликь е̃ рдѡлы и̑не ст҃р то пнка. въ днь поетса савва понеко, д҃і ѿдае̃т праꙁ̃ с҃тое бо̃ꙗвлеа ве̃ с тр̃ сл̃. савва сл̃ г҃ и̑. прп̃бніи ѡц҃и. і н̃ праꙁ̃

items.slavonic_text: на ст̃и. праꙁни̃. сла̃ гл̃а и҃. равноа҃гг̃лѡ̃ і нн҃ѣ праꙁни̃. тро̃. мч̃нцн твои. сла̃ і нн҃ы праꙁни̃. на оу̃. ка̃ праꙁни̃. на ѕ҃. и̑ сты. д҃ва по г҃. пѣ̃ ко̃ гл̃а в҃. в вышныхъ: — Ѡ мира сего мѧтежа ѡ̑бѣжасте и̑ к тихо моу оу̑строенїю приложистесѧ. мч҃еньꙗ кровми. и̑ въꙁдръжаньꙗ болѣꙁньми вѣн чаеми. тѣм же ꙗвистесѧ мч̃нкомь. и̑ прѣ подобны[м]ь є̑динокровиници: — по ѕ҃. пра ꙁни. кѡ̃. на ст̃и. п праꙁникоу. сла̃ ла и҃. бл̃женї есте. і нн҃ѣ праꙁн̃. на лїтоургїи ѡ̃ кано̃. праꙁни̃. пѣ̃ г҃. и̑ сты[х] ѡц҃ь ѕ̃ л. про̃. дивень бг҃ъ. стн въ цр҃къва. а̑пль. не̃. л҃г. а̑ллилуна. възъваша праведнїи єѵ̃лїе. ѡ̑ лоу̃. в па̃ в҃ не̃. кн̃. радоуит. д҃і прп̃бныхъ ѡ̑ц҃ъ наши, авва да. венїамина и̑ ф҃ вїꙁбїеныхь. вечерь ст҃ры. г҃. праꙁ. подва. гл̃а в҃. просвѣтителю нашего сла̃ і нн҃ѣ. преклонилъ еси главоу. пр̃о.

items.english_text: *Glory, Both now, Theotokion. At Matins: 3 Kathismata; and the Polyeleos; Sessional hymns of the saint; Sessional hymn of the 4th Tone. Prokeimenon: "Precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of His saints" [LXX Ps. 115:6]; Verse: "What shall I render unto the Lord for all that He hath rendered unto me?" [LXX Ps. 115:3]. "Let every breath praise the Lord" [LXX Ps. 150:6]. Gospel from Luke, in memory of the 2nd Sunday [Lk. 6:17–23]. Psalm 50 [LXX Ps. 50:3]; Sticheron of the saint. Canon of the Mother of God with its heirmos to 6, Tone 8: "Holding fast amidst many [temptations]...", and of the saint to 8. After Ode 3, Sessional hymn of the saint. After Ode 6, Kontakion, Tone 8: "In thy precious nativity the creation found joy, and in the divine..."*[^379]

Бг҃оꙗвлению звѣздоу вѣрѣ. иже по х҃ꙋ оу҆срьдно пострадавшаго. похвалимь. вѣнцемь достоино вѣнчае̄мь. неофи та. ѡ пазꙋющихъ. молѧщесѧ х҃ви. при днета радость даеть списали. и иными кто же накы: ~ Тажь. сѣдѣ. тыихь. по ѕ҃. ко. маѯиму. гла ѕ҃. Свѣтъ трисиѧнныи вселивыисѧ въ дш҃ю твою. съсъдъ избране нь показа тѧ преблж҃ене. сказающа бж҃твьнаꙗ концем. неоудобьразоумнаꙗ премд҃ре. и трц҃ю всѣмь ꙗсно проповѣдалъ свѣтлопре соущьноу. и безначалную: ~ На стихо внѣ. въ ѡхтоико. сла гла ѕ҃. items.english_text: *Kontakion, Tone 6:* *As a star of the Epiphany of the faith, let us praise Neophytus who zealously suffered for Christ, worthily crowning Him with a crown, crying: Praying unto Christ, come, He gives the joy of salvation!*

items.slavonic_text: мч҃нка, а҆настасьꙗ перьсанина. Вечерь. ст҃ры. ст҃ы. на ѕ҃. Сла. гла и҃. Едъпове лѣныи. і нн҃ы бг҃о. На стихѡ. и глалъ. сти въ въсѧ землѧ. та самогласень. гла а҃. свѣтилника. Сла гла в҃. Възвеличилъ еси х҃е. і нн҃ѣ бг҃о. Тро: Благости навыкъ. ѻк. г҃. Сла: Мч҃нкъ тво. На ꙋ кано въ ѡ. ст҃ы. два. по ѕ҃. пѣ ко. гла д҃. Бж҃твь наго оу҆ч҃нка. и съоу҆зьника павлова. тимоѳ ѳѣꙗ вѣрніи въспоимъ въси. съ нимъ почи тающа мѫдраго анастасьꙗ. просиѧвша го ѿ персиды ꙗко же звѣзда. и ѿгонѧща дꙋ шевныꙗ нашѧ страсти и недꙋгы телесныꙗ. На стихѡ. та сти. Праведникъ ꙗко фини къ процвѣтеть. и поють: самогласны. гл҃ а҃. Сла гла е҃. Прпбне ѡч҃е побѣдникъ даи домь. і нн҃ѣ бг҃о. На лѵургіи. въ ѡ. и ѡ ка апл҃оу. пѣ ѕ҃. Про. Въ въсѧ землѧ изы. Апл҃ь. к тимо. Чадо тимоѳею хвалю бг҃а.
items.english_text: *Kontakion, Tone 4:* *The divine disciple and fellow-prisoner of Paul, Timothy, let all of us faithful hymn, honoring with him the wise Anastasius, who shone forth from Persia as a star, and drives away our spiritual passions and bodily sicknesses!*

Дѣва днь. Бг҃ословнымь ꙗзыко своимь. плетеніа витѣискаꙗ разорилъ еси славне. православіа ѡдежею. свышенѣ исть каною. цр҃ковь ѡдѣꙗлъ еси: ꙗже и носѧще спасивъ, възываемъ ти съ своими чады: ра доуисѧ ѿче, бг҃ословьноу оу҆ме свершеный: ~ сѣдѣ. на хва по г҃. гл҃ д҃. Званыи свыш. и сѫгꙋбы г҃. гл҃ д҃. Бж҃твны. и ина два. сла гл҃а а҃. Цѣвницю дх҃овноую. і нн҃ кѡ҃. Славословье великое. тро ст҃о. ѻк те са. ѿпꙋ. и даетсѧ ст҃ое масло. На ли. ѿ ка пѣ г҃ и ѕ҃. про г҃а Оу҆ста моꙗ возг҃лю. апл и сѧб к҃. и ли в ж к҃. г҃. к ра аллилю бговы. аллуа. г҃. к въжелѣ телніе. еѵе ѿ іѡа. с е г҃ регь ꙗзъ есмь. ки в пам.
items.english_text: *Kontakion, Tone 3, Podoben: "Today the Virgin" (Дѣва днесь):* *By thy theological tongue thou didst dissolve the rhetorical entanglements, O glorious one; with the garment of Orthodoxy woven from on high thou hast clothed the Church; which also wearing salvation, we cry unto thee with thy children: Rejoice, O father, perfect theological mind!*

At the Praises: Prosomoia 3, Tone 4, Podoben: "Called from on high" (Званый свыше); and repeated 3, Tone 4: "Divine...", and two others; Glory, Tone 1: "The spiritual flute..."; Both now, Theotokion. Инъ. Испо лненїе дха. сего мц҃а ке. Инъ. Излиасѧ
