items.slavonic_text: і҃ н҃ . гл҃а ѕ҃ . роѡбразꙋя и сти҃ . самогланки г҃ гл҃ . а҃ . ꙗтискондане . сл҃а і҃ нн҃ѣ . гл҃а ѕ҃ . пе тра і ꙗкова . тр҃о гл҃а . з҃ . Преѡбразися на горѣ х҃е б҃е показа оучнкѡмь славꙋ свою . ꙗкоже можахоу . да въсияеть намь грѣшнымъ свѣтъ твои приносꙋщныи . мл҃ твами бц҃а свѣтодавче слава тобѣ :~ На велїкои вечерни . Бл҃жны мꙋж . На ги҃ възъва поемь стихы . и҃ . с самогланкы д҃ . празн . подба . гл҃ д҃ . Преже распятіа . сл҃а і҃ н҃ . гл҃а ѕ҃ . Проѡ бразꙋя . Вьхо҃ . пр҃о дн҃и того . и чт҃еа г҃ . д҃ва . ѿ исхода . рече гь к моисею въниди къ мнѣ . гл҃а гь къ моисею лице к лицю . по цр҃ства г҃ . то въсходи прижденліа . На исхоже . с агл҃нки . праз г҃ . гл҃ в҃ . сл҃ гл҃а е҃ Придѣте взидѣмь . і҃ н҃ . гл҃ е . Законоу и пр҃рк На сти҃ агл҃нки г҃ . гл҃ а҃ . е҃ . тїиже гли . т҃ко ꙗко тынѣса фаворьиерл҃о . сла і ны . гл҃а ѕ҃ . Петра и ꙗкова . тр҃о . прз г҃ ж҃ . Вл҃венье

items.slavonic_text: хлѣбо и чт҃ее похвала праз . на оу҃р тро праз г҃ . ѡбыі стихоловье . На многомл҃тивы . т҃ѣ . праз и чт҃ее к книгы ѡсл҃аа е ло . н҃ѕ . и н҃з . сте гл҃ д҃ . про҃ . Фаворь и ермо҃н ѡ твоемь оу невса . вся ды . єѵе ѡ лоу . в тъ врѣмя поꙗть іс҃ и цѣлоуе єѵлне . въскереніе хв҃о не глиамь . канона два . г҃ па козмы и г҃ и ѡана . гл҃а д҃ и гл҃а и҃ . і҃ рл҃о . п одва ж . и тро . по д . ж . катавас . кр҃та начерта . ѡ ба лика во коупѣ . по г҃ . пѣнѣ сѣда пра зникоу . по ѕ҃ . кѡ҃ . гл҃а . з҃ самоглань :~ На горѣ прѣѡбразися ꙗкоже въмѣщахꙋ оученници твои славꙋ твою х҃е б҃е видѣша . да егда тя оузрятъ распинаема . стра сть оубѡ разоумѣють влънжю . миро ви же проповѣдять . ꙗко ты еси въисти нноу ѡтче сияніе :~ На ѳ҃ пѣ дають ся свѣщи и браи . чт҃нѣишꙋ не стихослови сѣвѣ праз г҃ ж на хва поки г
items.english_text: *Troparion of the feast thrice. Ordinary psalmody [Kathismata]. At the Polyeleos: Sessional hymns of the feast, and reading from the books of St. John Chrysostom, Homilies 56 and 57.*[^464] *Gradual, Tone 4. Prokeimenon, Tone 4: "Tabor and Hermon shall rejoice in Thy name" [Ps. 88:13]. Verse: "Thine are the heavens" [Ps. 88:12]. "Let every breath..." Gospel from Luke [9:28–36]: "At that time, Jesus took Peter [and John and James]..." And we kiss the Gospel. "Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ" we do not say. Two canons: of master Cosmas [Tone 4] and of master John [Tone 8]; heirmoi twice, and troparia four times. Katabasia: "Tracing the Cross," both choirs together. After Ode 3, Sessional hymn of the feast. After Ode 6, Kontakion, Tone 7, Idiomelon:*[^465]

items.english_text: *At Ode 9, candles are given to the brethren. "More honorable" is not sung. Exapostilarion of the feast thrice. On the Praises, Stichera again 3...* *...of the feast on 4, Tone 4: "Called from on high"; Glory, and now, Tone 8: "Christ took Peter..." Great Doxology. Troparion of the feast, litany, dismissal, and holy oil is given to the brethren. At the Hours: Troparion and Kontakion of the feast. At the Liturgy: from the canons, Ode 3 and Ode 6. Prokeimenon, Tone 4: "O Lord, how magnified are Thy works; in wisdom hast Thou made them all" [Ps. 103:24]. Epistle from the Catholic Epistle of Peter [2 Pet. 1:10–19]: "Brethren, give diligence to make your calling and election sure..." Alleluia, Tone 8: "Thine are the heavens, and Thine is the earth" [Ps. 88:12]; verse: "Blessed is the people that know the joyful sound" [Ps. 88:16]. Gospel from Matthew [17:1–9]: "At that time, Jesus takes Peter, James, and John His brother..." Communion Hymn: "O Lord, in the light of Thy countenance shall they walk, and in Thy name shall they rejoice unto ages [Ps. 88:16–17]. Alleluia."*[^466]

items.slavonic_text: праз . на . д҃ . гл҃а д҃ . Званыи свы . сл҃а і҃ н҃ѣ гл҃а и҃ . поꙗть хс҃ петра . с ласловне великое тр҃о . праз ѡктеа . ѿпꙋ . и дает ся сїтое ма сло браи на часѣ . тр҃о . іко҃ праз . па ли ѡ ка пѣ . г҃ . и ѕ҃ . про . гл҃а д . ꙗко възвеличиша ся дѣла твоꙗ ги҃ а҃плъ ѡ скорна посла ніа петрова . Браіе потщитен зкѣсто аллꙋ гл҃а . и҃ . Т воꙗ сꙋть нб҃са с҃ бл҃жни люе . єѵліе ѡ ма҃ . къ в врѣмя поꙗ іс҃ . кн . въ свѣтѣ славы лица твоего гни пойде . и ѡ имени тво емь възрадꙋ емся къ вѣкы . а҃лава . По баеть вѣдати ꙗко преданіемь дїавоспетныи праз . преѡбраженіа . въкꙋшати стафи ль ꙗже блгв҃іе преѡбрѣа приємлющен млтвꙋ по окончаніи бжтвеныꙗ литоргиа . и по преломленіи . сирѣчь по раздаваніи доры . гл҃тся . тр҃о преѡбразися . сла . і нн҃ѣ кѡ҃ на горѣ пресѡбрази сниже гл҃ть їереи кадить . та їерѣ . гоу помолимся .
items.english_text: *It is meet to know that according to tradition, on the celebrated feast of the Transfiguration it is appointed to eat grapes, which receiving blessing through prayer at the conclusion of the Divine Liturgy, and after the breaking of bread, that is, after the distribution of the antidoron, there is said: Troparion, "Thou wast transfigured..."; Glory, and now, Kontakion: "Thou wast transfigured upon the mountain..."; while this is being said, the priest censes. Then the priest [says]: "Let us pray to the Lord."*[^467]

items.slavonic_text: мы же ги помилоу е рѣи мл҃твоу сию . Г҃и б҃е нашь иже прежде на землю цвѣты доброоудобривь . и плодоносне мнжа дивь вселице емоу красилъ еси . пакы же съставляя четырьми землю то же исте ченнеми росы . нее же ѿ въздуха ѡрошая и прохлажая , и теплотою слнечною . къ съзрѣнію плоды . сиꙗ приспѣти благово лилъ еси . благослови сна своею сне блгтью ꙗко да бждеть намь въ веселіе . и въ блго дарение невещиленѣ и въ крѣпости дръжавы твоея , и того ради приносити хвалоу . въ ѡчищение прегрѣшенни нашии , единою ст҃ои животворящаго тѣла . и крови га нашего їѵ҃ х҃а , възлюбленнаго твоего сна . с нимже блвнъ еси , съ прстмъ . и блгымь и животворящимь ти дх҃ѡ . нн ди прно :~ Се же вѣсто бждн . аще кто ѡ брати въкоуснть ѡ стафиль прежде такого праздника .

items.english_text: *And let this be known: If any of the brethren taste of the grapes prior to such feast...* *...let him receive a penance, namely, by this penance not to taste grapes for the entire month of August, as a transgressor of the ordinance, that he may learn to observe these things. And let this tradition be kept always also by the vinedressers. And grapes at the refectory after the feast are served thrice in the week, the brethren tasting thereof at the noon meal; and likewise let it be done with other fruits in their proper season.*[^469]

Се же пре даніе да держит ся всегда и на дѣлатели винограда . а мн стафиль а на трапезѣ по празднꙋцѣ . г҃ ж . в нели . прѣлагают ся . г҃ ж ѡни . въкоушающе браи . в пл҃е . врѣ . в лак т ѡго бываети на прочии ѡвощии . в ъ свое врѣ мя :~ Ст҃го прп҃бном . доментиа . ве҃р не сти҃локи На ги възъва поки г҃ п раз гл҃ д҃ Званыи свыше и с҃ гл҃ и҃ . проѡбразꙋя выхо҃ про гл҃ з҃ . Б҃ъ нашъ на нб҃си . и на земли с҃ въ исходи їилевѣ . Море видѣ въ побѣ на сти поки . праз . ꙗстискондаи . сла і н придѣте възыдемь . тр҃о . мч҃нкъ твои сла . і ны праздн . items.slavonic_text: + и братьи поющимъ . и ѡбъходитъ въноу три монастыря . и прѣ . и въ игоуменю кѣ лью . и въ трапезоу . и в келарню . и в пова рню в пекленицю в житницю в погребы . и въ вся кѣльи братьскыꙗ . и възвращь шеся :~ Поемь а҃ . ча . и бываетъ сверше нныи ѿпоу . на лу҃ . т҃ . пѣ҃ г҃ . на д҃ . и кр҃ту ѕ҃ . на д҃ . тр҃о кр҃тоу . с҃ . сл҃ ко҃ . с҃ . і нн҃ѣ . кр҃тоу . ко . про гл҃ в҃ . сп҃си ги люди своꙗ . сти҃ . к тебѣ ги . і нь . стыи же с҃ . а҃пл кр҃тоу . в па . велиныи . с҃ . пе . всѣ ст҃ы . аллуиа . гла а . помяни семль твои . с҃ . б҃ъ же црь нашъ . і нь въззваша праведни . єѵе кр҃ту . ѿ іѡа се ді . въ ѡ , съвѣтъ сътвориши . и сты єѵе . пе всѣ сты . кн . знаменами пасеѣ . дро радоуйтеся . вътъи же днь по ве҃рни възимает ся іереѡ чтное дрѣво . и носило бываетъ в содохра нилищю . съ свѣщами . и с кандиломь .

items.english_text: *He takes up the Precious Wood with the dish upon his head, and goes forth by the northern side out of the altar, two great candles going before him with a censer; and he comes unto the Royal Doors, and there stands awaiting the conclusion of the Trisagion. And the Trisagion being concluded, the deacon proclaims: "Wisdom! Stand upright!" The brethren chant the troparion: "Save, O Lord, Thy people," chanting it once. And the priest comes, bearing the Precious Wood, before the Holy Doors to a prepared table, and lays it upon the table, and censes. Water having been prepared in a vessel, troparia are chanted in order; the priest blesses the water. After the blessing of the water and the sprinkling of the sanctified water, he makes veneration to the Precious Wood, in ordinary order, bowing down thrice; after this, litany, dismissal.*[^475]

items.slavonic_text: на оу҃ кано в ъ ѡ . на ѕ҃ . и препраз҃ . на д҃ . и ст҃о на д҃ . по г҃ . пѣ тѣ с[ѣдаленъ] ст҃о . сла і н прѣ празне . по ѕ҃ . ко҃ гл҃а д҃ . Въ славнѣи па мати твоей . вселенаꙗ невещественныимь свѣтѡмь оукрашена . ѡудмно съ веселіемь зоветь текѣ . радꙋися дѣво хртїанѡмь по хвала :~ на сти ѡ . сл҃ і н гл҃а г҃ . пртекъ ен конци землѧ . е҃і Оуспеніе пртыꙗ бца . пра знꙋемь ве дн҃ь . пѣніекъсенощное . на ма лои вечерни . стры праз на д҃ сл҃ і н сагл҃ны праз . на сти праз . тро гл҃а а҃ . Въ ржтвѣ двыство , съхранила еси . въ оуспеніи мли ра не ѡставила еси бце . преставлена къ животоу . мт҃не щи живота . мл҃твами тво ими избавляеши ѡт съмр҃ти дш҃а нша :~ На вели кон вечерни . Бл҃женыи мꙋжь . На ги възъва поемь стихы . и҃ . стры . д҃ . праз . гл҃а а҃ . О дивное чюдо . и н҃ г҃ . тїже по в҃ . сл҃ і н҃ . гл҃а а҃ . Богоначалныимь . Выхо҃ про дню
items.english_text: *Kontakion of the Forefeast:* In thy glorious memory the universe, adorned with immaterial light, spiritually with gladness cries unto thee: Rejoice, O Virgin, boast of Christians!

items.english_text: *Troparion:* In giving birth Thou didst preserve Thy virginity; in falling asleep Thou didst not forsake the world, O Mother of God. Thou hast passed over unto life, being the Mother of Life, and by Thy prayers Thou dost deliver our souls from death!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
In giving birth Thou didst preserve Thy virginity; in falling asleep Thou didst not forsake the world, O Mother of God. Thou hast passed over unto life, being the Mother of Life, and by Thy prayers Thou dost deliver our souls from death!

items.slavonic_text: чт҃еа г҃ . празникову . На исхоженіе . само гл҃ны . г҃ . гл҃а а҃ . и гл҃а в҃ . и гл҃а г҃ . слава гл҃а е҃ . прте празнослюбци . і н҃ . въспоите лїе . На сти самогл҃нь гл҃а д҃ . сти же гли въскр҃ни гни въ покои твои . клѧт ся гь да выдови . сл҃а і ны гл҃ д҃ . егда изыде бце по тр҃толь . тр҃о празни . г лется г жвы . Бл҃веніе хлѣбоѡмь . и чтеніе в метафрастѣ . житїе , прѣстыꙗ бца . На оу҃ тр҃о . празни . г ж҃ . ѡбыное ст҃исловіе . На многомл҃тивы т҃ѣ празни . сте гл҃а д҃ . про гл҃ д҃ . помѧ ноу имя твое . сти . слыши дщи . всѧко дыханіе . єѵліе ѡ лоу . въ ѡ врема , въ ставши маріаль . стра . празни . гл҃а . ѕ҃ . Егда преставленіе . Канона два . г҃ па ко змы . гна іѡа . ірль . по в҃ . а трорѣ . на , в҃і . послѣ . ірль ѡ бою . канѡ . ѡ ба лика в кꙋ҃ . по единою . по г҃ . пѣ ѵпакои . бла жильдъ тя въси роди . по ѕ҃ . кѡ҃ . гл҃а в҃ . з҃и

items.english_text: *Troparion of the feast thrice. Ordinary psalmody [Kathismata]. At the Polyeleos: Sessional hymns of the feast. Gradual, Tone 4. Prokeimenon, Tone 4: "I will remember Thy name" [Ps. 44:18]; verse: "Give ear, O daughter, and consider, and incline thine ear" [Ps. 44:11]. "Let every breath..." Gospel from Luke [1:39–49, 56]: "In those days, Mary arose..." Sticheron of the feast, Tone 6: "When the passing..." Two canons: of master Cosmas [Tone 1] and of master John [Tone 4]; heirmoi twice, and troparia on 12; afterwards the heirmos of both canons both choirs together once. After Ode 3, Hypakoe: "All generations shall call thee blessed." After Ode 6, Kontakion, Tone 2.*

items.section: At Matins
items.season_or_tone: PART III: MENOLOGION
items.day_or_date: On the 6th day: The Holy Transfiguration of Our Lord God and Savior Jesus Christ:*[^461]
items.slavonic_text: Въ мл҃твахъ неоусыпающꙋю бц҃ю · и въ за стꙋпленіе непрелагаемое оупованіе · гробъ и оумрътвіе неоудържаста · ꙗкоже бо живота мт҃рь на животъ прѣстави · иже въ оутробꙋ въселивыисѧ приснодѣвьственꙋю :~ На ѳ҃ · пѣ даютьсѧ свѣщи браи · чт҃нѣишю не сти словимъ · свѣт празн҃ г҃ · на хва҃ поки г҃ · празн҃ гл҃а д҃ · на ѕ҃ · сл҃а і нн҃ѣ · гл҃а ѕ҃ · на бессмрътное твое · славословье великое · тр҃оп празн҃ · ѿктен҃ ѿпоу҃ · и даетсѧ с҃тое масло браи · На лїтоургіи · празн҃ · пѣ г҃ · и ѕ҃ · про҃ гл҃а г҃ · пѣ бц҃и величить дша моꙗ · сти · ꙗко призрѣ · апл҃ь · къ филипписеѡ · Брае сье да мꙋдр҃ · аллуи · гл҃а и҃ · въскрни ги҃ въ покои · сти · Клѧтсѧ гь дв҃дꙋ · єѵе · ѿ лоу · въ тѡ врѣмя вниде іс҃ · к҃н · Чашю · аще празноуетжесѧ праздникъ сеи · ѳ҃ · дн҃ий · оуставъ же ѡ межоупразнествѣ · въписань въ главахъ :~
items.english_text: *Kontakion of the Falling Asleep of the Most Holy Theotokos [Tone 2]:*[^479] In prayers the sleepless Mother of God, and in intercessions an unfailing hope, neither the grave nor death could hold; for as the Mother of Life, He Who dwelt in Her ever-virgin womb translated Her unto life!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Kontakion of the Falling Asleep of the Most Holy Theotokos [Tone 2]:*[^479]
In prayers the sleepless Mother of God, and in intercessions an unfailing hope, neither the grave nor death could hold; for as the Mother of Life, He Who dwelt in Her ever-virgin womb translated Her unto life!

items.english_text: *At the Liturgy: for the feast, from the canons, Ode 3 and Ode 6. Prokeimenon, Tone 3: Song of the Mother of God: "My soul doth magnify the Lord" [Luke 1:46]; Verse: "For He hath regarded [the low estate of His handmaiden]" [Luke 1:48]. Epistle to the Philippians [2:5–11]: "Brethren, let this mind be in you..." Alleluia, Tone 8: "Arise, O Lord, into Thy rest" [Ps. 131:8]; Verse: "The Lord hath sworn unto David" [Ps. 131:11]. Gospel from Luke [10:38–42; 11:27–28]: "At that time, Jesus entered into a certain village..." Communion Hymn: "I will take the cup of salvation [and call upon the name of the Lord]" [Ps. 115:4].*[^480]

items.english_text: *Troparion of the Holy Mandylion:* We venerate Thy most pure Icon, O Good One, asking forgiveness of our transgressions, O Christ God; for of Thine own will Thou wast pleased to ascend the Cross in the flesh, to deliver them whom Thou hadst created from the bondage of the enemy. Therefore thankfully we cry unto Thee: Having filled all things with joy, O our tender-hearted Savior, Who didst come to save the world!

items.english_text: *Kontakion of the Holy Mandylion:* He Who descended from heaven for the compassions of mercy, O tender-hearted Savior, Thou hast today given the honorable image of Thy most pure flesh unto the city that honors Thee and unto the Christian people as a treasure as a steadfast full armor, from which drawing sanctification, with fervent faith we embrace it!

provenance.verbatim_source:

...as a steadfast full armor, from which drawing sanctification, with fervent faith we embrace it!

items.slavonic_text: далъ еси · ꙗко тверъдое въсе ѡрꙋжіе · ѡ не гоже почръпающе стыню · вѣрою тепле · ѡбъемлюмь :~ На стиховнѣ все праздникъ · С҃того мч҃ника мѵрона · пѣніе въ коу·пѣ же не гл҃емь · до ѿданіа праздника · С҃тꙋю мчн кꙋ фрола и лавра · пѣніе в коу · празднкꙋ · И ст҃ы · С҃тго мч҃ника · андрѣꙗ стратилата и иже съ нимь · двѣ тысещи · и · ф҃ · и · н҃ · и · г҃ · С҃тго пр҃рка самоила · пѣніе в коу · тр҃о · пр҃о рока твоего · глас а҃ · сл҃а і нн҃ празн҃ · кѡ҃ с҃тго гл҃а г҃ · Ꙗко драгыи и чт҃ныи дарь · пре же зачатна въ данъ бы[сть] · и з млада томоу ꙗко аг҃глъ послоуживъ всеблажене и сподобн сѧ бꙋдꙋщаꙗ вѣщати · тѣмь въпіемъ ти радоусѧ пр҃рче бж҃іи самоиле · архїерѣю ве ликыи :~ С҃тго апл҃а фадѣꙗ · и мч҃ннци васи лисы · С҃тго мч҃нка агафоника · въ тъ днь поетсѧ стл҃пꙋ · ст҃ры · ѡбоюкꙋ въ · д҃ · с҃то · і нн҃ празн҃ · на сти · все празн҃ · тр҃о ·

items.slavonic_text: далъ еси · ꙗко тверъдое въсе ѡрꙋжіе · ѡ не гоже почръпающе стыню · вѣрою тепле · ѡбъемлюмь :~ На стиховнѣ все праздникъ · С҃того мч҃ника мѵрона · пѣніе въ коу·пѣ же не гл҃емь · до ѿданіа праздника · С҃тꙋю мчн кꙋ фрола и лавра · пѣніе в коу · празднкꙋ · И ст҃ы · С҃тго мч҃ника · андрѣꙗ стратилата и иже съ нимь · двѣ тысещи · и · ф҃ · и · н҃ · и · г҃ · С҃тго пр҃рка самоила · пѣніе в коу · тр҃о · пр҃о рока твоего · глас а҃ · сл҃а і нн҃ празн҃ · кѡ҃ с҃тго гл҃а г҃ · Ꙗко драгыи и чт҃ныи дарь · пре же зачатна въ данъ бы[сть] · и з млада томоу ꙗко аг҃глъ послоуживъ всеблажене и сподобн сѧ бꙋдꙋщаꙗ вѣщати · тѣмь въпіемъ ти радоусѧ пр҃рче бж҃іи самоиле · архїерѣю ве ликыи :~ С҃тго апл҃а фадѣꙗ · и мч҃ннци васи лисы · С҃тго мч҃нка агафоника · въ тъ днь поетсѧ стл҃пꙋ · ст҃ры · ѡбоюкꙋ въ · д҃ · с҃то · і нн҃ празн҃ · на сти · все празн҃ · тр҃о ·

items.slavonic_text: мч҃нци твои ги҃ · сл҃а і нн҃ празн҃ · на оутр҃ · тр҃о празн҃ в҃ · сл҃а с҃тго · і нн҃ праз҃ · сѣ праздн҃ · кано празн҃ на ѕ҃ · и с҃ты два · по г҃ · пѣ кѡ҃ с҃ты гл҃а д҃ · ликъ аг҃гльскыи · Званіе бл҃го стажавъ бг҃омꙋдре · мꙋже лꙋкавы ѿвратилъ еси не вѣры · неоубоꙗвсѧ мꙋкъ · агафоннке славне · тѣмже бысть бл҃гыимъ наслѣ дникъ · и приꙗлъ еси съ постражющиими с то бою достоиныи вѣнець :~ Та сѣ с҃ты · сл҃ і нн҃ праз҃ · по ѕ҃ · ко҃ и и҃кѡ · на стихи все праз҃ · С҃тго мч҃нка лоуппа · въ тъ днь ѿдава етсѧ праздникъ · верь · ѡбычно стихоловье · на ги҃ възъва · ст҃ры праздникꙋ на ѕ҃ · гл҃а а҃ · Ѡ дивеное чюдо · сл҃а і нн҃ бг҃оначалныимъ · аще е в па · вечерь · і нн҃ бг҃о а҃ · настоꙗщаго гл҃са · про҃ дн҃и того · без выхо · и без чтеа на сти праꙁ · гл҃ д҃ · сл҃ і нн҃ егда изыде бц҃е на оут҃ тр҃о г҃ · празн҃ · сѣ праздн҃ · ка два праз еди со ірм҃ль на и҃ и дроу съ ірм҃ль на ѕ҃ ·
items.english_text: *Kontakion of the Holy Martyr Agathonicus:* Having acquired a noble calling, O divinely-wise one, thou didst turn deceitful men from unbelief, fearing no torments, O glorious Agathonicus; therefore thou hast become an inheritor of good things, and hast received with those who suffered with thee a worthy crown!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Kontakion of the Holy Martyr Agathonicus:*
Having acquired a noble calling, O divinely-wise one, thou didst turn deceitful men from unbelief, fearing no torments, O glorious Agathonicus; therefore thou hast become an inheritor of good things, and hast received with those who suffered with thee a worthy crown!

Tone 3; Glory, and now, Kontakion, Tone 3:* A fellow-partaker with the Apostles and the beauty of the saints, as Eutyches thou didst glorify the apostolic rank; thou didst shine forth as a star, enlightening all, and didst dispel the deep night of godlessness; therefore we honor thee as truly a divine initiate of Christ!

*Troparion and Prokeimenon... Tone 3; Glory, and now, Kontakion, Tone 3:*
*Kontakion of the Holy Apostle Eutyches:*
A fellow-partaker with the Apostles and the beauty of the saints, as Eutyches thou didst glorify the apostolic rank; thou didst shine forth as a star, enlightening all, and didst dispel the deep night of godlessness; therefore we honor thee as truly a divine initiate of Christ!

items.slavonic_text: ап҃ла тита · оученнка с҃тго ап҃ла павла · въ слѣ дованіе ѡбою вкоу · тр҃о · Ап҃ле с҃тыи · сл҃а і нн҃ б҃о · на оут҃ ка к ъ ѡ · на ѕ҃ · и с҃ты д҃ва · по г҃ · пѣ ко҃ варѳоломеꙋ · и іпакои · по ѕ҃ · ко҃ титꙋ · гл҃а в҃ · Павловъ ꙗвисѧ спо собникъ ап҃ле · съ нимь намь слово провѣ звѣстилъ еси · бж҃твною бл҃гтью · таебниче тите всебл҃жене · сего ради въпіемъ ти непре стаи мл҃ѧ ѡ всѣхъ на[съ] :~ На лѵ҃ про въ всю зе млю · с҃ · Нб҃са повѣдатъ · ап҃ль · к титꙋ · Павелъ рабъ бж҃іи · ап҃лъ г҃а іс҃ х҃а · к титоу присномоу чадꙋ · аллуа · Исповѣдꙗтсѧ · єѵліе ѿ ма · нотб к҃г · ре гь вы есте свѣтъ · к н҃е Въ всю землю · С҃тыи мч҃никъи андріана и натальи · самогласенъи д҃ва · гл҃ а҃ · и гл҃ ѕ҃ · тр҃о Мч҃нци твои ги҃ · кѡ҃ гл҃а д҃ :~ Мч҃никъ въсна бж҃твнаꙗ памать · ꙗже дныꙗ ѡзарꙗꙗ всѧ конца свѣтло · съ весе ліемь зовꙋща · ты еси мл҃икохъ радованіе :~ Сего днь празноуеть праздникъ срѣтенію иконѣ пр[чстые] вл҃дчца наша бц҃а, иже гл҃ють володимерьскаꙗ.
items.english_text: *Kontakion of the Holy Apostle Titus:* Thou wast revealed as a fellow-worker with Paul, O Apostle; with him thou didst proclaim the Word unto us by divine grace, O initiate Titus, all-blessed; therefore we cry unto thee: Cease not praying for us all!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Kontakion of the Holy Apostle Titus:*
Thou wast revealed as a fellow-worker with Paul, O Apostle; with him thou didst proclaim the Word unto us by divine grace, O initiate Titus, all-blessed; therefore we cry unto thee: Cease not praying for us all!

items.slavonic_text: ап҃ла тита · оученнка с҃тго ап҃ла павла · въ слѣ дованіе ѡбою вкоу · тр҃о · Ап҃ле с҃тыи · сл҃а і нн҃ б҃о · на оут҃ ка к ъ ѡ · на ѕ҃ · и с҃ты д҃ва · по г҃ · пѣ ко҃ варѳоломеꙋ · и іпакои · по ѕ҃ · ко҃ титꙋ · гл҃а в҃ · Павловъ ꙗвисѧ спо собникъ ап҃ле · съ нимь намь слово провѣ звѣстилъ еси · бж҃твною бл҃гтью · таебниче тите всебл҃жене · сего ради въпіемъ ти непре стаи мл҃ѧ ѡ всѣхъ на[съ] :~ На лѵ҃ про въ всю зе млю · с҃ · Нб҃са повѣдатъ · ап҃ль · к титꙋ · Павелъ рабъ бж҃іи · ап҃лъ г҃а іс҃ х҃а · к титоу присномоу чадꙋ · аллуа · Исповѣдꙗтсѧ · єѵліе ѿ ма · нотб к҃г · ре гь вы есте свѣтъ · к н҃е Въ всю землю · С҃тыи мч҃никъи андріана и натальи · самогласенъи д҃ва · гл҃ а҃ · и гл҃ ѕ҃ · тр҃о Мч҃нци твои ги҃ · кѡ҃ гл҃а д҃ :~ Мч҃никъ въсна бж҃твнаꙗ памать · ꙗже дныꙗ ѡзарꙗꙗ всѧ конца свѣтло · съ весе ліемь зовꙋща · ты еси мл҃икохъ радованіе :~ Сего днь празноуеть праздникъ срѣтенію иконѣ пр[чстые] вл҃дчца наша бц҃а, иже гл҃ють володимерьскаꙗ.

items.english_text: *Kontakion of the Beheading of the Forerunner:* The glorious beheading of the Forerunner was a certain divine dispensation, that he might preach even unto those in Hades the coming of the Savior; let Herodias weep having asked for lawless murder; for she loved not the Law of God, nor eternal life, but deceit that is temporal!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Kontakion of the Beheading of the Forerunner:*
The glorious beheading of the Forerunner was a certain divine dispensation, that he might preach even unto those in Hades the coming of the Savior; let Herodias weep...
...having asked for lawless murder; for she loved not the Law of God, nor eternal life, but deceit that is temporal!

items.slavonic_text: Иродъ прѣдѣтече безаконновавь женѣ подасть главоу твою чт҃нꙋю · еиже покла нающесѧ веселимсѧ · иродъ же плаче тсѧ и рыдаетъ :~ На сти · ѡ · сл҃а пр҃тчи · і нн҃ б҃о · тр҃о пр҃тчи · и с҃ты :~ Положеніе чт҃наго поꙗса · прч҃тыꙗ вл҃дчца на ша бц҃а · в халкопратыи · Вечерь · обыное стихословье · Ст҃ры · въ минеи · на ѕ҃ · сл҃а і нн҃ гл҃а в҃ · Ꙗко вѣнець · На сти · ѡ · сл҃а і нн҃ самогласны · гл҃а в҃ · тр҃о Бц҃е приснодв҃о · и іпала в҃ · На оут҃ тр҃о г҃ · сѣ въ ѡ · канонъ · Бц҃и · въ минеи · на ѕ҃ · и въ ѡ · два · на и҃ · по ѕ҃ · кѡ҃ гл҃а д҃ · подб · Ꙗвисѧ :~ Чьстнаго поꙗса твоего положе ніе празднꙋеть дн҃ь твои препѣтаꙗ хра · прилежно възываетъ ти · радоуисѧ дв҃о хр҃тиꙗномъ похвало :~ На сти ѡ · На лѵ҃ про҃ · гл҃а г҃ · Пѣ бц҃и · Величит дша моꙗ га · сти · ꙗко призри на смѣ · апл҃ь къ еврееѡ ·

items.english_text: *On Saturday evening: "Blessed is the man." On "Lord, I have cried," Stichera on 10: 3 Resurrectional, and 4 Anatolian, and in the Triodion two, in Tone 1, twice; Glory, in the Triodion; Both now, Resurrectional. The sequence of the Saint in the Menaion is sung at Compline. On the Aposticha, Resurrectional and alphabetical stichera. At Matins: the ordinary psalmody [Kathismata], and the Polyeleos ["Many-merciful"]; Graduals of the tone; Prokeimenon; "Let every breath [praise the Lord]"; Sunday Gospel; "Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ"; Psalm 50; Resurrectional Sticheron. Canons: Resurrectional on 4, and of the Theotokos on 4, and in the Triodion on 6. After Ode 3, Sessional hymn in the Triodion. After Ode 6, Kontakion, Tone 2:*"[^506]

items.english_text: *Kontakion of the Prodigal Son [Tone 3]:* Having foolishly fled from Thy paternal glory, in evils I have squandered the riches Thou gavest unto me; therefore I offer unto Thee the voice of the prodigal: I have sinned before Thee, O compassionate Father; receive me repenting, and make me as one of Thy hired servants![^512]

provenance.verbatim_source:

Having foolishly fled from Thy paternal glory, in evils I have squandered the riches Thou gavest unto me; therefore I offer unto Thee the voice of the prodigal: I have sinned before Thee, O compassionate Father; receive me repenting, and make me as one of Thy hired servants![^512]

items.english_text: *On Friday evening: Stichera on 6: 3 of the Martyrs of the incoming tone, and in the Triodion stichera 3; Glory: "I weep and I lament"; Both now, Theotokion 1 of the incoming tone. In place of the Prokeimenon, at Vespers: Alleluia, in Tone 8; Verse: "Blessed are they whom Thou hast chosen and taken [unto Thyself, O Lord]; and their memorial is from generation to generation" [Ps. 64:5; 101:13]. On the Aposticha: one of the Martyrs, and for the reposed two Idiomela of the current tone; Glory, Tone 6: "A beginning today is composed..."; Both now, in the Triodion: "Thou art our God." Troparion, Tone 8: "Who by depth of wisdom..."; Glory, both now, Theotokion. Canon in the Octoechos on 6, and in the Triodion on 8. On the Praises, in the Triodion on 4. On the Aposticha, at Matins. At the Liturgy, in the Triodion: Ode 3 and Ode 6. Prokeimenon: "Their souls shall dwell among good things" [Ps. 24:13]; [Verse:] "Unto Thee, O Lord, have I lifted up my soul" [Ps. 24:1]. Epistles: The daily one: "Brethren, all things are lawful unto me..." [1 Cor. 6:12–20]; The other for the reposed: "Brethren, I would not have you to be ignorant..." [1 Thess. 4:13–17]. Alleluia: "Blessed are they whom Thou hast chosen and taken." Gospel: the daily one [Luke 21:8–9, 25–27, 33–36], and for the reposed [John 5:24–30]. Communion Hymn: "Blessed are they whom Thou hast chosen."*[^514]

items.english_text: *On Sunday evening: On "Lord, I have cried," Stichera on 6: in the Octoechos 3 of the current tone, and in the Menaion 3. On the Aposticha, the Octoechos is not sung; there is sung the daily Automelon 2 and 4, in the same Tone 5, once, both choirs together; Glory, both now, Theotokion. Thus sings the stichera at Vespers during the other days of Cheesefare week. But let it be known that on Cheesefare Saturday and Sunday the Menaion is not sung, but the sequence of the Saints whose memory is accounted...*[^520] *...accounted on Saturday and Sunday is sung at Compline, or whenever the ecclesiarch wills.*[^521]

items.english_text: *Kontakion of Cheesefare Sunday [Tone 6]:* Instructor of wisdom and Giver of prudence, Educator of the senseless and Defender of the poor: confirm and give understanding unto my heart, O Master! Do Thou give me the word, O Word of wisdom; for lo, I will not refrain both my lips from crying unto Thee: O Merciful One, have mercy on me who am fallen![^528]

provenance.verbatim_source:

Instructor of wisdom and Giver of prudence, Educator of the senseless and Defender of the poor: confirm and give understanding unto my heart, O Master! items.english_text: *On the Praises, on 8: Resurrectional on 4, and in the Triodion on 4. Great Doxology. At the Liturgy: the Octoechos on 6...* *...and in the Triodion, Ode 6 on 4. Prokeimenon, Tone 8: "Make vows, and pay them unto the Lord our God" [Ps. 75:12]; [Verse:] "In Judah is God known" [Ps. 75:2]. Epistle to the Romans: "Brethren, now is our salvation nearer than when we believed..." [Rom. 13:11–14:4]. Alleluia: "It is a good thing to give thanks unto the Lord" [Ps. 91:2]; [Verse:] "For the Lord is upright" [Ps. 91:16]. Gospel from Matthew [6:14–21]: "The Lord said: If ye forgive men their trespasses..." And the rest of the Divine Liturgy of John Chrysostom is celebrated. Communion Hymn: "Praise the Lord from the heavens" [Ps. 148:1]; and the other: "Rejoice in the Lord, O ye righteous" [Ps. 32:1].*[^529]

items.english_text: *On Friday of the First Week of the Fast: At Vespers prostrations are omitted.*[^542] *We chant: "In my distress I cried unto the Lord" [Ps. 119; Kathisma 18]. Stichera on 10: the Idiomelon twice, and 4 of the Martyrs in the Octoechos of the current tone, and of Saint Theodore 3 on 4. Entrance without the Gospel; "O Gladsome Light." Prokeimenon and readings in the Old Testament lections. "Let my prayer be set forth," and 3 prostrations. Likewise also at "Now the powers of heaven" and at "Blessed be the name of the Lord," 3 great prostrations each; and the rest of the Presanctified service.*[^543]

items.english_text: *Troparion of Saint Theodore the Recruit [Tone 2]:* Great are the achievements of faith! In the fountain of flame, as upon the water of rest, the holy Martyr Theodore rejoiced; for having been consumed by fire, as sweet bread he was offered unto the Trinity. By his prayers, O Christ God, have mercy on us![^545]

*Troparion of Saint Theodore the Recruit [Tone 2]:*
Great are the achievements of faith!...
...In the fountain of flame, as upon the water of rest, the holy Martyr Theodore rejoiced; for having been consumed by fire, as sweet bread he was offered unto the Trinity. By his prayers, O Christ God, have mercy on us![^545]

items.english_text: *Exapostilarion, Resurrectional, and in the Triodion. On the Praises, on 8: Resurrectional 3, and in the Triodion on 4; then 3: "Arise, O Lord my God" [Ps. 9:33]; Idiomelon, Tone 6: "Moses in the season of abstinence..."; Glory, the same; Both now: "Most blessed art thou, O Virgin Theotokos..."; and the Great Doxology. At the Liturgy: the Octoechos on 6, and in the Triodion, Ode 3. Prokeimenon: "Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers" [Dan. 3:26]; Verse: "For Thou art righteous in all that Thou hast done" [Dan. 3:27]. Epistle: "By faith Moses, when he was come to years..." [Heb. 11:24–26, 32–12:2]. Alleluia: "Moses and Aaron among His priests, and Samuel among them that call upon His name" [Ps. 98:6]. Gospel from John [1:43–51]: "The day following Jesus would go forth..." Communion Hymn: "Praise the Lord from the heavens" [Ps. 148:1]; and the other: "Rejoice in the Lord, O ye righteous" [Ps. 32:1].*

items.english_text: *On the evening of that same Sunday: as on Cheesefare Sunday. Great Prokeimenon, Tone 8: "Thou hast given an heritage unto them that fear Thy name, O Lord" [Ps. 60:6]; Verse: "From the ends of the earth have I cried unto Thee" [Ps. 60:3]; Verse: "I will be sheltered under the shadow of Thy wings" [Ps. 60:5]; Verse: "So will I sing praise unto Thy name unto ages of ages" [Ps. 60:9]. Then: "Vouchsafe, O Lord." Now these two Great Prokeimena: the first on Cheesefare...*[^553] *...Sunday, and the second this one, which alternate on the Sunday evenings of this holy Fast, from Cheesefare Sunday until the 5th Sunday. After [Vespers], as at the beginning, at Compline on Sunday evening prostrations are not made, except only after "Glory to God in the highest," and at the end 15 [metanias] and the last [great prostration]; after the Trisagion, 3.*[^554]

items.english_text: *And let this be known, that from Tuesday of the second week [of Great Lent], there are chanted at Compline the canons in the Menaion of the Saints occurring from Lazarus Saturday until Thomas Sunday, together with one Theotokion canon: first we chant the canon of the Theotokos, then that in the Menaion; after Ode 3, the Sessional hymn in the Menaion; after Ode 6, the Kontakion of the Theotokos, and the Kontakion and Ikos [of the Saint].*[^555]

items.english_text: *On the Second Sunday of the Fast: the order is according to the customary manner, even as was previously set forth. At the Liturgy: Prokeimenon: "Thou, O Lord, shalt keep us, and shalt preserve us" [Ps. 11:8]; Verse: "Save me, O Lord, for the godly man hath ceased" [Ps. 11:2]. Epistle: of the day [Heb. 1:10–2:3], and of the Theotokos [Heb. 9:1–7]. Alleluia: the tone likewise. Gospel: of the day [Mark 2:1–12], and of the Theotokos [Luke 10:38–42, 11:27–28]. And the Communion Hymn likewise.*[^558]

items.english_text: *The Third Sunday of the Fast, on which we celebrate the Veneration of the Precious Cross: At Great Vespers...* *...Stichera on 10: Resurrectional 6, and of the Cross on 4; the tone of the Cross: Automelon 1. At the Entrance: Theotokion Dogmatikon of the tone; Glory, Tone 5: "Beholding Thee, O Christ, hanging upon the Tree..."; on the Aposticha: Resurrectional; Glory, Tone 4: "O Lord Who didst help gentle David..."; Both now, the same. Troparion: "Theotokos Virgin, rejoice..." twice; Tone 1: "Save, O Lord, Thy people..." once; this makes 3. At Matins: Troparion, Resurrectional twice; Glory, both now, of the Cross; and the rest the customary order. Canons: Resurrectional on 4, and of the Theotokos on 2, and of the Cross on 8; Katavasia: "Divine Moses prefigured of old...". After Ode 3, Sessional hymn of the Cross. After Ode 6, Kontakion, Tone 7, Automelon:*[^559]

Оуже пламенное ѡрꋋжїе не хранить врать едемскы . прїиде бо емоу преславныи игл̑а . древо кр҃стьное . смертное жало . и адова побѣда погоублена бы . приде бо сп҃съ мои , въпїа въ рныи . вънидете пакы въ раи:~ свѣ . въскресень . и кр҃тоу . на хва . постави . на ҃и . ҃д . въскрны . и кр҃тоу . по̂ гл҃а ҃д . на ҃д . ҃в . по̂ . кр҃тоу . поютсѧ . съ стї . ҃г . б҃ъ же цр҃ь наш̑ь . с҃ . кланꙗитесѧ по̂но̂ . по се . гл̑етсѧ .
items.english_text: *Kontakion of the Precious Cross [Tone 7]:* No longer doth the flaming sword guard the gate of Eden, for upon it hath come a marvelous bond, the Tree of the Cross! The sting of death and the victory of Hades have been destroyed, for Thou didst appear, O my Savior, crying unto those in faith: Enter ye again into Paradise!

items.english_text: *Exapostilarion: Resurrectional, and of the Cross. On the Praises, appoint 8: 4 Resurrectional; and of the Cross, Prosomoia in Tone 4, on 4: 2 Prosomoia of the Cross are chanted with the 3 verses: "God is our King before the ages..." [Ps. 73:12]; Verse: "Exalt ye the Lord our God, and worship at His footstool..." [Ps. 98:5]. After this is said...* *...another Resurrectional verse and the Prosomoia; and one sings the Idiomelon of the day in that tone, Tone 8: "The boast of the faithful..."; Glory, Tone 6: "Today the Cross of the Lord..."; Both now: "Most blessed art thou, O Virgin Theotokos..."; Great Doxology, sung in a quiet voice. After this Doxology, the priest vests in the phelonion, and comes with the censer and with a candle unto the Holy Table, and censes the Holy Table and the Precious Wood; and thus he lifts it upon his head, in his hands, upon a platter. And he goes by the left side of the altar, two great candles and the censer preceding him. He comes unto the church doors, and there stands awaiting the end of the Trisagion.*[^560] *And when the Trisagion is finished, the deacon says: "Wisdom! Let us attend!" And the brethren begin the Troparion: "Save, O Lord, Thy people...", chanting it thrice. And the priest comes, carrying the Precious Wood through the Holy Doors unto the prepared table, and places the Precious Wood upon the table. And thus...* *...thus he censes it on the 4 sides. And while they sing: "Before Thy Cross we bow down in worship, O Master, and Thy holy Resurrection we glorify", immediately uncovering the casket, they begin to make prostrations in this manner: The Igumen with the priest make 3 prostrations unto the ground, and kiss the Precious Cross; and having kissed it, they again make 1 prostration, both together, and step back to their places. In like manner also the brethren begin, two from the right side and from the left side, after the same manner.*[^561] *And the choirs sing the Idiomelon Stichera: Tone 2: "Come, ye faithful, let us worship the life-giving Wood...", and the others which belong to the Cross; Glory, both now, Tone 8: "Today the Master of creation and Lord of glory is nailed to the Cross..." And when the kissing is completed, then the litany and dismissal. At the Liturgy: Beatitudes in the Octoechos on 6, and of the Cross, Ode 3; Troparion: Resurrectional, and of the Cross; Glory, both now, Kontakion of the Cross. In place of the Trisagion: "Before Thy Cross we bow down in worship..." Prokeimenon: "Save, O Lord, Thy people, and bless Thine inheritance" [Ps. 27:9]; Verse: "Unto Thee will I cry, O Lord my God" [Ps. 27:1]. Epistle of the day [Heb. 4:14–5:6]. Alleluia: "Remember Thy congregation, which Thou hast purchased from the beginning" [Ps. 73:2]; Verse: "God is our King before the ages, Who hath wrought salvation in the midst of the earth" [Ps. 73:12]. Gospel of the day [Mark 8:34–9:1]. Communion Hymn: "The light of Thy countenance is signed upon us, O Lord" [Ps. 4:7].*

Бывает же сице . в пне̂ на ҃а мь . часѣ твори поклананїе . поюще . и въ мѣстѡ столы люꙗ . кр҃тоу твое̂моу . такоже и въ середоу потомоу ѡбразоу . в пꙗ же . на ҃ѕ . мь часѣ . сътвараемь тр҃тое . и покланꙗемсѧ кр҃тоу . и тако възимаетсѧ кр҃ть . Въ сꋋботоу . д҃ . нѣ . ве̂рь . ѡбычное . стїхословье . и прое̂ , по ѡбычаю . въ сре̂ д҃ . нѣ . на у̂р . поетсѧ . канѡ . кр҃тоу . съ трипѣснадїи . Стомоу ѡставлаетсѧ . Въ тꋋе же . д҃ . нѣ . начинае̂ты їереи . двооугꋋбые . ѡглашеньꙗ . е̂лко ѡглашенїи , съ мл҃твою . дажь . и досрѣ великыꙗ . items.english_text: *Be it known that this veneration we perform according to the aforesaid manner for 4 days, that is: on Sunday, on Monday, on Wednesday, and on Friday.*[^562] *And it takes place as follows: On Monday, at the First Hour one makes the veneration, while chanting instead of the dismissal troparion: "Before Thy Cross we bow down in worship...". In like manner also on Wednesday, after the same manner. But on Friday, at the Sixth Hour, we perform the third veneration, and venerate the Cross, and thus the Cross is taken up into the sanctuary. On Saturday evening of the 4th week: the customary stichologia, and the rest according to custom. On Wednesday of the 4th week, at Matins is chanted the Canon of the Cross with the Triodia; of the Saint it is left out. In that same 4th week, the priest begins the twofold litanies of the catechumens: "As many as are catechumens, depart...", with the prayer, even until Great Wednesday.*[^563] *On the 4th Sunday of the Fast, at Vespers: one recites the stichologia: Kathisma 4; and on Monday of the 5th week: one recites the stichologia: the Kathismata in order. In the evening, on Wednesday of the 5th week: at Vespers, the customary stichologia, and on "Lord, I have cried," Idiomela...* *...Idiomela of the day: 2, and 4; and after 3 stichera, in the Triodion; and immediately we sing the 24 Stichera of the Great Canon, whose acrostic is: "Falling into the nets...". And at each sticheron we make 3 prostrations. Then Glory, Triadikon; Both now, Theotokion from the same; and the rest of the order of the Presanctified. In the refectory, we eat food with oil from tree-fruit, and we drink wine, on account of the labor of the All-Night Vigil. And Compline we chant in the cells. On Thursday of the 5th week, at Matins we sing "Alleluia," and in the current tone is said the Hymn to the Trinity. And one recites the stichologia: one Kathisma, 7 in the Octoechos, and of the Apostles 4; and we read from the book of Saint Ephrem; and Psalm 50. And we begin the Great Canon of master Andrew; and at each troparion we make 3 prostrations. And there is read the Life of Saint Mary of Egypt, in two readings: after Ode 3 in the Triodion; at Ode 4 the Triodion precedes, without prostrations; likewise also at Ode 8 and at Ode 9.*[^564]

items.english_text: *Kathisma psalmody: two Kathismata. After the 1st Kathisma, Kontakion, Tone 8: "To thee, the Champion Leader..."; then 6 Ikoses; Hypakoe; the same Kontakion. And when these Ikoses are said, one does not sit down, but standing we listen with fear.*[^566] *After the 2nd Kathisma: Kontakion: "To thee, the Champion Leader...", and the remaining 6 Ikoses, and again that same Kontakion. Psalm 50. Canon of the Theotokos, of the Akathist [non-sitting], Tone 4, on 8; and for the patron Saint of the church on 6; and where the Four-Ode Canon occurs, omit that of the church, and for the Theotokos on 6. After Ode 3, Kontakion: "To thee, the Champion Leader...", and 6 Ikoses, and again that same Kontakion. After Ode 6, the Four-Ode Canon according to custom. After Ode 6, Kontakion: "To thee, the Champion Leader...", and 6 Ikoses, and again that same Kontakion, and Ikos 1. After Ode 9: Exapostilarion of the Theotokos. On the Praises: Prosomoia of the Theotokos on 4; Glory, both now: "A language which she knew not..." [Tone 2]. Great Doxology; Troparion of the Theotokos. At the Liturgy: Beatitudes from the Canon of the Theotokos, Ode 3 and Ode 6. Prokeimenon: "My soul doth magnify the Lord, and my spirit hath rejoiced in God my Savior" [Luke 1:46–47]...* *...Verse: "For He hath regarded the lowliness of His handmaiden" [Luke 1:48]. Epistle: [Hebrews], pericope 320 [Heb. 9:1–7]: "For both He that sanctifies and they who are sanctified are all of one..." Alleluia: "Unto Thy face shall the rich among the people make supplication" [Ps. 44:13]. Gospel: [Luke], pericope 54 [Luke 1:39–49, 56]: "In those days, Mary arose..." Communion Hymn: "I will take the cup of salvation, and call upon the name of the Lord" [Ps. 115:4].*

items.english_text: *On Friday of the 6th week, at Matins: the customary stichologia. On the Aposticha: Idiomela: 2, and of the day; Glory, Tone 8: "Having accomplished the forty days that bring profit to our souls..." (that is, the lesser one); Both now, again the same. On Friday of the 6th week, at Vespers: Kathisma [18: "In my distress I cried unto the Lord"]. On "Lord, I have cried," Stichera on 10: we sing "Having accomplished the forty days that bring profit to our souls" (the lesser one) twice, and of the day once; and of Saint Lazarus, Idiomela 5, on 7, Tone 6: "Lord, standing by the tomb of Lazarus..."; Glory, Tone 8: "Standing by the tomb of Lazarus..."; Both now, of the same tone: "Having accomplished the forty days that bring profit to our souls" (that is, the greater one). items.slavonic_text: Егдаже братия цѣлують• еѵ̃ліе• раздаваеть игоуменъ• ваия• еже бѣтви• и начинаемь кано̃• гла̃ д̃• [я]вишася исто• ір̃мъ• по в̃• и тр̃ори• на, в̃і• и пакы• ір̃мъ• а̃• в коу̃• по ѕ̃• пѣ к̃о̃ гла̃ ѕ̃• На прѣстолѣ на нб̃си на жребяти на земли, сѣдяи х̃е б̃е• ѿ а̃г̃глъ хваленіе, и ѿ ѡ̃трокъ пѣніе пріймяше• въпіющих, блг̃венъ грядыи а̃дама възъдвигноути:~ Даются свѣщи н̃браи• с̃вѣ• г̃• на хва̃• ст̃ры• на ѕ̃• самогла̃нь• д̃• гла̃ д̃• и множество хотящоу• и зижитель• ѡ̃бщее въскр̃ніе• сла̃ і н̃ ѕ̃• преже шестии д̃ни• славословіе• тр̃о и ѡ̃поу̃• Въ, в̃• ча̃ д̃ни• [зри] ѡ̃биходимь• съ кр̃ты• манастырь• и възвращьшеся• начинаемь• а̃• ча̃:~ и сътворяемь• літоургію ранее троуда ради:~ на літоургіи• а̃нтины• а̃нти̃• а̃• ѱаломь• Възлюбихъ [я]ко оуслыша г̃ь гласъ моленіа моегое• мл̃твами б̃ца• с̃•

items.slavonic_text: домъ ааронь [я]ко бл̃гъ [я]ко въ вѣкы• тр̃о Общее въскр̃сеніе• с̃• Да рекоуть поющеис[я] г̃а• [я]ко бл̃гъ [я]ко въ вѣкы• тр̃о• Общее въскр̃сеніе• въхо̃• Бл̃венъ грядыи въ имя г̃не, б̃ъ г̃ь [я]вися намь• Общее въскр̃сеніе сл і н̃ ко̃ тр̃тое про̃• Бл̃венъ грядыи въ имя г̃не• с̃ Исповѣдаитеся г̃ви• ап̃л р̃д̃• Радоуитеся ѡ̃ г̃ѣ• а̃ллилуа• Въспоите г̃ви пѣ нову• с̃ Видѣша вси конци еѵ̃е ѿ іѡ̃а Преже шестии д̃не• И прое літоургіа златоу̃стаго• при̃• Бл̃венъ грядыи въ и̃мя г̃не б̃ъ г̃ь [я]вися намь• На трапезѣ оутѣшеніе, бра̃н веліе• и [я]ды рыбу и піемь питье• Въ туюжь не̃• ѕ̃ ю• верь• ка̃ не стихословимь• ст̃ры на ѕ̃• гла̃ и̃• Радоуися и веселися• сла пакы радоуитеся• і н̃• На херувид̃ѣ• въхо̃• про̃ Сем̃ ннѣ бл̃вите• с̃ Повнги, и покло̃, г̃• На с̃ти• самогла̃ны г̃• единь гла̃ в̃• Ѡ ваіа вѣтви• і ны гла̃ г̃• Стра
items.english_text: *Entrance: "Blessed is He that comes in the name of the Lord; God is the Lord, and hath appeared unto us" [Ps. 117:26–27]. Troparion: "Giving assurance of the universal resurrection..."; Glory, both now: Kontakion: "Borne upon a throne in heaven..." Prokeimenon: "Blessed is He that comes in the name of the Lord" [Ps. 117:26]; Verse: "O give thanks unto the Lord, for He is good, for His mercy endures unto the ages" [Ps. 117:1]. Epistle of the day: [Philippians, pericope 247; Phil. 4:4–9]: "Rejoice in the Lord alway..." Alleluia: "O sing unto the Lord a new song" [Ps. 97:1]; Verse: "All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God" [Ps. 97:3]. Gospel according to John, pericope [John 12:1–18]: "Six days before the Passover, Jesus came to Bethany..." And the rest of the Liturgy of Saint John Chrysostom. Communion Hymn: "Blessed is He that comes in the name of the Lord; God is the Lord, and hath appeared unto us [Ps. 117:26–27]. Alleluia." In the refectory there is consolation, a great meal: we eat fish and we drink wine.*[^577]

items.english_text: *In the Great Days [Holy Week], at Matins:*[^580] *we sing "Alleluia" in Tone 8, and we say the Troparion in Tone 8, thrice: "Behold, the Bridegroom comes in the middle of the night...", which is written in the Midnight Office. After the Kathismata, the Sessional hymns of the day in the Triodion. Psalm 50, and the prayer: "O God, save Thy people..."; and we begin the Triodion, composed by Cosmas: the heirmos twice, and the troparia on 12;* *...and again the heirmos once together. After Ode [8], Kontakion, Tone 8, Automelon:*[^581]

items.slavonic_text: и пакы• ір̃мь• а̃• въкоупѣ• поемь• пѣ̃ни к̃о̃• гла̃ и̃• [я]ко начаткы• [Я]кѡ вьрыдаяше• іѡсифова лишеніа• [я]ко въ колесницѣ сѣдяше• на колесници [я]ко оурьчтоль• егѵптанынне ѡ̃сласти тогда не поработивься славляяше• И нынѣ славится ѡ̃ всевидящаго ч̃лчьская ср̃д̃ца• и посылающаго вѣнець ненетлѣнныи:~ с̃вѣ гла̃ и̃• Чертога твоего г̃• поетжеся• посре̃ цр̃кви• и пакы ѡ̃бою страноу• на хва̃• самогла̃ны• г̃• на д̃• единь• гла̃ а̃• Приходя г̃ь• е̃ два• е̃го• Постигше• г̃и гряди• сла̃ і н̃ гла̃ и̃• Исухъшьша• на сти̃• самогла̃ны• г̃• гла̃ е̃• Г̃и к таинъ• г̃и съкръши• постигше его• с̃ти же г̃лемь• Въспоите г̃ви• с̃ти• Видѣша въси• сла̃ і н̃ гла̃ и̃• И съвкоупляемь• а̃• ча̃• без стихословья• по обычаю• г̃, [я]же ча̃ ѕ̃• с̃ стихословьемь• въ свое время:~ на часѣх же• г̃лется• к̃о̃ д̃невн• трори•
items.english_text: *Kontakion of Great Monday [Tone 8]:* Jacob lamented the loss of Joseph, while the noble youth sat in a chariot, honored as a king; for having not submitted then to the pleasures of the Egyptian woman, he was glorified by Him Who sees the hearts of men and bestows an incorruptible crown!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Kontakion of Great Monday [Tone 8]:*
Jacob lamented the loss of Joseph, while the noble youth sat in a chariot, honored as a king; for having not submitted then to the pleasures of the Egyptian woman, he was glorified by Him Who sees the hearts of men and bestows an incorruptible crown!

items.english_text: *Exapostilarion, Tone 8: "Thy Bridal Chamber, O Lord, I behold adorned, and a garment I have not that I may enter therein; enlighten the vesture of my soul, O Giver of Light, and save me", chanted thrice in the midst of the church, and again by both sides [choirs].*[^582] *On the Praises: Idiomela 3, on 4: one in Tone 1: "The Lord, going unto His voluntary Passion..."; and the other two: "Having reached the saving Passion...", "Lord, coming unto Thy Passion..."; Glory, both now, Tone 8: "Finding the fig tree withered [because of its barrenness]..." On the Aposticha: Idiomela 3, Tone 5: "Lord, reaching the mystery...", "Lord, Thou hast crushed...", "Having reached..."; and we say the verses: "Sing unto the Lord a new song" [Ps. 97:1]; Verse: "All the ends of the earth have seen" [Ps. 97:3]; Glory, both now, Tone 8: ["A second Eve the serpent found in the Egyptian woman..."]. And we join the First Hour, without stichologia, according to custom; but the Third and Sixth Hours with stichologia at their proper time. At the Hours, moreover, there is said the Kontakion of the day, and the troparia...* *...the customary ones. It is fitting to know how the Four Gospels [Tetraevangelion] are read:*[^583] *The Gospel of Matthew is read entirely in two readings; likewise also that of Mark, entirely in two; and that of Luke is read in three readings; and that of John is read up to the beginning of the Holy Passion in two readings. And they read the Gospels during the three days: on Monday, on Tuesday, and on Wednesday, at the Third, Sixth, and Ninth Hours.*

items.slavonic_text: и ѳ̃• мь часѣ• ѻ̃кте̃а Ръцѣмь вси• и прое, прежесщеннаа• Въ ср̃е великую, на оу̃трии а̃ллилуіа• въ гла̃ и̃• тр̃о г̃• Се жени• ка̃ г̃• с̃ѣ въ триѡ̃• ѱл̃ѡ н̃• и мл̃о, и начинае̃• и триѡ̃• г̃ла, козмы• ір̃мь по в̃• и тр̃ор на в̃і• и пакы• ір̃мь а̃• вкоу̃• по г̃• пѣ̃• к̃о̃ гла̃ д̃• въ з̃пе• Паче блудница беззаконновавь щедре• и слъзъ потоками никогдаже ти принесох• но млъчаніемь, мл̃яся припадаю ти• желая лобызати прѣч̃стѣи твои нозѣ• [я]ко да прощеніе мл̃ніа [я]ко вл̃ка даси долго зовоущю с̃п̃се• ѿ сквернъ дѣлъ моихъ избави мя:~ с̃вѣ г̃• На хва̃• самогласны д̃• гла̃ а̃• Тя д̃вч̃а с̃па• Мно̃гоцѣнно, Егда пріидеши• Ѡ іюдинос̃л• сла̃ і н̃ ѕ̃• Д̃нь х̃с на ст̃не а̃гл̃ны д̃• грѣшница• и г̃ гла̃ ѕ̃• Пріиде жена• Простре• И еще• с̃ти гле• Исплънихомся• И б̃жди свѣтло• сла̃ і н̃ и̃• Г̃и въ многыя• съвъкоупляе̃ а̃ ча̃ безъ сти̃сло̃ва
items.english_text: *Kontakion of Great Wednesday [Tone 4]:* Having transgressed more than the harlot, O Compassionate One, I have never offered Thee streams of tears; but in silence, praying, I fall down before Thee, desiring with love to kiss Thine all-pure feet, that Thou, as Master, mayest grant forgiveness of debts unto me who cry out: O Savior, deliver me from my filthy deeds!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Kontakion of Great Wednesday [Tone 4]:*
Having transgressed more than the harlot, O Compassionate One, I have never offered Thee streams of tears; but in silence, praying, I fall down before Thee, desiring with love to kiss Thine all-pure feet, that Thou, as Master, mayest grant forgiveness of debts unto me who cry out: O Savior, deliver me from my filthy deeds!

items.english_text: *Troparion of Great Thursday, Tone 8:* When the glorious disciples at the washing of the Supper were enlightened, then Judas the ungodly, stricken with the love of silver, was darkened, and to the lawless judges surrenders Thee, the righteous Judge. On the Praises: Idiomela 4, Tone 2: "Today He Who holds [creation] in His palm...", "What is this sight that is beheld...", "Come, behold [our Life lying in the tomb]..."; and another in Tone 6...* *...and: "Joseph went in and asked for the Body of Jesus..." Glory, Tone 6: "Today secretly the great Moses prefigured this day..."; Both now: "Most blessed art Thou, [O Virgin Theotokos...]"; Great Doxology. The priest vests in full sacerdotal vestments;*[^607] *and he makes the Entrance with the Holy Gospel; he comes before the Holy Doors, and there stands awaiting the end of the Trisagion; and when the Trisagion is finished, he exclaims: "Wisdom. Stand upright." And they chant the Troparion: "The noble Joseph..." Then the priest enters: "Peace be unto all." Then the Paremia Troparion, Tone 4: "He Who holds the ends of the earth..."; then the Paremia of the day [Ezek. 37:1–14]; Prokeimenon before the Apostle: "Arise, O Lord my God, let Thine hand be lifted up; forget not Thy poor for ever" [Ps. 9:33 (10:12)]; Verse: "I will give thanks unto Thee, O Lord, with my whole heart" [Ps. 9:1]; Epistle to the Romans [sic; 1 Cor. 5:6–8]: "A little leaven leavens the whole lump..."; Alleluia: "Let God arise, and let His enemies be scattered" [Ps. 67:1]; Verse: "As smoke vanishes, so let them vanish" [Ps. 67:2]; Verse: "So let the wicked perish at the presence of God" [Ps. 67:2]; Gospel according to Matthew [Matt. 27:62–66]. At Matins, following the Gospel: Litany: "Let us all say...", and "Let us complete our morning prayer...", and the Dismissal.*

items.english_text: *It is fitting that the Ecclesiarch know: so that the dismissal of the Liturgy shall be at the 2nd hour of the night.*[^610] *And after the dismissal, we do not go out from the church, but each sits in his own place; and the cellarer distributes the blessed bread, and drink, a cup of wine.*[^611] *Then the Acts of the Holy Apostles are read.*[^612]

items.slavonic_text: и҆ пакы і҃рм̃съ · а҃ · вкоу̃ · по · г҃ · пѣ́с҃ тѣ и҆ чтенье · по · ѕ҃ · пѣ́ кѡ̃ · гл̃а · в҃ · и҆ и҆́кѡ̃ · сꙋботныи · и҆ чт҃ее по канѡ̃ · тр҃тое · тр҃о · е҆гда сни · ѡ҆кте̃а ѡ҃ поу̃ · и҆ чт҃ее · По чтен · дае́т е҆клисиа́рхъ свѣщи бран · кандилаптис же ѡ҆знаменаеть , въ великое , и҆ въ желѣ́зное · и҆́сходимъ вси въ притворꙑ · развѣ кандилаптисъ , въжнгаеть бо свѣщи въсѧ , и҆ пандикадила · и҆ оу҆строить съсꙋжецїль съ ѡ҆гнемь · и҆ поставить посрѣ̃ цр҃кве и҆ положить фимїама много , поблизоу с҃ты дверїи · ѡ҆бѣсит же и҆ въс̑ ѡ҆лтари ѡ҆гнь съ фимїа̃мѡ · и҆ кадить цр҃ковь · і҃ереи же ѡ҆блачитсѧ въ свѣтлыи санъ · и҆ исходить въ притворъ · сѣверныими дверьми · и҆ прѣидꙋщима двѣма свѣщама · затвореным же дверемь · кади і҃ереи · въ притворѣ въсѧ · и҆ ставь прѣ цр҃ковными враты зрѧ ко въстокоу · начертаеть кр҃та кадилѡ̃ · г҃ ·
items.english_text: *After the reading, the Ecclesiarch gives tapers unto the brethren.*[^613] *The candilaptis sounds the great semantron and the iron semantron.*[^614] *And we all go out into the narthex, except the candilaptis, for he lights all the candles and chandeliers, and prepares a vessel with fire, and sets it in the midst of the church, and places much incense near the Holy Doors; and he also suspends fire with incense in the sanctuary; and the church is censed.*[^615]

items.english_text: *And the priest vests in radiant vestments, and goes out into the narthex through the northern door, with two candles preceding him. And the doors being shut, the priest censes all in the narthex; and standing before the church doors looking toward the east, he marks the sign of the cross thrice with the censer...* *...saying with a loud voice: "Glory to the holy, consubstantial, life-creating, and undivided Trinity, alway, now and ever, and unto ages of ages!" And after "Amen", the priest begins in Tone 5: "Christ is risen from the dead, trampling down death by death, and upon those in the tombs bestowing life!" thrice; then the choir and the brethren chant it thrice.*[^616]

items.english_text: If anyone has come after the sixth hour, having nothing, let him in no way be judged; for there shall be no loss. If anyone has tarried even unto the ninth hour, let him draw near, doubting nothing. If anyone has arrived only at the eleventh hour, let him not fear because of his delay; for the Lover of mankind with bounty receives the last even as the first: He gives rest unto him who came at the eleventh hour, even as unto him who worked from the morning; He has mercy upon the last, and consoles the first; and unto that one He gives, and unto this one He bestows; and He accepts the deeds, and cherishes the intention of him that delayed; He honors the work, and praises the haste of him that delayed!

items.english_text: The church's table is laden; feast all of you! The fatted calf is set forth; let all be filled, let no one go forth hungry! Feast all of you upon the banquet of faith; receive all of you the riches of goodness!

items.slavonic_text: нье̃ , никтоже не и҆зыди а҆́лченъ · вси насладитесѧ пира цр҃ковнаго · въси прїимѣ́те бг҃атство бл҃гти · развѣ́ : сквернитель · и҆́же своꙗ телеса ѡ҆сквернѧють блꙋдомь и҆ требамн · ти́ бо неприꙗзни слꙋжать · никтоже да не плачетсѧ нищетою · ꙗви бо сѧ ѡ҆бьщее цр҃ьство · никтоже да не рыдае́ть прегрѣшенїа · прощенїе бо ѡ҃ гроба въсиꙗ · никтоже да боитсѧ смерти · свободи бо на̃ с҃пса нашего : смр҃ть · дръзаите а҆́зъ побѣди́хъ миръ · и҆́миродръжителѧ · понесъ са́мъ грѣхы мира · сп҃слъ бо ны е҆ х҃съ , и҆ ѡ҃ ада и҆збавиль · и҆сторже бо ны · ѡ҃ дїа́вола насїлїа · и҆ ѡ҃ работы е҆го свободиль е҆ , ѡ҆горчи сѧ а҆́дъ · въкоусивъ чьстныа и҆ ст҃ыа плът̑и влч҃на · ꙗкоже и҆саиа проре̃ · ѡ҆горчи сѧ а҆́дъ оу҆срѣ́тъ тебе долꙋ · ѡ҆горчи сѧ оу҆́бо понеже оу҆празднисѧ · ѡ҆горчи сѧ оу҆́бо , понеже порꙋганъ бы̃ · ѡ҆горчисѧ понеже свѧзанъ бы · прїѧть тѣ́ло ,
items.english_text: Except the defiler, and those who defile their own bodies with fornication and pagan sacrifices, for they serve the devil![^624]

items.slavonic_text: сохомь · въскре̃ х҃с , и҆ мы ѡ҆жихомь · х҃с ѡ҃ мр҃твыхъ въскрсе , и҆ начатокъ оу҆мерши̃ бы · томоу слава и҆ дръжава , и҆ покланѧнїе и҆ велѣ́пїе · ны́нѣ и҆ пр̃но и҆ въ вѣ́кы вѣкѡ̃ а҆минь :~ та̃ тро · гла̃ · и҃ · ѡ҆ оу҆́стъ твоихъ ꙗко злато · ѡ҆кте̃а · и҆ ѡ҆поу̃ :~ чинъ , часѡ̃ на ст҃ꙋю пасхоу , сице же поетсѧ · и҆ павечерница · и҆ до сꙋботы · ѡ҃ годины · ча̃ · а҃ · бл҃вившю і҃ереꙋ · г҃лемь · х҃съ въскрсе · г҃ · та̃ · сїе · г҃ :~ Въскресенїе х҃во видѣвше , поклонимсѧ ст҃мꙋ г҃у і҃соу · є҆диномꙋ безгрѣ́шномꙋ · крестꙋ твоє́мꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ х҃е · и҆ ст҃ое въскресенїе твое славимь · ты бо е҆си б҃ъ нашь развѣ́ тебе и҆ного не знае́мь · и҆́мѧ твое нарицае́мь · прїидѣ́те вьси вѣ́рнїи поклонимсѧ х҃воу ст҃моу въскрсенїю · се бо прииде кр҃та ради радость въсемꙋ мироу · въсегда бл҃вѧще г҃а , и҆ въскрсенїе е҆го поимь распѧтїе бо пострада и҆ съмръ́тїю съмръ́ть раздроуши :~ г҃ ·
items.english_text: ...Christ is risen, and we are brought to life! "Christ is risen from the dead, and become the firstfruits of them that slept" [1 Cor. 15:20]. Unto Him be glory and dominion, worship and majesty, now and ever, and unto ages of ages. Amen.[^628]

items.english_text: Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ, let us worship the Holy Lord Jesus, the only Sinless One. We venerate Thy Cross, O Christ, and Thy Holy Resurrection we praise and glorify. For Thou art our God, apart from Thee we know no other, we call upon Thy Name. Come, all ye faithful, let us venerate the Holy Resurrection of Christ! For behold, through the Cross joy hath come into all the world! Ever blessing the Lord, we sing His Resurrection; for having endured the Crucifixion, by death He hath destroyed death! *(thrice).*

items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Иродъ прѣдѣтече безаконновавь женѣ подасть главоу
items.slavonic_text: Превариша оу҆́тро ꙗ҆́же ѡ҃ мр҃їи , и҆ ѡ҃врѣ́тоша · ка́мень ѡ҃валенъ , слышаша ѡ҃ а҆́гг҃ла · и҆́же въ свѣ́тѣ пр̃ноесꙋщїимь бы́лъ , с жи́выми съ мр҃твыими · не и҆́щите ꙗко чл҃ка · видите гро тныꙗ пелены тецѣ́те и҆ мироу проповѣ́дите ꙗ҆ко въскрсе г҃ь оу҆мр҃твивыи смр҃ть · ꙗко тѣ́ н҃е сн҃ь бж҃їи · сп҃сающаго ро́дъ чл҃чьскыи :~ кѡ̃ , гл̃ . А҆́ще и҆ въ гробъ съниде бессмр҃тне · и҆ а҆́довꙋ разроуши силоу · и҆ въскрсе ꙗ҆́ко побѣ́дитель х҃е б҃е · женамъ мѵроносицамъ ра́ дость провѣ́ща · и҆ своимь а҆пл҃омъ миръ даро ва · и҆же падшимь подаꙗ въскрсенїе :~ Въ гробѣ плътскы · въ а҆́дѣ же съ дꙋ́шею ꙗко б҃ъ · в раи же съ разбоиникѡ , на пр̃тлѣ бѣаше х҃е съ ѡ҃ц҃емь и҆ дх҃мь · всѧ́ и҆сплъна́ѧ неѡ҃писанныи :~ Сла́ · Ꙗ҆́ко живоносець ꙗ҆ко раꙗ краснѣ́иши , въ и҆́стиноу и҆ всѧкого чертога цр҃ьска , ꙗвльне же свѣтлѣ́нши х҃е гро бъ твои · и҆сточникъ нашему въскрнїю :~
items.english_text: *Kontakion, Tone 8:* Though Thou didst descend into the tomb, O Immortal One, yet didst Thou destroy the power of Hades, and didst arise as victor, O Christ God, saying unto the Myrrh-bearing Women: "Rejoice!" and bestowing peace upon Thine Apostles, Thou Who dost grant resurrection to the fallen.[^632]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Kontakion, Tone 8:*
Though Thou didst descend into the tomb, O Immortal One, yet didst Thou destroy the power of Hades, and didst arise as victor, O Christ God, saying unto the Myrrh-bearing Women: "Rejoice!" and bestowing peace upon Thine Apostles, Thou Who dost grant resurrection to the fallen.[^632]

items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Иродъ прѣдѣтече безаконновавь женѣ подасть главоу
items.slavonic_text: и҆ нн҃ѣ · Вышнѧ́го ѡ҃сщ҃енно бж҃їе селенїе ра дꙋисѧ · тобою бо дастьсѧ ра́дость бц҃е · въпїю щимь ти · бл҃гословл́ена ты въ жена́ · въсенепоро чнаꙗ влч҃це :~ Г҃и помлꙋи · м҃ · сла́ і҃н҃, чь стнѣ́ишю херꙋви̃ · и҆́менемь гн҃имь · сщ҃енни · за мл҃твъ ст҃ы ѡ҃ц҃ь · си́мь ѡ҃бразо̃ гли̃ · и҆ за а҃ · и҆ · г҃ · и҆ · ѕ҃ · и҆ · ѳ҃ · та̃ а҆́ще за бл҃го видѧть ѡ҃ци , зр҃и · х҃съ въскрсе · г҃ · въскрсенїе х҃во · а҃ · и҆ пре́ва риша оу҆́тро · сла́ а҆́ще и҆ въ гробъ · и҆ нн҃ едино родныи · та̃ бл҃жена · ѡ҃ кано̃ · пѣ̃ · г҃ · и҆ · ѕ҃ а҃пл҃ъ е҆ѵлїе · та̃ помѧнниа · ликы нбсны вѣ́рꙋю въ е҆диного б҃а · ѡ҃че нашь · ко̃ а҆́ще и҆ въ гробъ · г҃и помлꙋи · в҃і · та̃ х҃съ въскрсе г҃ · сла́ · и҆ нн҃ѣ · г҃и бл҃ви · та̃ бл҃вꙋ г҃ана · до не лишатсѧ всѧкого бл҃га · и҆ ѡ҃пꙋ̃ · сице по емь , часы до сꙋботы · ѳ҃ · ѡ҃дины :~ Въ ст҃ꙋю великую , нѣлю , пасхы · на лѵ́ тоургїи · а҃нтїп , глють же сѧ · и҆ въ прочїи дни сеꙗ нѣли · е҆гда бѣ , лѵтꙋргїа · а҃нтїп · а҃ · ѱло̃ · ѯ҃е ·
items.english_text: *Theotokion of the Hours:* Rejoice, O sanctified divine dwelling of the Most High! For through thee joy hath been given, O Theotokos, unto them that cry to thee: Blessed art thou among women, O all-immaculate Lady![^635]

*Theotokion of the Hours:*
Rejoice, O sanctified divine dwelling of the Most High! For through thee joy hath been given, O Theotokos, unto them that cry to thee: Blessed art thou among women, O all-immaculate Lady![^635]

items.english_text: *"Christ is risen" (thrice); "Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ" (once); and "The women with Mary came before dawn"; Glory: "Though Thou didst descend into the tomb"; Both now: "Only-begotten Son"; then the Beatitudes, from the Canon, Ode 3 and Ode 6; Epistle; Gospel; then the commemorations; "The heavenly choir"; "I believe in one God"; "Our Father"; Kontakion: "Though Thou didst descend into the tomb"; "Lord, have mercy" (12); then "Christ is risen" (thrice); Glory, Both now; Lord, bless; then "Blessed be the Name of the Lord", unto "shall not lack any good thing" [Ps. 33:11]; and the Dismissal. In this manner we sing the Hours until Saturday of the 9th hour.*[^637]

items.slavonic_text: Въскликнете г҃ви вьсѧ землѧ · М҃литва ми бц҃а сп҃се сп҃си на̃ · ст҃и · Въскликнете г҃ви вьсѧ землѧ · поите же и҆́мени е҆го · дадите славоу хвалѣ́ е҆го · М҃литвами бц҃а · С҃ти · Рцыте б҃оу коль страшна дѣ́ла твоꙗ · Мо литвами бц҃а · ст҃и · Въ мно́жествѣ силы твое́ꙗ сължꙋть тебѣ́ , врази твои · Моли твами бц҃а · Сла́ М҃литвами бц҃а · і҃н҃ Моли твами бц҃а сп҃се · а҃нтї , в҃ · ѱаломь , ѯ҃ѕ · Б҃ъ оу҆́щедри ны и҆ бл҃ви ны , сп҃си ны сн҃е бж҃їи въскресыи и҆з̾ мр҃твы поющимь ти · а҆́ллꙋ́ꙗ · а҆́ллꙋ́ꙗ · а҆́ллꙋиа · ст҃ · Б҃ъ оу҆́щедри ны и҆ бл҃ви ны · про свѣти лице твое на ны и҆ помилꙋи ны · сп҃си ны сн҃е бж҃їи · ст҃ · Да позна́емь на земли пꙋ̃ твои · и҆ въ всѣ́хъ ꙗ҆зыцѣ́хъ сп҃сенїе твое , сп҃си ны сн҃е бж҃їи · ст҃ · И҆сповѣ́датсѧ тебѣ́ людїе б҃е и҆сповѣ́датсѧ тебѣ́ людїе вьси · сп҃си ны сн҃е Сл҃ і҃ н҃ Е҆диноро́дныи сн҃ъ · а҃нтї г҃ · ѱлѡ̃ ѯ҃з : Да въскреснеть б҃ъ и҆ разыдꙋ́тсѧ вьси

items.slavonic_text: врази е҆́го · Х҃съ въскрсе · Да въскреснеть б҃ъ и҆ разыдꙋ́тсѧ врази е҆́го · и҆ бѣжа́ть ѡ҃ лица е҆го́ въси ненави́дѧщїи н҃его · Х҃съ въскресе · Ꙗ҆́ко и҆́щезае́ть дымь да и҆́щезнꙋ́ , ꙗко та́ еть воскъ ѡ҃ лица ѡ҃гню · Х҃съ въскрсе · Въ хо̃ · Въ цр҃квахъ бл҃вите г҃а · Х҃съ въскрсе , сла́ і҃н҃ А҆́ще въ гробъ , въ тр҃таго мѣ́сто · Е҆́ли ци въ х҃а · Про · Снидныи же сътвори · ст҃и · И҆сповѣ́даите сѧ · А҆пл҃ь · Пръвое слово · А҆́ллꙋ́ꙗ · Ты въскр̃сь оу҆́щедри , Г҃ь съ нб҃се на землю при · Е҆ѵе ѡ҃ і҃ѡа · И҆скони бѣ̀ сло во · и҆ про̃ · Лѵтꙋргїа · Златоу́стаго · при тѣ́ло х҃во · и҆ на трапезѣ оу҆тѣ́шенїе бра́тїе вели́ лїе · и҆ допѣ́лникое быва́е :~ Чинъ ѡ҃ панагїи , быва́емы · и҆́же ѡ҃ ѡ҃бы́ч , въ зластырѣ , на ст҃ꙋю пасхꙋ · Въставаꙗ ѡ҃ трапезы · бра́ꙗ · рекꙋ́ · Х҃съ въскр̃е г҃ · г҃и помлꙋи г҃ · та̃ кела́ · ства́ рье̃ , ѡ҃быи покло̃ · и҆ по́имь а҆́ртъ̃ · ѡ҃бѣ́ма рꙋкама · е҆́же е҆́ просфꙋра на то оу҆строе́на ·

items.english_text: *The priest vests in sacred vestments...* *...and standing before the Holy Doors with the censer, he censes the Holy Doors in the form of a cross, saying:* "Blessed is our God..."; *and after "Amen", he begins: "Christ is risen" (thrice); then it is also sung by the brethren (thrice); and the priest says the verses: "Let God arise"; Verse: "As smoke vanishes"; Verse: "So let the wicked perish"; and after each verse the brethren sing: "Christ is risen"; Glory, Both now: "Christ is risen". Great Litany. At "Lord, I have cried", in Tone 2: Stichera, 3 Resurrectional and 3 Anatolian of Tone 2; Glory, Anatolian; Both now, Theotokion, Tone 1:* "The shadow of the Law hath passed away, now that grace hath come; for as the Bush was not consumed though on fire, so hast thou given birth as a virgin and remained a virgin. In place of the pillar of fire, the Sun of Righteousness hath shone forth; instead of Moses, Christ, the salvation of our souls."[^653] *Entrance with the Holy Gospel; "O Joyful Light"; then the Great Prokeimenon, Tone 7:* "Who is a god so great as our God? Thou art the God that doest wonders!" [Ps. 76:14–15][^654] *Verse 1: "Thou hast declared Thy power among the peoples" [Ps. 76:15]; Verse 2: "And I said: Now have I begun" [Ps. 76:11]; Verse 3: "I remembered the works of the Lord" [Ps. 76:12]; then the priest:* "And that we may be accounted worthy..."; *and he reads the Gospel according to John [20:19–25]: "The same day at evening..." ending with: "...I will not believe."*[^655] *Litany: "Let us all say..."; "Vouchsafe, O Lord..."; then the Litany: "Let us complete our evening prayer..."; Aposticha: Resurrectional:* "Thy Resurrection, O Christ Savior, hath enlightened the whole universe; and Thou hast recalled Thine own creation: O Almighty Lord, glory to Thee!"; *then 3 Stichera of Pascha...*[^656] *..."Pascha the sacred"; Verse: "Let God arise"; and the rest with their verses; Glory, Both now:* "This is the day of Resurrection..."; "Christ is risen" *(thrice); Dismissal. In this manner Vespers is sung throughout all this week, except for the Gospel.*[^657]

items.english_text: *The priest puts on the epitrachelion, and taking the censer, censes the Holy Table thrice in the sign of the cross, saying:* "Glory to the holy, consubstantial..."; *and after "Amen", the priest begins: "Christ is risen" (thrice), and censes the altar, the brethren singing: "Christ is risen" (thrice); and the priest says 3 verses: "O give thanks unto the Lord" [Ps. 117:1]; "This is the day which the Lord hath made" [Ps. 117:24]; "Bind the sacrifice with cords" [Ps. 117:27]; at each verse: "Christ is risen"; and again the priest: "Christ is risen"; the brethren: "And upon those in the tombs bestowing life!" Great Litany. After the exclamation, we begin the Canon:* "This is the day of Resurrection..."; *the Heirmos twice, and the troparia on 4, and again the Heirmos once together. At the beginning of the Canon the priest censes the church. After Ode 3, the Hypakoe, then the Heirmos; after Ode 6, Kontakion and Ikos, then the Resurrectional hymn...*[^659] *..."Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ" (thrice); and "Jesus having risen from the tomb", without the 50th Psalm.*[^660] *After Ode 9, the Exapostilarion (thrice); at the Praises: Stichera of the Octoechos of Tone 2 on 4; then the Paschal Stichera: "Pascha the sacred"; Glory, Both now:* "This is the day of Resurrection..."; *then "Christ is risen" (thrice); Litany, and Dismissal; and they process with crosses around the monastery. In this manner it is sung also at Matins throughout all the week.*[^661]

[Ps. 76:2][^671]

items.slavonic_text: Прн · тѣ́ло х҃во · Въ то́нже , дн҃ь · на вечерни стры · въ · ѡ҃ · въскрн҃ · гл̃а и҃ · въскр̃ны г҃ · и҆ въсто г҃ · сла̃ д҃ н҃ въсто · і҃н҃ б҃о · цр҃ю не бесныи · въхо̃ · про гл̃а и҃ · Далъ е҆си до стоꙗнїе · с҃ · ѿ конець землѧ , с҃ · покрыю сѧ въ · таковъ спою · На стї · въскр̃сны · и҆ пасцьѣ́ · Въ сꙋботоу , на оу҆трни , ꙗ҆́коже и҆ в пн҃е · на лѵ́ргїи · а҃нтї па̃ · про , г҃ь просвѣ́ щенїе мое · с҃ · г҃ь защититель · а҆́пль рж҃ · а҆́ллꙋ́ꙗ · Г҃ь въцр̃исѧ · с҃ · и҆́бо оу҆твръди е҆ѵлїе рж҃ · при Тѣ́ло х҃во · На трапезѣ , сѣ́ кши бра̃и , раздробивъ келарь , а҆́ртоу и҆ дае ть бра̃и · Х҃с же въскрсе , възглашаетсѧ в конець трапезы · и҆ ѡ҃всегда · ѿ нн҃ѣ́ даже и҆ до възнесенїа · въ мѣ́стѣ́ , великомїа · Се моу же гл̃емомꙋ · ѿ келарѧ · мы гле̃мь ѡ҃ вѣ́щеваа · Въистинноу въскрсе · та̃ кела рь · прекрщ҃аѧ · панагыю · хлѣ́бомь речеть · Пр҃таа бц҃е помагаи намь · мы же

items.slavonic_text: Прн · тѣ́ло х҃во · Въ то́нже , дн҃ь · на вечерни стры · въ · ѡ҃ · въскрн҃ · гл̃а и҃ · въскр̃ны г҃ · и҆ въсто г҃ · сла̃ д҃ н҃ въсто · і҃н҃ б҃о · цр҃ю не бесныи · въхо̃ · про гл̃а и҃ · Далъ е҆си до стоꙗнїе · с҃ · ѿ конець землѧ , с҃ · покрыю сѧ въ · таковъ спою · На стї · въскр̃сны · и҆ пасцьѣ́ · Въ сꙋботоу , на оу҆трни , ꙗ҆́коже и҆ в пн҃е · на лѵ́ргїи · а҃нтї па̃ · про , г҃ь просвѣ́ щенїе мое · с҃ · г҃ь защититель · а҆́пль рж҃ · а҆́ллꙋ́ꙗ · Г҃ь въцр̃исѧ · с҃ · и҆́бо оу҆твръди е҆ѵлїе рж҃ · при Тѣ́ло х҃во · На трапезѣ , сѣ́ кши бра̃и , раздробивъ келарь , а҆́ртоу и҆ дае ть бра̃и · Х҃с же въскрсе , възглашаетсѧ в конець трапезы · и҆ ѡ҃всегда · ѿ нн҃ѣ́ даже и҆ до възнесенїа · въ мѣ́стѣ́ , великомїа · Се моу же гл̃емомꙋ · ѿ келарѧ · мы гле̃мь ѡ҃ вѣ́щеваа · Въистинноу въскрсе · та̃ кела рь · прекрщ҃аѧ · панагыю · хлѣ́бомь речеть · Пр҃таа бц҃е помагаи намь · мы же
items.english_text: *At the Refectory [trapeza]: The brethren having sat down, the cellarer having broken the Artos, distributes it unto the brethren.*[^699] *"Christ is risen" is proclaimed at the end of the refectory, and always from now even unto the Ascension, in place of "Great is the Name [of the Holy Trinity]".*[^700] *And when this is said by the cellarer, we say responding:* "Truly He is risen!" *Then the cellarer, crossing the panagia with the bread, says:* "All-holy Theotokos, help us!" *And we...* *...respond:* "By her prayers, O God, have mercy on us!"[^701] *Then:* "All generations call thee blessed", *and the rest of the customary order.*[^702]

items.slavonic_text: и҆ дверемъ затвореныимь оу҆чн҃комь преста и҆́же въсѣ́мь въскренїе , дх҃ъ правыи тѣ́ми ѡ҃бновлꙗꙗ намь по велицѣи твое́и мл҃ти :~ Подобает же вѣ́дати , ꙗ҆́ко ѿ сеꙗ нѣли · и҆ до въ сѣ́хъ ст҃ы · на всенощно · а҃ · е҆ · великое чь тенїе · ѿ дѣꙗнїи а҆пл҃ь · и҆ е҆гда кончаютсѧ пакы начне · На оу҆ тро̃ · праз̃ · г҃ · ка̃ , двѣ́ и҆ липого мл҃тивы · сѣ́д праздн̃ · чт҃ее въ б҃о словѣ́ · Степенна · гла̃ д҃ · а҃нтї , а҃ · про по Хвали і҃ерлм̃е г҃а · с҃ · Ꙗ҆́ко оу҆крѣ́пи верѣ́ꙗ , е҆ѵлїе въскр̃ное а҃ · е҃ · Въскрсенїе х҃во · ѱа ломь · н҃ · ст҃ра , праздн̃ · кано̃ · гла̃ а҃ · Поимь вси людїе · і҃рм̃ь по , в҃ · и҆ тро̃ на в҃і · катавасїа · Въскрсенїа дн҃ь · по г҃ · пѣ̃ · сѣ́д празн̃ · гла̃ ѕ҃ · сла̃ і҃ н҃ б҃о а҃ · по ѕ҃ · пѣ̃ · ко̃ гла̃ и҃ · Любопытною десницею , живо дателнаꙗ твоꙗ ребра · Ѳома и҆спыталь е҆̃ х҃е б҃е · затвореныимь оу҆́бо дверемь , ꙗ҆́ко въ виде · и҆ съ прочими на́плы въпїꙗше · Г҃ь е҆си
items.english_text: *It should be known that from this Sunday even unto All Saints, at the All-Night Vigil, the first great reading is from the Acts of the Apostles; and when it is finished, it is begun again.*[^708]

items.english_text: With his searching right hand did Thomas explore Thy life-giving side, O Christ God; for when Thou didst enter, the doors being shut, he cried aloud with the rest of the Apostles: Thou art my Lord and my God![^711] *Ikos; after Ode 9:* "More honorable than the Cherubim" *is not sung, and we do not chant the verses of the Ninth Ode.*[^712] *Exapostilarion, Tone 3:* "With thy hand having probed the wounds of My members, Thomas, be not faithless unto Me..."[^713] *At the Praises, Stichera on 4, Tone 1, Podoben: "All-praised martyrs" (Всехвалніи мученицы):*[^714] *Glory, Tone 6:* "After eight days our Savior came unto the disciples..."; *Both now:* "Most blessed art thou, O Virgin Theotokos..."; *Great Doxology; Troparion of the feast, and Dismissal.*

items.slavonic_text: кврѣ́ ст҃го пантикостна · и҆змѣ́ныи стра̃мь · и҆ тро́ре · по гл̃со · Въ пн҃е а҃нтипас хы · на оу҆рни · ѡ҃быи · полꙋнощница · та̃ бл҃вившꙋ і҃ере́ю · начинае̃ · Х҃с въскре̃ · г҃ , та̃ Слава въ вышнїи , и҆ шесапл̃мы · И҆ на б҃ъ г҃ь тро̃ · праз̃ г҃ · и҆ ст҃ислови , двѣ́ · ка̃ · По а҃ · ка̃ · сѣ́д въ ѡ҃ · въскр̃ны · и҆ покаꙗнны · и҆ дл҃ · сл҃ і҃ н҃ · по в҃ · ка̃ сѣ́д · праз̃ · Въскре нїе х҃во видѣ · ѱл̃ѡ н҃ · пѣ́ни же не гле̃ въ всю н҃ цю · и҆ табїе начинае · і҃рмо по в҃ · и҆ тро̃ на ѕ҃ · и҆ ст҃овдїи · на д҃ · по г҃ пѣ́ · сѣ́д в д҃и по ѕ҃ · кѡ̃ праз̃ · по ѳ҃ · свѣ́ праз̃ · на хва̃ · въскр̃ны · покаꙗнны · и҆ дл҃ · сл̃ і҃ н҃ праз̃ · на стї ст҃ры праз̃ · и҆́же въ триѡ҃ · с҃ тї же гле̃ ды · въ всю зелю · с҃ · нб҃са повѣ́даю · сл̃а і҃ н҃ праз̃ · по тр҃тѣмь · тро̃ праз̃ · і҃ере̃и ѡ҃кте̃ю · та̃ і҃ереи · Сын бл̃агословень б҃ъ нашь · и҆ съвъкоуплꙗе̃ · а҃ ча̃ · по ѡ҃быю · Вѣ́домо же бꙋди ꙗ҆́ко ѿ сеꙗ дн҃нны · начи
items.english_text: *On Monday of Antipascha [Second Monday after Pascha], at Matins: The usual Midnight Office. Then the priest having blessed, we begin:* "Christ is risen" *(thrice); then* "Glory to God in the highest", *and the Six Psalms. And at* "God is the Lord": *Troparion of the feast, thrice; and chant two Kathismata. After the 1st Kathisma: Sessional hymns from the Octoechos, Resurrectional and Penitential, and of the day; Glory, Both now. After the 2nd Kathisma: Sessional hymn of the feast;* "Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ"; *Psalm 50; but the Hymns [of repentance: "Open unto me the doors of repentance..."] are not said throughout the whole Fifty Days [Pentecostarion period]. And straightway we begin [the Canon]: the Heirmos twice, and troparia to 6, and of the Triodion/saint to 4. After Ode 3: Sessional hymn of the day; after Ode 6: Kontakion of the feast; after Ode 9: Exapostilarion of the feast. At the Praises: Resurrectional, Penitential, and of the day; Glory, Both now, of the feast. At the Aposticha: Stichera of the feast, which are in the Triodion; and we say the verses:* Their sound is gone out into all the earth, and their words unto the ends of the world! [Ps. 18:5][^722] *Verse:* The heavens declare the glory of God, and the firmament proclaims the work of His hands! [Ps. 18:2] *Glory, Both now, of the feast. After the Trisagion: Troparion of the feast. The priest says the Ektenia. Then the priest [gives the dismissal/blessing]:* "Blessed is the Son of God, our God", *and he joins the First Hour according to custom.*[^723]

items.english_text: *Be it known that from this day we begin...* *...to chant the Psalter: two Kathismata at Matins, and the third at Vespers in order.*[^724] *And from now on we begin to chant the Canon to the Most Holy Theotokos at Compline, the daily canons in the Triodion.*[^725] *At the beginning of every singing [office], the priest having blessed, we say:* "Christ is risen" *(thrice); then* "Glory, Both now", "All-holy Trinity", *and* "Our Father", *and the rest as usual.*[^726] *Likewise even until the Day of the Ascension, in the same manner. And at Matins, after the second litany is said:* "Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ", *even until the Ascension of the Lord.*[^727] *And this is to be known: Even as it hath been indicated on Sunday evening and on Monday at Matins, so it is done throughout all the weeks, even until the Ascension, with the stichera changing according to the Tones in the Octoechos, and the Sessional hymns according to custom.*[^728] *Be it known also that on Wednesday and on Friday, the Stichera of the Cross are sung first; thus: the Resurrectional are not first, because our Lord Jesus Christ was first crucified...* *...and thus rose from the dead.*[^729]

*Be it known that from this day we begin...*
*...to chant the Psalter: two Kathismata at Matins, and the third at Vespers in order.*[^724] *And from now on we begin to chant the Canon to the Most Holy Theotokos at Compline, the daily canons in the Triodion.*[^725] *At the beginning of every singing [office], the priest having blessed, we say:* "Christ is risen" *(thrice); then* "Glory, Both now", "All-holy Trinity", *and* "Our Father", *and the rest as usual.*[^726] *Likewise even until the Day of the Ascension, in the same manner. And at Matins, after the second litany is said:* "Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ", *even until the Ascension of the Lord.*[^727] *And this is to be known: Even as it hath been indicated on Sunday evening and on Monday at Matins, so it is done throughout all the weeks, even until the Ascension, with the stichera changing according to the Tones in the Octoechos, and the Sessional hymns according to custom.*[^728] *Be it known also that on Wednesday and on Friday, the Stichera of the Cross are sung first; thus: the Resurrectional are not first, because our Lord Jesus Christ was first crucified...*
*...and thus rose from the dead.*[^729]

items.english_text: *On Friday of Antipascha [Second Friday of Paschaltide, Apodosis of Thomas Sunday], at Vespers: Stichera on 6: of the feast, idiomela 3 in Tone 1; and of the day, 3; Glory, Tone 6:* "When the doors were shut..."; *Both now, Dogmatikon Theotokion of Tone 1:* "The glory of all the world, who sprouted from mankind..."[^730] *At the Aposticha: 4 Resurrectional of Tone 1; and we say the verses:* The Lord is King, He is clothed with majesty! [Ps. 92:1a] *Verse:* For He hath established the world, which shall not be shaken! [Ps. 92:1c] *Verse:* Holiness becomes Thine house, O Lord, unto length of days! [Ps. 92:5b] *Glory, Both now, Tone 5:* "O Lover of mankind, great and unsearchable..."; *Troparion, Tone 7:* "Though the tomb was sealed..."; *the Canon for the Departed in the Octoechos of the current Tone.*[^731] *On all Saturdays of the Fifty Days is sung [the Canon for the Departed] on Friday at Compline. On Saturday at Matins: Troparion of the feast, thrice; Sessional hymns in the Triodion of the feast; Canon of the feast with the heirmoi on 6, and of the patron saint of the temple in Tone 1 on 4; or if there be no patronal service, then of the Prophets; or of the Saint [from the Menaion] on 4.*[^732] *At the Praises: 4 Resurrectional of Tone 1; Glory, Both now, of the feast. At the Liturgy: Prokeimenon of the feast; Alleluia, Communion verse of the feast; but the Epistle and Gospel of the day.*[^733]

items.slavonic_text: цы · въскр̃ны · г҃ · въ ѡ҃ · в҃ го гласа · и҆ въ [сто] д҃ · и҆ мироносица · сагл̃ны · г҃ · гл̃ в҃ · сл̃ · гл̃ ѕ҃ · Мироносица же · і҃н҃ б҃о · Пренде сѣ́нь зако̃ · на и҆схо̃ · сагл̃ны · г҃ · гл̃а а҃ · сла̃ гл̃ ѕ҃ · И҆ спроси і҃ѡси̃ · і҃н҃ б҃о · а҆́збꙋ̃ · въ тои гл̃а · на сти · стїхива · въскрена · и҆ а҆́збꙋ̃ сл҃ і҃ н҃ · гл̃ е҃ · Тебе ѡ҃дѣ́ющагосѧ · по тр҃томь бц҃е д҃во г҃ · На оу҆́рни · на б҃ъ г҃ь · тро̃ гл̃ в҃ · Е҆гда сниде · в҃ · Сл̃ · Бл҃гообразныи , і҆ѡси̃ · съ кр҃та съне̃ прч҃тое тѣ́ло твое · плащѧни цею чт҃ою ѡ҃бвивъ · и҆ вонꙗми въ гробѣ новꙋ възакрывы положи · но въ третїи дн҃ь въ скре̃ ꙗ҆́ко б҃ъ · дарова всемоу мирови велїю ми ло̃ :~ і҆ны · Мироносицамь женамь · при гро бѣ ставь а҆́гг҃лъ гла̃ше миро мрт҃выимь е҆́ подо бно · х҃с же и҆стлѣ́нїю ꙗ҆́висѧ чюжь · но въ спите зовꙋще · въскре̃ г҃ь подаꙗ мирови ве лїю мл҃ть :~ и҆ про е҆ ѡ҃бычное · нѣ̃ · сꙋтенна · в҃ · го · е҆ѵлїе · г҃е · оу҆трнее · Канонъ · въ

items.english_text: *On the 3rd Sunday evening [Third Sunday of Pascha, at Vespers]: Even as on the Sunday of Antipascha. But the Entrance from now on Sunday [evening] does not take place.*[^750] *And on Monday...* *...at Matins: As also on Monday of Antipascha. At the Aposticha: Stichera of the feast, and we say the verses:* Lord, Thou hast been favorable unto Thy land! [Ps. 84:2] *Verse:* Mercy and truth are met together! [Ps. 84:11] *Glory, Both now, of the feast. On Monday evening of the 3rd Week: Even as indicated for Monday of the 2nd Week, with changing stichera and troparia. On Saturday at Matins: As on Saturday of Antipascha.*[^751] *At the Liturgy: Ode 9 of the feast with the heirmoi on 6; Prokeimenon, Alleluia of the feast; but the Epistle and Gospel, and Communion verse, of the day.*[^752]
